anh_en: Oh! She once invited me to dinner, and I said yes. However, when I arrived at the restaurant, it turned out to be a large gathering with dozens of people… I was quite nervous, but she was super nice, always making sure I was okay. Thanks to that, I actually met a lot of new people... and some of them even became my clients later on.

speaker: Zhezhi
anh_en: His lion dancing... it's really something. So precise and yet so full of life. I once walked by a lion dance performance and tried to sketch it quickly, but the movements kept changing... My pencil couldn't keep up. So, I ended up going to the theater a few more times just to watch. Before I knew it, I actually started enjoying the <te href=850131>liondances</te> quite a bit.

speaker: Zhezhi
anh_en: It's your birthday today. I-I know there will be many people celebrating and giving you gifts, so... I'm not sure what to get that won't be repetitive… How-how about you tell me what you want? Anything you want, I can find it, or any place you wanna go, I'll come along. If you haven't decided yet, that's okay too! My offer will never expire. Really, anytime you need something, just ask and I'll do my best. Oops, sorry, I-I'm rambling... I meant to say, happy birthday!

speaker: Zhezhi
anh_en: Hmm… what should I paint… Oh…

speaker: Zhezhi
anh_en: I'm Zhezhi… I do commissioned paintings. Um, what else...? Oh, I'm open for commissions! I offer fair prices, can adapt to any style you need, and do revisions too. And I never miss a deadline!

speaker: Zhezhi
anh_en: Now I've got the energy to work on my commissions.

speaker: Zhezhi
anh_en: Your trust… means so much to me!

speaker: Zhezhi
anh_en: Fighting… has never been my strong suit. But, I understand what you're asking of me. I won't give up easily, no matter who or what I'm up against!

speaker: Zhezhi
anh_en: Th-thank you! Sorry if I've been a bother... Please make sure to take care of yourself before helping me. I wouldn't know what to do with this power if something happened to you... But please, know how much I cherish y—Er, I mean, know how much I cherish your help!

speaker: Zhezhi
anh_en: Wow, beautiful… Oh, I'd better put them away first.

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Huh, you're lucky to have come across me—the undisputed master of antique appraisal! Now, what do we have here? Hand over your goodies and I'll take a look!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Don't bother impressing me with your knowledge of antique appraisal, since hardly anyone knows it better than me! *self-satisfied snort* What I want in a friend is merely respect for ancient artifacts.

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Hey, here's a secret–but don't go blabbing to anyone else. If you recite "Master Youhu's Poem Collection" by the City Hall, the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> will totally bless you. Well, maybe it won't... but hey, at least *I'll* totally help you…

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Somehow you've been giving off antique vibes... Ahem! I'm being professional here! Your frequencies! Some of them feel recent, but some feel like they're from ancient times. It's... special...

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Antiques aren't just about how much they're worth, but the feelings they hold. For example, if an item can record this moment in time, a memory of you and me together... That will make it super important. Yes... It will be priceless... To me, at least!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: I am Master Youhu, the best antique appraiser ever! Needless to say my favorite is antiques of all kinds. Some say I talk too much, but hey, if they brought me cool stuff, I'd zip it real quick. No lie.

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Treasures are plenty if you look, but stealing is a total bore. Catching baddies dusk till dawn, that's what I do all along.*Yawn* Still got a bunch of losers who haven't returned what they took. Let's see who's so unlucky to cross paths with yours truly, Master Youhu!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Loong Buns are cool, they're like our tribute to the great Loongs. Food Ration Bars are cool too, they remind me of our soldier's dedication. Obviously, only the best meaningful food could ever impress Master Youhu!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Ugh, plain tea is so bitter! Who even likes that? I'll just find a chance to dump it in the cup of whoever bothers me next time. Hehe!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Why would I do this whole antique appraisal thing? To make sure the antiques end up with the right people, of course! I'm like, the go-to for anyone who actually appreciates these things. And those snotty fakers and liars? I'll show 'em what's up. Aww, it's sure tough being such an honest and awesome appraiser like me!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Nothing's ever perfect in this world, and this jade ring is no exception... Ahh, you're curious? My story isn't free, ya know! My antique appraisal fee is... Oh wait, it's my day off. I don't work for money today. Bye-bye!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: I've been a genius since I was born! Like this one time, I met a dude who made bank by dissing real antiques, so he could sell them later for way more. Had the face to call himself an appraiser, huh. So I snuck into his place, stole his secrets, and posted them on the gate of the market. Pretty cool, right? Only problem was I was eight years old and couldn't run fast enough from him. *hiss*… Ugh, the pain in my head is still fresh even after all these years.

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: That <te href=850131>liondancer</te>... Lingyang, I think? He surely knows how to come up with those Lucky Greetings. They sound cool. Almost as cool as my poems, I'll give him that!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Even though I haven't chatted with him much, I can tell that Mortefi dude is a man of culture. Fingers crossed he becomes my client one day!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: A <te href=850112>Jinzhou Patroller</te>... Uhh, gotta stay away from her... Hey, I've done nothing bad! Just used a few... tricks, to get back what belongs to the right people. Surely that's not a crime... right?

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: We're about the same age, but Danjin's much taller than me... The jade she wears is so pretty! *sigh*... It's a shame I can't feel a single joyful frequency from it...

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: What's up with that mirror she carries, you ask? Oh my, oh my! That's a big, BIG secret. Not for your ears!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: So, I accidentally heard it's your birthday today. And because we're like, friends or something, I made you this wooden statue of the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>. It's said to protect you on your trips. Yeah, I just whipped it up on a whim! W-What do you mean it takes other people months to finish? Well I'm just amazingly talented, so of course it only took me half a day!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Hmm...  Can't seem to figure out these scratch marks... Ummm... Ugh!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Hmhmm... Aha! What, you want a bite?

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Time may deceive, but wisdom takes hold. Here comes Master Youhu, the great antique appraiser!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Woah! Hehe... Wanna catch me huh, you thieves?

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: New goodies to see? I'm in!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Just so you know, while I charge little for antique appraisals, fighting's gonna be a different price!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Alright, I'll humor you for a bit, since I'm feeling good today!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Geez, you're actually giving me all of these? Good call!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Well, I'm already super strong but... Thanks for the extra buff!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Aha! Now I'm up to my eyes in goodies, and I've got the strength to keep 'em safe too!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: As per Master Youhu's professional opinion, I am invincible now! Those who don't appreciate antiques shall tremble before me!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Such power should allow me to protect all the antiques in the world... Thanks to you, I'm no longer fighting alone... Ack! Nope. This is too embarrassing to say out loud!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Luck is on MY side! Hehe... Waaahhh!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Don't let your jaws drop yet! Hehe... Waaahhh!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Is that the best you got?

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Worry not! Go ahead and open it! This master is here for ya!

speaker: Youhu
anh_en: Outta my way! I want a look!

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Before our paths crossed, I'd only heard stories about you from Grandfather. But <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> is rather secluded, and not all the tales that reach us remain true. I found myself wondering who you really were, and you surpassed every expectation. Your arrival didn't just disrupt the delicate balance in Ragunna, it also shed light on doubts and hesitations that had kept me trapped for so long.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Be light and swift, steady and precise. One hand on the waist, the other on the shoulder. Let the momentum carry you into a perfect arc as you spin… Hehe, you see? Combat and ballroom dancing do share a few similarities, wouldn't you agree?

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: In our family, we encounter all sorts of people, but they generally fall into three categories: the wealthy, the poor, and young newcomers with nothing to lose. Regardless, those that intrigue me the most are the ones with a fire in their eyes. You see, those who don't know what they truly want are often adrift, chasing after everything but never holding onto a thing.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: I've come to find a genuine pleasure working with you—truly, I do not say this out of formality. Whether it's business or not, I truly cherish every moment we share.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: You have the most beautiful eyes. When you're focused intently, they shine like gems... I must admit, I find myself captivated. So, why not keep me in your sights a little longer? Perhaps then, I could be the one to make that sparkle even brighter.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: The beauty of art shouldn't be confined by a viewer's knowledge or taste. Whether it's the latest trends, timeless classics, or avant-garde surrealism, each offers a unique vantage point. What I truly admire is the emotion and passion artists pour into their work. That's why I connect them with patrons who can truly appreciate their vision, ensuring their brilliance is recognized and valued.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Long ago, I witnessed a storm that I will never forget. The air was suffocating, damp, and tinged with a faint, rusty odor. I stood there in silence, feeling utterly helpless. Since that day, I've faced many more storms. Instead of retreating, I choose to walk into the rain, seeking justice before it can wash away all the blood and pain. Now that I think about it, perhaps it wasn't the rain itself I loathed, but what it brought with it. After all, it's difficult to hold onto one's dignity in a downpour, and in those moments, we all reveal parts of ourselves we'd rather keep hidden.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: When it comes to flavors, I don't have any particular preferences. But isn't it curious how food can take on a meaning of its own depending on the company? Take my family, for instance—we say true unity only comes after sharing a bottle of honeyed wine and a slice of orange pie. What do you think? Shall we try that next time?

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Have you ever attended one of those lavish traditional banquets? The portions are modest, but the pomp is overwhelming. Silver bowls, crystal goblets, and gem-studded plates parade before you, each one more ostentatious than the last, all to flaunt the host's wealth... Before you can even begin to eat, you must endure dozens of needless formalities. To me, they seem to forget that true decorum and elegance are not about such excess.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: The <te href=850101>Montellis'</te> legacy is built and sustained by every member of the our family. We know the world is far greater than <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> or <te href=850096>Rinascita</te> alone. Just as our ancestors once ventured into the unknown, we too must continue to chart new courses. Now, a golden opportunity lies before us... I need only to seize it and take that step forward. Perhaps more than just one.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Everyone who handles family directives has a codename, each with a matching token. Mine is the opal. While they do shine and dazzle, my opals aren't real jewels. They're merely crystals reshaped by my Forte. Whether as decorations or ammunition, I use them to create the brilliance I desire.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: My past is no secret within my family or among old acquaintances… I've been called many things: the abandoned orphan, descendant of the lesser branch, prominent young lady, and efficient executor. Each title represents a part of me, though none capture the whole. To dance on the edge of danger, one must learn to wear many masks. For the future of the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family, I will play any role that's required of me.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: He's the captain leading his crew through tempestuous seas, and I often wonder whether his gaze from the deck reveals ambition, or selflessness and passion. Our family once extended an invitation to him, but he declined, remarking, "A captain's ship is his alone, and he will never abandon it." Thus, we remain partners with aligned interests, and that suits us just fine.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: I've always been curious about something. Just how much can her box, <te href=850122>Pero</te>, actually hold? New designs, costumes, the fine wines the troupe keeps hidden, shimmering sea gems and shells... And Roccia's thoughts and feelings, too. Though Roccia herself rarely speaks her mind, Pero seems to reveal them all.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Phoebe is as pure and innocent as a budding lily. Her kindness and devotion are beyond question. Yet, without sufficient strength, such virtues might lead one into the trap of blind faith. I mean no disrespect, but this is a dilemma every believer faces at some point—whether they are following a mere illusion shaped by others' agendas or upholding principles and beliefs that truly have meaning.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Zani is wary of unnecessary, inefficient tasks because she excels at completing her work with haste, precision, and quality. Although it may seem that these aspects contradict each other, they actually complement one another. The family imposes few restrictions on private commissions, so if you have a challenging request, feel free to approach her. Oh, but do ensure the compensation is appropriate.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Some people see family as a matter of blood and heritage, while others, unbound by such conventions, consider those who share their ideals as family. I am deeply grateful for the protection, opportunities, and insight Grandfather has given me, along with the pride of being a <te href=850101>Montelli</te>. He embodies the spirit of the Montelli family, and I am determined to honor his legacy. Like him, I will lead our family forward with action, as a true Montelli would.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Happy birthday, {PlayerName}. I must confess, ever since I found out about your birthday, I've been thinking about the perfect gift for you. You likely already possess many treasures, so I wanted mine to be something unique, practical, and delightful—something that would bring you joy and remind you of me. So, here it is: a pistol reshaped by my Forte. It symbolizes that you have the freedom to do as you wish. Whether or not you're a Montelli, this promise holds true, always, in the name of Carlotta <te href=850101>Montelli</te>.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Bang. The white has been dyed red.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: To shine or to die? Merely two sides of the same coin.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: I am Carlotta Montelli, the second lady of the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family. In certain situations, I might also be known as Opal. I have a talent for uncovering value and solving problems. Whether it's for business or building friendships, you can rely on me. If you're interested in closer collaboration... well, that's certainly possible. However, are you prepared to offer your faith, life, and future in exchange?

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Fate has led you to me, and considering the terms I'm offering… You wouldn't refuse me, would you?

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Let's prove our value to each other.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: See? I always choose the winning side—yours.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: New investments, new deals… I promise you won't be disappointed.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Now, my Forte can reshape even more. Your labour has truly borne fruit.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Such delightful and irresistible power. Well, now we have another shared secret.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Your generosity is as unwavering as ever. But how should I repay you? After all, the most precious things are often those that defy definition.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: The opal shines even more brightly… It seems you find greater pleasure in the crafting process itself than in the finished gems.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: Indeed, very well. Please, continue… Heh, did you not expect me to say that? I relish all the experiences you offered and make no secret of the ambition stirred. So, see this through—what I wish for and what I can offer go far beyond what is presented now.

speaker: Carlotta
anh_en: In the name of the <te href=850101>Montellis</te>.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: Aleph-1 has been driven back, for now. But its shadow lingers. There are still complications in <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>, matters unfit for researchers that require my hand. Once they are settled, I intend to return to <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te> to see it for myself. Though it has already been... Well, perhaps we will meet again there.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: About the Fractsidus... You remember how I can draw upon my futures with the Suzu's power? Among them was one where I became a <te href=850074>Threnodian</te> Resonator. That possibility proved I could bear its power, and marked me as a threat in the eyes of many. That is why the Fractsidus sought me out, time and again. But you need not worry. I burned that future to ash before your eyes. The line is drawn.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: Tales of your exploits abound. Folk legends across countless regions, <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te> reports, slander from the lips of your enemies...Yet those remain merely the evaluations of others. It was not until I met you that I understood why they depict you as they do. Had our paths crossed sooner... I wonder, might mine have taken a different turn?

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: There is something I wish... No, something I must confess to you. Even now, after our time together, a sour sentiment lingers within me. If I were to name it, I would call it "jealousy." I find myself imagining your power as my own, wondering if I, too, could have... Forgive me. I simply needed to exhale this poison. If my words trouble you... then I will bear whatever judgment you deem fitting.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: I once wielded my blade to see it shatter. Each strike was my prayer for spring, for the snow to thaw, and... for my own release. I believed solitude was a fate I could not escape. But when I looked at you, I realized that perhaps I may yet cling to something in this fate. I am not you, and I will never become you. Our paths may have crossed but briefly, yet knowing you walk the same path as well... I no longer feel alone.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: I sculpt figurines in my leisure time. It is an intricate process, demanding one's complete focus. A state I find grounding. And no matter the medium or style, there is always a reference, a clear set of steps to follow. Adhere to them, and a repeatable result is assured. Such certainty is rare to find these days.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te> still occupies my thoughts... but I would not call it a burden. The past is settled. What remains is to handle what was left behind. Even if it is nowhere to be found on any map, the land still carries a legacy meant to endure.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: Gyokuro tea. It is <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>'s specialty. When I was young, I would steal sips from the adults' cups. All I tasted then was bitterness. But by the time I learned to appreciate the sweet aftertaste, I realized I had begun to miss that bitterness instead.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: Confections, I suppose... Not from any preference of palate. It is simply that sweetness, upon tasting, stirs memories of a bitter kind. The sweeter the past I once held, the more bitter the aftertaste that lingers.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: My wish is... that there will never be another Miko of Flaming Sakura. That no further fate need be bound to the <te href=850074>Threnodians</te>. Perhaps... all we have ever sought is a world where every soul is simply granted the right to live an ordinary life.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: The bell I wear on my wrist is what we call a "Legacy Talisman" in <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>. For us Mikos of Flaming Sakura, it is a sacred relic passed down through generations—a vessel of Ashinohara's wishes. Through it, I gain the power to burn my futures, a power said to originate from Ashinohara's Sentinel. I know you share a close bond with the Sentinels. If you wish to see it, I can show it to you. Oh... the cord tied to the bell? Gyokuro braided it for me when I was a child. That alone is mine. The only thing that is.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: If you wish to know more about my past, you will find snippets of it in the records of <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>. They tell a far more vivid tale than I ever could. After all, my only memory of the past is me striking that blade, again and again and again.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: She is a bright spirit. I am aware of certain secrets she carries. In a sense, we are both bound by our pasts. But she has a future she is galloping toward, one filled with light and hope she wholly deserves. That said, I still believe she should refrain from using her Forte to slip into class when she is late.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: Chisa is also from <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>. I have made a point to avoid meeting her. After all, in our homeland, Mikos only appeared in the darkest of times. We were never omens of good fortune—perhaps a parallel can be drawn to those detective comics popular nowadays. Besides, it may be unsettling to see a name from history standing before you in the flesh. Also, please do not speak to her of what transpired in Ashinohara. That burden is not hers to bear.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: A resilient child. She surely endured unimaginable hardship to return here. When she vanished within the simulator cockpit, I was out on a field assignment. The investigation team later briefed me on her case. The detail that made me pause was her writing "saving the world" as her career aspiration... Hm, I find myself wondering... what in her upbringing instilled this level of conviction?

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: She bears an awful load for a child of her age. She seeks to shoulder the expectations placed upon a <te href=700025>Solsworn</te> far ahead her own time. I have noticed her watching the Shiratori I send forth. Perhaps I should fold one for her before I depart?

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: I... believe I failed her, in a way. Had I been quicker to see through the Fractsidus's plot, she might not have suffered as she did. I borrowed your strength when I delivered that strike. Only then was I able to restore a whisper of her true self back to her. I pray it caused no lasting harm. I am told that she is recovering. If we meet again, I will offer my apologies in person.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: Though Lucilla insists our partnership is only contractual, I am well aware that without her discreet arrangements, I would have no place in the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>, much less have obtained that blade. She carries herself lightly, yet the weight on her shoulders is plain to see. She often visits me, half in jest, declaring that she intends to "call it quits"—it is her way of venting. Before returning to <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>, I should at least see her through the troubles presently at hand.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: A joyous birthday to you. The day of one's birth signifies the commencement of all things. It is a guidepost to your origin and an anchor should you ever drift. I first thought to prepare a traditional gift. Yet upon reflection, there is no offering more fitting than this single, blank paper. Please, write your wish here. Hold nothing back. Whatever it may be, I shall make it come true.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: I am Hiyuki, the last Miko of Flaming Sakura. Should you seek to slay the Threnodians, my blade and I stand at your service.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: Hm, I feel it now. A sharper edge now rests within my grasp.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: To refine one's skill is a lifelong pursuit. Perhaps we may reach greater heights together.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: With this strength, I shall safeguard more wishes.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: The path I walk stretches into the future. The wishes laid upon me… perhaps one day, I can finally make them...

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: You hear the ring of my blade, do you not? It is the sound of my conviction to see through your wishes. Any of them.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: Is that the best you can do?

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: Follow my moves, if you can.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: You've prepared for this, have you not?

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: A life as fleeting as the first snow.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: Take your final dive, into Naraka.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: May the sakura incinerate. Burn this self away.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: Roam above the inferno, gazing at the snow.

speaker: Hiyuki
anh_en: For all wishes spoken, this vessel I offer.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Sometimes, it feels a little strange when you call me "Professor." Feels like since you enrolled, I've been the one taking instruction. In any case, glad to have you around, {PlayerName}. Or should I say, "Professor {PlayerName}"?

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Seeing you takes me back to my Pioneer Association days. Oh, the anticipation of setting foot on one strange land after another. Sometimes you'd stumble onto something wonderful. More often? Brutal challenges. Absurd misadventures. Lying flat on your back in camp, staring up at the stars, too exhausted to move... What do you think would cross your mind? Who would you think of?

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: When I first joined the Pioneer Association, it was pure rebellion. A way to spite my mother's plans. A little "self-sabotage" just to get under her skin. "Look," I wanted to say, "your carefully cultivated protege just joined an organization with zero political capital." Feels arrogant now, looking back. She raised me too well. Made me just like her...

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Coming to Startorch Academy was mostly by chance. I was first dispatched to Lahai-Roi for an extended expedition. Then one thing led to another, and I was reassigned to the Spacetrek Collective, eventually ending up here at the Academy. At first, they wanted me to use my Forte to trace ancient memories buried in Exostrider material. But how was a small life form such as myself ever to resonate with an alien civilization?

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: I left that cold home. Left the New Federation. Left the Pioneer Association, too. Back then, I was just running for the sake of running. I loathed where I had come from so much that I tried to erase my memories of it. But you can't erase who you are... I thought the Academy would be another stop on the road. Then the views here took hold of me. And now, when I look back, all I see is them.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Busy afternoons on the first day of the semester. Hosting orientations, listening to reports, and delivering speeches at ceremonies. Then heading straight back to my office, lying face down on the cold desk, and listening to the little gremlins chattering and laughing away outside. Those are my favorite moments.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: I swear, the new jokes and memes around campus are evolving faster than I can keep up...

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Burnt cookies, soggy instant noodles, desserts where someone confused salt with sugar... If they made it for me, I love it.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: I like to think I'm quite open-minded about how each department runs things. But, how shall I put this... Sometimes I do feel the cafeteria's canned foods are a bit of a letdown.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: My dream now is just to see all my students' dreams come true.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: That camera, or rather that gun, has always existed in my memories. It seemed to have been with me ever since I awakened my Forte. Was it a present from someone? Or is it a "gift" from my memories? I can't quite remember.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: I have to admit, being editor-in-chief, a researcher, and President all at the same time probably means I didn't escape her plans for me. Which is all the more reason for me to be the kind of President students adore and bigwigs can't stand. Perhaps this is my "rebellious phase."

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: You, me, and Hiyuki. If I may, I'd like to presume we're "cut from the same cloth." Each of us had our reasons for starting down the path we're on now. Difference is, I journey to stay, whereas you and Hiyuki...

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Behind that lovely smile is pure steel. I feel inspired just hearing her voice—Heh, see? You're a better teacher than I am!

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: He's got just a few too many mysteries for a doctor... But as a colleague, his skills speak for themselves. And that's what I trust.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: She's just the cutest, isn't she? Pure, honest, trying so hard to carry the weight of the world on those tiny shoulders. Breaks my heart. But given my position, even a gentle pat on the cheek would likely only make her more anxious.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: She's kept it hidden so well, for so long. That just makes me blame myself and my heart ache for her more.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Happy birthday, {PlayerName}.\nAs your instructor, I hope you've taken something from every challenge we've faced together. Experience. Strength. For a dream like yours, you can never be too prepared.\nBut as your friend, my selfish wish is that you'd let yourself live a little more freely. At least today on your birthday, step out of the shadows of the past and look toward the future!

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: I believe it's this one? ...How nice.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: ...Yes, I'm here. Of course. Proceed as planned. Bye-bye.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Lucilla, President of Startorch Academy. What surprises do you have in store for me today?

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Life's a reel of memories. And memories? Life, recut.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Tell me there's no sweating involved.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: So it's my turn to be the student this time?

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Slow and steady. Let's not bite off more than we can chew.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: You may not have memories of power, but you can always draw strength from memories.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Every challenge we've faced, every obstacle we've overcome, and every memory we've shared... All of it has become my strength.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Illusions of the past... Step forward!

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Oh, this gadget has seen some upgrades.

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Well, well. What do we have here?

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Let's pick up the pace, hm?

speaker: Lucilla
anh_en: Nothing motivates like a little reward.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: It sucks that you can't remember your past, there must've been a lot of unforgettable memories. But no worries, we can create new ones. You and I, together!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: You should check out Uncle Mahe's for freshest groceries and Auntie Panhua's for the best cuisines. Oh, I'm not saying this because we're related. The food's just that good! Say, I'll bring you over so you can give 'em a try yourself when we have the time.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Auntie Panhua always told me how tastebuds can store memories. Maybe the taste of a familiar dish could jog your memory? Even if that fails, a yummy meal will certainly lift your spirits! I want to make everyone happy, especially you.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: <te href=850113>Overdash</te> racing, hero plays, plus the secret bases out in the suburbs... There are so many more places that I want to take you to. I've never been hyped for days off like this before you came. It's amazing how time flies when we're together!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Even I can tell you're different from us... One day you'll leave for somewhere far away, right? Well, when the day comes, do take this Fiamma sticker, this wristlet I made, plus this jar of homemade Victor Savor... What? That's too much to carry? I-I just want you to think of me when we're not together!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: The hero plays at Jinzhou Theater are the bee's knees! Especially during New Years, everyone would gather around to enjoy the plays, havin' a whale of a time.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: You see, heroes can defeat bad guys with just a few whams 'n' bams in plays. But that isn't so easy in real life. They're like those pesky Excarats, you whack one here and another pops up somewhere else, like those <te href=850081>TDs</te> in the wilds, those no-good bandits, and those weirdos in red... Ahem. Anyway, just keep 'em comin' alright. I'll take 'em all on!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Victor Savor! That sauce is so good, you'll munch an old shoe with it.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: What's there to be picky about? I'm good with any food, as long as it fills my tummy.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I've always wanted to become a hero! A hero matching Speedster and Fiamma, bringing hope and courage to all!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I used to fight with nothing more than my flames, but now I have these pistols. I'll hold on tight to whatever weapon I can have, so I can protect everyone!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I was really scared of the dark when I was little, but "Fiamma" would always arrive in time to drive it away. Now that I'm all grown up, I'm not scared anymore. I can be my own torch!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Happy Birthday! Try this, I made this bow of Maocai all by myself, with extra Victor Savor added just for you. Eat up while it's still steamin'! Don't worry about the spiciness, it's a good omen!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Everyone's safe and sound? Looks like I didn't practice for nothing, then!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: <te href=850112>Jinzhou Patroller</te>, Chixia. You can always call on me if you ever find yourself in a pickle!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Huggghhh... I can feel the power! And the flames rising!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: At this rate, the entire <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> City... No wait. The entirety of Huanglong shall be known to the heroic Chixia's name!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I've become a Human Torch! I am flame! With this power, I can now protect everyone, including someone as strong as you!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I can do this all day!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Now, what do we have here? Ya can't hide from me!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Chixia, Ally of Justice, at your service! Are you the one in need of a hero?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Whoa! You've made me so much stronger than I could have ever imagined! Now I'm finally the superhero I've always wanted to be! You've been here for me every step of the way, and you'll forever be the one I want to protect the most!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Ohhh... please have something good this time!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Yangyang's such a darling, even her words sound pretty! Sometimes I can't quite get what she says though. Whatcha call those again? Ah, poems, I think!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Speaking of Baizhi, she's not the talkative type. Don't get me wrong, she's not an Ice Queen! She just has her own ways of expressing emotions. You'll get it once you've spent enough time with her.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: She was once the thunder that lit up my path ahead. I've always wanted to be like her, until I realized not everyone had that power. Now, I am happy with being a small flicker of flame, doing what I can to help people around me.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Sometimes they'd perform <te href=850131>liondance</te> between hero plays. That leading dancer, Lingyang, can put on quite a show for a small guy like him! The way he moves and swings around really makes for an awesome lion!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: You don't talk much, but you're so strong in battle. There's a good old <te href=850093>Huanglong</te> saying, "A cat that catches mice doesn't meow." Fits perfectly on you, doesn't it?

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Isn't weird that there's only one right answer to every question? I mean, even the Woolies in my box aren't all the same. They're not all cute and cuddly. Some may even have pointy teeth! "Baa!" ...You see?

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Do you know what's under <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>' base? Aalto and the others won't ever let me go near. Are they keeping cool stuff and scary things down there?

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Cosmos said you smell full of stories, and Cloudly told me you've been to many, many places. So, here's Encore's question of the day... What does it feel like to walk at night, when there's no stars in the sky? And... how's it like to be out there in the wild, all by yourself?

speaker: Encore
anh_en: At the end of a show, everybody yells "Encore!" really loud, then the curtains open, and they play another song. That's super cool, right? So... If you're friends with Encore, your story will never come to an end!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: I've got lots of friends now, but sometimes in my dreams, I'm still all alone. Mommy's not with me anymore, and they say Cosmos and Cloudy are just my imaginary friends… Erm. C-can you hug me a little?

speaker: Encore
anh_en: What have you been up to today? Did you have fun? Saw anything cool? C'mon, spill the beans! Encore loves stories! And the feelings people share... they're like one story after another!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Mommy... will you be there in my dreams?

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Here! You can have this chocolate, and I'll take your Star Flakes! And presto! Now you have yummy chocolate, and I have chocolate-flavored Star Flakes! How's that for a deal? Psst, It's a little trade secret I got from Aalto!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Ooh… Watch out! The ghosts of food you didn't finish will crawl out of your tummy and give you bad dreams... Boo! Gotcha!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Maybe one day, Encore will go everywhere in the world and be a hero too. Hehe, but first, what's for breakfast tomorrow?

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Cosmos and Cloudy are presents from mommy. They're my best buddies! Don't worry, they're nice Woolies, they tell me lots and lots of stories!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Being happy is the bestest feeling, but it can't just be some pretend thing in a dream! Once upon a time, Encore was living in the happiest dream ever... but it had to stop, like all dreams do. Then when a dream is over, it's another brand new day ahead. Let's do our best!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: ♪Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you...♪ Mommy used to sing this birthday song on Encore's birthdays! Now, Encore is singing it just for you. Here's to a new, happy life!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: One sheep, two sheep... Three... Um? Where was I?

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Encore spent a long, long time on this! Wanna have a bite? Hehe!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Hee-hee. Hi, there! I'm Encore from <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>! Wanna go on an adventure with me and my Woolies?

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Knew it! You can't do without Encore! Off we go!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: What kinda story will Encore hear today?

speaker: Encore
anh_en: This is wicked cool! It's just like in the stories... So Encore can beat up a bad dragon now?! Yay!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Woah! Is this "Rover Magic"!? Oh no you don't, you're not going anywhere unless you tell me your secrets!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: The fire's getting warmer and prettier! Can we share it with other people? Encore wanna be a helper!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Woah, so that's how you did it! Encore's making it part of the story... You'll hear it when you've got the time.

speaker: Encore
anh_en: No one picks on Encore's friends!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Ooh, shiny! It's gotta be a dragon's treasure!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Aalto's money this and money that all day, but did you know? Sometimes he helps people for free! He just wouldn't tell me why... Hmph. Then it's up to me to find out!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Verina's flowers are grown with love! Nothing like the ones they sell in the New Federation! But some of them looked a bit wacky, like the one that gobbled down on Aalto's head and gave him a new haircut… Gotta ask her what it's called next time!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Friends in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> told me Mortefi makes lots of fun gadgets and gizmos! That's so cool! Hmm, should I ask him for a bouncy sheep next time…

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Psst. Wanna hear a secret? That strange big guy Aalto's been working with is actually... a doggy person! That's why he's a big doggy in Encore's stories!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Grown-ups like him have to wear a long face all the time, you know. See? Being a grown-up is really tough!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Miss Chixia is another one of Encore's besties! She can get a bit strict sometimes, but in a good way! You can call her when you're lost in town, she doesn't mind the extra work.

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Woah! Hey! Woolies, make some room! I wanna look, see? ...<te href=850109>Black Shores</te> member, Encore, reporting in!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: Your adventure sounds so much fun! Encore really wanna go! Promise you'll take me next time? Pinky swear!

speaker: Encore
anh_en: There has to be more. Right?

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: The Academy is working as fast as a Hoartoise. So many mysteries about you remain unanswered, yet my research proposals are still pending approval.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: As a lone traveler, there must've been times when you were taken advantage of, but couldn't retaliate on the spot. If you ever find yourself in such a situation again... do not hesitate to bring me along.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Many believe having "talent" is a blessing, but ignore the curse that comes along: someday fate might take it away, quietly. Don't take your talent for granted—make the most of it, before it's too late.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Creating and sustaining connections requires reading between the lines, and speaking words that please... Even the same words can be interpreted differently, depending on the tone and context. It's too complicated for my liking. This is why I prefer straightforward individuals... and I'm glad you are one.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: A powerful weapon can bring either justice, or devastation. The character and conviction of its wielder dictate how it's used, and that has a bearing on the judgement of those who crafted it. Now, if I entrust my works to you... to where will this decision lead me?

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Music composition follows intricate regulations, much like balancing mathematical equations. This attention to rationalism is profound in classical music. I remember reading a score that sounded beautiful even when played in reverse. The composer was able to create something so mathematically precise, yet still kept all its beauty... I couldn't help wondering how.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Scientific research is but a tool. It's not magic. People tend to have unrealistic expectations about how research works, and you wouldn't want to be one of them.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: I need an energy source to keep my brain going while I work, and sugar is the most effective choice. Candies always instantly improve my mood without leaving sticky residues on my fingers. Here, allow me to present you the Lemon Bomb, a proud work of mine. Care to have a taste?

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: It's important to take time savoring meals prepared with devotion and care, but never those shoddily manufactured instant foods; consuming them is only a disservice to my chewing muscles.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: There is an abyssal gap between "knowing" and "understanding". I once assumed I knew the suffering of people stricken by <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>, trapped in dread and hunger... After my departure from the New Federation, I realized how I wasn't even close to "understanding" any of them. Maybe there is still a gap between true understanding and what I know now; still, I must do what I can to remedy the situation, now that I am aware of it. I will create Tacetite weapons that are stronger than ever... and with that, grant humans the power to confront Tacet Discords.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Curious about this lighter? I use it to quell my temper when things get annoying. It's not about the flame that goes up in the instant; it's about the "click" it makes. Sounds nice, doesn't it? Try it yourself.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: I knew a couple of researchers from the New Federation. Their worship of technology was fanatical, and it was exactly this fanaticism that clouded their judgment. They believed technological progress was an end in itself, rather than a means for achieving something else. As creators, we must recognize exactly what we are building, and for what purpose.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Happy birthday! I spend most of my time working in the lab, but days like this are not ones I'd easily forget. Here, I have made a multi-purpose tactical belt for you. This is the fifty-plus iteration of it, with an illuminator, a thruster, an air inflation module, and more. This should suffice for most situations you may encounter in the wild. If you want other features, come find me and I'll install them for you.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: I still have much experiment data to process...

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Precision, elegance, and harmony... These are the beautiful parallels between classical music and science.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: With temperance and discipline, my flames will be kept in check.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Mortefi, researcher at Department of Safety, <te href=850092>Huaxu Academy</te>. For inquiries about Tacetite weapons, you may visit my lab. Make sure you know what you're talking about, though, before knocking at my door.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: As always, I'm the one you need... I really can't win with you, can I? Let's just get this done.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Make this quick. I have experiments underway.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Dragging me out of my lab for this...*Yawn* You better have a good reason.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Hmm... Thank you, I appreciate it. From now on, you'll have priority access to me for any deliverables you need.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: My thoughts feel sharper now... Wait, that could be an interesting concept. I should jot it down.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Such mystical power... If applied to Tacetite research, our progress will be remarkable.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Fine, since you've done this much for me... Go ahead, tell me the wildest inventions you can think of, and watch me make them happen for you.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: It was Jiyan who rescued me from the wilderness and referred me to the Academy, and I've been thankful for that... I have solved a lot of problems for him in return, of course. For example, all the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> currently use a one-piece medical kit of my design.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: That girl, I think the name is Yangyang. I hear her humming from time to time. Surprisingly, her melodies always bring my mind to peace.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Baizhi and I are almost colleagues, though we don't work in the same department. I've only interacted with her briefly on a few occasions, but I had the chance to read some of her writings. Her paper was well-thought-out and carefully expressed, featuring an intriguing perspective. If I may comment, she is an excellent scholar of <te href=850076>Remnant</te> Creatures.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Speaking of Chixia, she's a regular visitor at my lab, often bringing children along. She's a straightforward person, which I like. Besides, those who get along with kids are never bad people. Kids are incredibly perceptive of a person's true character.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: That Xiangli Yao... One day I'll outdo him, and create even better inventions!

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Quit the chit-chat. Tell me what you need and I'll make it for you, provided your descriptions are reasonable.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Come find me when you need something made. Come find me... when you don't, too. Just idling by together, listening to music and indulging in some sweets... I'll be looking forward to that, if you're here with me.

speaker: Mortefi
anh_en: Hmph... Quite good at hiding, aren't you?

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Ah, look who we have here. A rare visitor. Luckily, I've finished my work for today. Would you like to join me in a game of Weiqi, if you're not in a rush to leave?

speaker: Changli
anh_en: I seem to know a lot about your past, you say? *a small chuckle* Not really. I'd say you may have left those clues for your present self long ago, and I just happened to come across them while going through historical records. I am honored to guide you through the connections between your past and present.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: A strategist's mind is a vast and complex entity, much like the ocean. Its placid exterior may mask the turbulent currents of thought swirling within. Master once warned me to be wary of those who stay quiet in times of uncertainty. Yet with you, I find solace in the quiet moments, in our unspoken connection.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Master Xuanmiao taught me the ways of the sword, but he left this world before I could fully absorb his teachings. I have since tried my best to understand his notes and continue my training on my own. When I first saw you wield your sword, it struck a chord with me, and now I understand why. It's not that you resemble my late master in your skills, but rather that he learned from you.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: I found you and brought you out of that Sonoro Sphere. This is proof I am qualified to stand by your side and assist in achieving our shared goal. It takes great courage and wisdom to willingly enter into a situation full of unknowns, and I trust that you will achieve your desired outcome. My knowledge and power are at your disposal, always ready to help you in any way needed.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: The dynamics of a Weiqi game mirror the complexities of our world, always in a state of constant flux and transformation... Fascinating, isn't it?

speaker: Changli
anh_en: My body temperature is higher than usual because of my Flame-controlling Forte. It doesn't hinder daily tasks, but it does have its quirky consequences. Jinhsi's iced pastries and Sanhua's delicate snow birds always melt faster than I'd prefer in my hands... Sigh.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Each delicacy is unique in its own right. It's difficult to choose just one, but if I must, there was a meal I received as a hungry child, a kind gesture that left an indelible memory. That taste remains with me to this day.

speaker: Changli
anh_en:
What food do I dislike? It's not something that crosses my mind often. 
Having traveled through barren lands where people suffer from starvation, I have learned to appreciate every bit of nourishment. 
Plus, there are endless culinary delights beyond the borders of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. 
Even if I spent years exploring, I doubt I could taste them all.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: I have always dreamed of a world filled with peace and prosperity. Though I may not live to see it myself, I will do everything in my power to support those who continue to work towards that future. And when that day finally arrives, if you ever find yourself back in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, please take a moment to leave a cup of tea for me at my resting place.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: The feather I gave you before? Well, it was forged from the fires of my heart. There are only two of them. \nAs long as you hold onto that feather, my fire will never harm you. In fact, I can use it to track your whereabouts if you wish. However, if it ever falls into our enemies' hands... hehe.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Why did I quit my job in the capital and request a transfer to <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>? It's quite simple, really. After the Battle Beneath the Crescent, there was no <te href=850084>Magistrate</te> in Jinzhou and the central government couldn't just sit by and let chaos reign. Also, my master had a strong connection to Mt. Firmament. He told me it would be the very place where I would find the one I needed to look for. I didn't quite understand his intentions then, but now... well, as they say, fate works in mysterious ways.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Jinhsi is a bright and diligent soul. With time, she will undoubtedly blossom into a capable <te href=850084>Magistrate</te>. She has always been dedicated to her work, perhaps too much so. She simply needs some time to find balance and fully embrace who she truly is. I am entrusting her care to you, Rover.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Upon my initial arrival in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, I was tasked with handling paperwork at the City Hall for a temporary period. Despite sifting through countless documents and files, never once did I come across any issues regarding our border defenses. During the time when Jinzhou was lacking a <te href=850084>Magistrate</te>, General Jiyan's unwavering efforts were essential in protecting the welfare of our people.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Sanhua is always composed and silent. As a bodyguard, she remains vigilant and alert at all times. But both Jinhsi and I have always wished for her to take a well-deserved rest and let others help shoulder the burden.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Although we followed different sects of Taoist teachings, I found commonalities with her. Her pure and open mind is quite rare nowadays. I believe her perception of the world must be as clear as her eyes. I first met her at the tea house; back then, she seemed to have sensed something about my condition, and served me a bowl of Lotus Seed Soup. That was a delightful surprise.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Chixia is a vibrant girl, radiating warmth and enthusiasm like a shining flame. She graciously showed me around <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, introducing me to all the local gems and delectable delicacies. Ah, yes, now I remember... The Spicy Pulled Chicken may seem intimidating to many, but it's just the right amount of spice for me.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Happy birthday, my dear. When I was younger, I traveled to many places and saw diverse customs for celebrating birthdays, each one unique and fascinating. Here are some gift boxes for you, a small token of my affection. May you find peace and happiness in the years ahead, like the constant moon and rising sun. Oh, these may be too much? Hehe… Consider them extra gifts for your future birthdays. And if I'm still around to see them, I'll find you something different.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: The moment at hand... This very moment is the best of our lives.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: I am Changli, Counselor to the Jinzhou <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. Pleased to make your acquaintance, Rover. We meet at last. Should you ever need any assistance in Jinzhou, please let me know.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Eons of time on this vast land, all encapsulated in a humble game... \nI am fortunate to have you as my opponent.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Time to start a new game.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Plan with convention, then conquer by ingenuity.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Who will be sitting on the other side of the board this time?

speaker: Changli
anh_en: The sword has no set form, it adapts along with its foes... Likewise, strategies must shift against different opponents.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Oh? This feeling of power coursing through my veins... It feels different from before. Please, do spar with me for another round.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: After my master's passing, I spent years studying martial arts and other subjects through… various unconventional methods. This resulted in some rather comical situations, where angry bookshop owners chased me around. But now, I have the luxury of having you teach me everything without any expectations in return. It's something my younger self could only dream of.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: I never thought I could further refine my abilities. Your guidance has been invaluable, and I ought to help you in some way in return. So… Anything I can do for you?

speaker: Changli
anh_en: You've taught me more than words can express... I believed I had come to terms with my death; never thought I could one day catch a glimpse into the perspective of an eternal being. For this, I am grateful. As long as my flames still burn, I will stay by your side, dear Rover.

speaker: Changli
anh_en: Who is the caged bird now?

speaker: Changli
anh_en: No need to dwell on it.

speaker: Brant
anh_en: I've got some time today. What would you say to a nice stroll on the beach? Maybe the sea breeze and ocean sunset will inspire you!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: When sailing the seas, always remember to set your course first, and then... adapt to whatever comes your way!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: Hey, here to see our performance? Take this ticket. No need to bring anything, just a smile and a heart full of excitement. But if you insist… Well, when I step on stage, be sure to give me all the applause and cheers you've got!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: All I think about on stage is losing myself in the role—the stage becomes "my" entire world, with every light, note, and movement telling "my" story. Up there, the world is my oyster. But once I step off, I'm just a minor character in the tale of <ano=the world>Solaris</ano>.

speaker: Brant
anh_en: See that? Over there, just around the corner—that's Trattoria Margherita. Nearly everyone in our troupe has walked this alley; it's where we grew up. Out at sea, I'd wonder how <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> could turn its back on us, or what I'd do when I finally returned. I pictured a hundred things… but now, standing here, all I want is a slice of pizza... The sights and sounds of this city have always been a part of me.

speaker: Brant
anh_en: The boundless sea is the grandest stage, its towering waves our most thunderous applause! We sail with the currents and winds, hunting for cheers and laughter on every distant shore. Therefore, my friend, lift your voice and dance with abandon—for you, for me, and for every day we have lived in full!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: Here, try this wine… A bit too sweet? Haha, that's just my "Strength!" Everyone's brew tastes different, you know. Battier's has a spicy edge, Tina's is rather refreshing. This is the Troupe's Strength… a blend of everyone's life.

speaker: Brant
anh_en: For me, any food's fair game. C'mon, don't overthink it! When you're hungry enough, everything tastes amazing!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: One day, our troupe will sail to every corner of the world, and every wave will echo a shared story—the tale of <ano=Freedom>the Fools</ano>!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: Take this telescope and see for yourself… Even the highest clouds feel close enough to touch, don't they? With this gadget, you'll catch every thrill onstage and every "new world" waiting out at sea.

speaker: Brant
anh_en: Unforgettable adventures? Where to start? How about an ancient trial that spanned over a century?

speaker: Brant
anh_en: Don't be fooled by our First Mate's age—if you ever need performance advice, she's your go-to. Plus, she's also an excellent stage designer!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: She's got her course set and sticks to it, no matter what. Living as a <te href=850101>Montelli</te> is no easy path, but she's determined to make her own way. And mark my words, when her performances draw to a close, she'll be known not just as a Montelli, but Carlotta.

speaker: Brant
anh_en: Some call her a saint; others, a sinner. But who is she really? No one cares how she treats her friends or faces her foes. The Order's tales never speak of her dreams, and the legends conceal her heart's desire. Everyone has heard of Cartethyia—but does anyone know the person behind that name?

speaker: Brant
anh_en: Many wear masks to fit in, but not her. Whatever her past, whatever roles she's played, she's here now, true to herself.

speaker: Brant
anh_en: Happy birthday, my dear friend! Got any plans today? How about slipping away with me for a little adventure? I'll even let you take the helm. Here, hold on tight—together, we'll sail into the far horizon!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: Hey, little one... There you go!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: Brant's the name, captain of the <te href=850108>Fool's Troupe</te>! A pleasure to meet you, and please, call me whatever you'd like, for I'm but a humble Fool in pursuit of freedom. Enough with introductions now. Let's hand the stage over to everlasting joy and boundless liberty!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: The curtains pull back and I'm here to hunt for every laugh! Brant, at your service. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.

speaker: Brant
anh_en: The course is determined. Time to set sail!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: With this, the stage is set for a grand opening. Come on, trim the sails!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: More power... Now we're storm-proof and unstoppable! Let's go, full speed ahead!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: We're smooth sailing now. Onto the next stop... Hard to portside!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: With your strength, this massive wave is just a splash in our show! Bring it on!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: Haha! Now this is the strength worthy of a true swordsman of the seas! Join me on this voyage to the world's end, my friend! Together, we'll face that fleeting moment when the world turns upside down!

speaker: Brant
anh_en: You earned it, you keep it.

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: Ugh… I didn't expect the paparazzi to be on us during our stroll. A-actually, no, they weren't just after me, they wanted your picture too, Warrior. After all, you're a champion and the talk of the town now! But I bet you're not too keen on ending up in those gossip rags. Don't worry, I'll handle it tomorrow. Our good times are for us, and us alone!

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: Sparring with you always takes me back to my childhood. Back then, we'd fight with cardboard "weapons." No crowd, no cheers, no glory, just pure fun. Whether we won or lost, we'd always laugh and hug it out. Warrior… can I get a hug now, too?

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: You wish to try? Sure, go ahead! Here, take this comb, my assistant bought it. They say you need a whole collection for a tail like mine. Mmm… wow, you're really good at this! Even I can't run a comb through it like that... Why am I suddenly so sleepy...

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: Being apart, going solo... I remember feeling a little uneasy. Cartethyia had passed the hope to you, and you entrusted it to me. It was a fight I had to win. I wasn't afraid of failure, but I knew that someone who couldn't face failure with dignity would never truly know victory. And... I was the "protagonist" you chose, wasn't I? I couldn't let you down.

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: I have received many honors, but the championship medal I won with you is the one I cherish the most. I love this city, the land it rests on, its sights, and its people. It is a place of glory and pride, of filth and despair, but I love it all. I don't suppose you can stay in Septimont forever, this is just a small part of your journey. But for me, it will burn like fire. No matter what darkness comes next, this memory will always light my way.

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: I love going to the Septimont baths after a training session. The warm water does wonders for easing weariness. You should give it a try.

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: Every winter, my tail becomes a hive of static... Very annoying when I'm grooming...

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: A Saltimbocca made with fresh meat. I'm a Septimont traditionalist by palate, so a pinch of hot sauce is okay, but no weird sour cream. Don't be like the <te href=850097>Ragunnesi</te>!

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: The "vittles." Oh, it means food cooked exclusively by <te href=850082>Echoes</te> sans human input. All "vittles" taste very bland... Do Septimont Echoes hate seasoning?

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: I just want to enjoy the thrill of competition, win or lose. I can hear my heart pounding when I strike, weapon in hand, my cheeks burning as the crowd cheers... It's simple. Pure. No need for extra pomp or returns. The hard work, the strategy, the sacrifice... It's all worth it to feel that joy! Sticking with this for life won't be easy, but would I have to quit? Not a chance.

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: This spear? It was a gift from Domina Julia... Yeah, the same weapon I carried into my very first match in Septimont. Back then, I was just a child with "some natural talent." She spotted me in the crowd and brought me into the limelight. So, in the following years, I turned a blind eye to the outrageous contract terms, willfully ignoring the fact that she sought to use me for her own gain. I used to believe her pride would hold her back, that it would stop her from crossing the line...

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: It's now all a blur to me... the memory of being trapped in that empty city... Walls crawling with Tidal Blight, monsters prowling the streets. Everyone had vanished without a trace. It was the lowest I'd ever seen Septimont. I couldn't bear to see such hellish sights. But I told myself, "I can still hold on." I had to keep going... keep searching for a way to save this city, no matter how many times it took.

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: In that empty city, Cartethyia was there for me during my most delirious and painful moments. At first, our conversations were a bit stiff. Guess she hadn't spoken to anyone in who knows how long. But as we spent more time together, I realized that she was actually easygoing and carefree. For someone like her, being trapped in one place for so long must've been unbearable... Now that our long journey is over, I hope my friend can fully enjoy this moment of peace.

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: Whenever I watch videos of the Ephor's past fights, I do wonder if she stepped into the arena for political reasons, or-or to prove herself. Whatever her reason, Augusta's rise to power was a good thing for Septimont. Change is always toughest at the beginning. And for that, I have respect for her.

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: I rarely visit the Temple to pray for revelations, so I can't say I know the Priestesses well. But I do like Iuno. Many of the nobles can't stand her unconventional ways, but I find her boldness entertaining. Don't you?

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: A spirited, nimble girl... That's my impression of her. Once, I saw her sprint along the narrow bricks at the top of the high wall and leap onto a statue like a cat. No clue who was chasing her, but I cheered loudly along with everyone else at the foot of the wall!

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: Many Gladiators of the Blue Furies come from the <te href=850108>Troupe of Fools</te>. I remember once, at Cliffside Harbor, I saw their captain leap off the deck just to hug his crew. They chattered on for a while, and then suddenly broke into song...!

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: When I first saw the footage of Contender Mya, I was merely impressed by her raw, unfiltered determination. At the time, my team had some problems, and my teammates accused me of not understanding what it felt like to be left behind. Normally, I'd brush it off, but the sounds of sorrow grew louder and started to weigh on me. Strength, weakness, winning, losing... I began to question if I had only made it through by luck. But Mya has shown me the answer with her whole life. Victory is about giving everything you've got.

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: Happy birthday, Fellow Warrior! Hahaha, did I scare you? How could I ever forget your special day? I've already set up a party at the Leonidas Hotel—whenever you return to Septimont, I'll be there waiting. Now, look out the window! These fireworks are for you. We Septimontians know how to put on a show, thanks to all the contests and celebrations we throw. Okay, let's kick things off with a cup of wheat juice! No? Seriously? Alright, fine. Then close your eyes and make a wish.

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: In my previous match, I slipped and left an opening, but my opponent failed to notice. He gradually lost his advantage... and here, he started to panic, until... I knocked him down with a single blow!

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: Lupa, Gladiator of Septimont. Just ignore the attention, Warrior. This victory is ours to savor!

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: Oh, is a new match calling?

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: Awesome! I'll record our training and savor every detail of it.

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: Do I look overexcited? Because in truth, I am. All I want is to keep sparring with you.

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: More... Get me more... One more round, Warrior! I want a rematch!

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: As we advance from one battle to the next, do you ever feel tired? I want to become stronger, wiser, and better. I want to be someone who's got your back, to be your... most trusted Fellow Warrior.

speaker: Lupa
anh_en: Does the Vale of Glory await me?

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: <te href=260005>Chimera</te> feeds on my soul. To replenish what he takes, I hunt <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> for their frequencies. Even without a pact, he would still find a way to take from me. So I made a choice. Not to resist, but to become part of him. Only flames survive flames. Now, forged in hellfire, this body burns even brighter. As for Chimera and the other Tacet Discords who thought they were so tough? They must learn to live in my fire.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: An incarnate of hellfire, fed on demons, commanding the power of the <te href=851023>Dark Tide</te>. This is who I am. Will you fear me… or scorn me? They call my power a curse, an ancient omen of darkness. But I call it something else—an oath. I know what I have to do. And no matter how the world may judge me, I will see it through to the very end.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Many call me "Galbrena," and I've grown used to it. It's the name of my second life. Hey, if it gets the job done, I don't mind it. But Angel... that name has always stayed with me. It was given to me by my parents, outcasts from Ragunna who hoped I'd grow into it one day. Since then, I've crossed many lands, seen my share of "monsters and demons"... but never angels. They say angels exist to fight devils. And where an angel goes, danger follows. They may not look like people think. Sometimes they scare you. Sometimes they warn you. If that's what an angel is… maybe I have lived up to that name after all. So tell me. What do you see?

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Along my journey, I've stopped a lot of tragedies... and watched just as many unfold, both natural and man-made. This world isn't always beautiful. And that's exactly why the bonds we make in it feel all the more precious. Like you, I load my gun for the ones who never made it home. I wasn't the first. And I won't be the last.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: The showdown between me and <te href=260005>Chimera</te> will come, sooner or later. If the worst happens that day... then I want you to hunt me. Heh, don't worry. I never said I'd let Chimera win. Besides, I've got one more reason to win now.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: The sky offers a wide, unbroken view. From up there, I see everything—prey included. The moment they slip up, I strike, swift and silent. There's something... in watching from above. Keeps me away from crowds, too... I bring fear only when it's called for.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en:
Galbrena: I can keep <te href=260005>Chimera</te> in check most of the time… but the second I'm distracted, he always finds a way to—
Chimera: You never talk this much to anyone else.
Galbrena: …Like that. I speak more when the person doesn't grate on me.
Chimera: You talk to me often. Do I count?
Galbrena: First of all, you don't count as a "person."
Chimera: Then just admit it—even you fear being alone.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Sorbet, shaved ice, gelato… they're pretty much the same. The hellfire inside me never dies down. Cold things help keep it in check. But an added bit of sweetness works even better.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: At first, I "ate" <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> just to survive. But now, I hunt them for power... They don't count as food? Well, if we're talking about food in the usual sense, I can stomach anything on the table.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Live well. Die right. That's how I see it. And if there really is an afterlife, where I get to see "them" again… I want to face them with pride. To say I lived fully. Fought for what I believed in. Died with meaning. No regrets, nothing unfinished. But until my flame burns out, I'll keep crossing death, again and again. And when it's time... I'll offer whatever spark is left, and gladly embrace the end.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: I was born in Septimont. It taught me how to fight, and to this day, I still trust in that. But most weapons don't hold up against the <te href=851023>Dark Tide</te>. Its corruption gets in deep, eats them from the inside out. For a long time, I fought Tacet Discords bare-handed. Then I got my hands on these guns. Took a hell of a fight to pry them out of <te href=260005>Chimera</te>'s jaws. He'd been hoarding them the whole time.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: You've seen what I was in the Dark Tide. As for what came after, it was just hunt or be hunted. I fell, I got back up, again and again, until the hunt ended. Then I'd brush the embers off my shoulders just like this, and move onto the next hunting ground. Met different people. Saw different things. Oh, and sometimes... I'd stop to find a place to grab ice cream.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Augusta... she was my childhood friend. Back then, I'd usually sit quietly under a tree, lost in my own thoughts. She'd be off swinging her sword, shouting about becoming the next Hero of Heroes. She loved dragging me into sparring matches... We'd often end up scuffling into the <te href=260006>Fabianum</te> rivers, and when we got tired, we'd lie on the riverbank letting the cool water soak us completely. Now... time has changed a lot. But thankfully, not all of it for the worse. Augusta became exactly the kind of ruler Septimont needed.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: It was through the <te href=851023>Dark Tide</te>'s memory that I first learned of her. I never saw her as anyone's Resonator, and in return, she gave me a reply that was... wild, reckless, but resolute. A knight of justice shouldn't be sealed away in a tower. The nightmare Leviathan cast upon her lasted far too long… But now that <te href=850096>Rinascita</te> has emerged from the darkness, she too should be free to embrace her own dawn.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: <te href=850109>The Black Shores</te>' database needs constant updates, and I send captured Tacet Discord data back like clockwork. I don't visit the base much, so Aalto is the one who always helps handle my performance check-ins. Of course, he never signs off on anything that doesn't benefit him. That's why half the data I send ends up counted as his work.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: While hunting in the New Federation, we had our eyes on the same Tacet Discord. His goal was to eliminate it. Mine was to absorb it. There were some misunderstandings along the way, but overall, it was a smooth collaboration. He actually invited me to join his mercenary group. Pack hunting is indeed important to survival, but... I'm just used to working alone.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Happy birthday. Instead of saying, "Congrats on escaping another year in time's hunt," I'd rather say, "Here's to happy hunting in the time you've got." Here, this necklace is for you. Think of it as a talisman. It holds every story I've lived through. The plain metal badge once saved me when I was shot in the heart. The seashell comes from a lost civilization. You can still hear its echoes if you listen close. And this "tear" of glass, forged in fire and shed from a war machine... There's a lot more. If you want, I can tell you all about them. Next year, I'll even bring some new charms to add.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: <te href=260005>Chimera</te>: Ah, a fresh delicacy...\nGalbrena: Back off.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena. The Fiend of Ever-burning Flame. The Discord Slayer. Call me what you want. Just point me to the monsters.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena. Ready to join the hunt.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: An unusual way to gain strength... thanks.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: ...You didn't need to do this just for my power.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Hah... what now? Trying to make a pact with the "devil"?

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: My path is mine alone. It's long. Perilous. No light. No company. I won't always be around… And the "devil" will want its pound of flesh. For a pact this unfair... Are you sure you can accept it?

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: This blood... let it drip into your palm. There. Now our "pact" is sealed.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena: Fight fire with fire.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: Let strength speak!

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena: Tainted hellfire.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: Devour them all!

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena: Explode.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: To hell with you!

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena: By my trigger... enter hell's gates!\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: Scorched to ash!

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena: The hunt ends here.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: Time to gorge!

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena: I've come... to send you to your grave.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: A fresh feast!

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena: I'll show you...\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: The gates of hell!

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena: ...Again.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: Pain sharpens your mind.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena: …Just a scratch.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: No time to lick your wounds.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena: ...Very well.\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: Your fury begins to stir.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena: ...Till my last breath!\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: This hunt shall never end!

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena: Through death...\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: ...We will return.

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena: The flames... never die...\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: We... will not retreat...

speaker: Galbrena
anh_en: Galbrena: Gift-wrapped prey?\n<te href=260005>Chimera</te>: Satisfy my hunger.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: I graduated from the Department of Exostrider Engineering at <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te>, and my senior thesis was "The Correlation Analysis Between Energy Output Management and Exoswarm Material Renewal." The proposal caught the attention of the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>, which further developed it into the "New Solar Ceremony" project.
