The content specified in my paper involves utilizing multi-phase energy conversion modules through a superconductor network...\n\n...Sorry, I'll try my best to find topics that may interest you in the future.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en:
So, which flavor of Midnight Wonder Cup Noodles do you prefer? Lichen Salad or Creamy Bisque?

My post-lecture observation shows it's the second most-discussed topic amongst students, right after "what to highlight in class." So I thought, since you're now a student here at Startorch, you might be interested in this.

Wait, apologies. I don't have any Midnight Wonder Cup Noodles with me, only supplements... But we can go buy a few at the Academy, if you'd like. Shall we?

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: My legs? They're prosthetics developed by the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>. Before having the surgery, I had to rely on a wheelchair due to a condition called Congenital Hypoplasia of the Lumbosacral Plexus.\n\nI don't really remember much from those days. The empty home, the quiet classroom, the pain of falling from my wheelchair... I know they were all part of my life. But the feelings are just... forgotten. Sometimes, I wonder... is this why I can't make sense of some of the feelings in my heart?

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: I'm conducting a field research to verify some engineering hypotheses, and I'd like you to be my colleague for the day.\n\n...Oh, don't misunderstand. All the permits are in order and the location is entirely safe. You don't need to act as my security. This is a project on <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>'s frontier technology. My project. I wish to... introduce you to it.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en:
<te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>'s Sky Projection Array recreates starry skies from the ancient records. The brightest white mass close to the zenith is Apus Alpha, an A-type main-sequence star. To its right are the Crux's binary stars, locked in their mutual gravitational dance. Slightly above them are the polar stars, Vulpecula Delta, and the Scorpius Cluster...

No, don't look at me. Please keep looking at the sky. Over the years at Lahai-Roi, every time I look up at this sky, I'm reminded of the dream to reach the stars... and the ineffable emptiness I feel.

There are words I never got to say under the stars, many years ago... I'd like you to hear them now.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: I came across a paper a few days ago from Huanglong's Huaxu Academy, titled "Peridynamics-Based Analysis of Tacetite Microstructure Evolution and Precipitation Behavior." That's 167 pages of intellectual brilliance. Reading it gave me a profound sense of satisfaction.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: Sometimes, I find myself puzzled by the students' logic. For instance, we have very clear rubrics for grading final exams. Why, then, would they ask me to "go easy on them"? The rules are the rules. I can't simply bend them…

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: The "Instant Wakeup Energy Gel Sachet" developed by the Division of Ecology Conservation. It manages to keep over 95% of the ingredients' energy. A real triumph of ingenuity for the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>.\n\n...How does it taste? I quite enjoy it myself. You can taste the entire ingredient list in a single bite. Very efficient.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: Anything that takes too much work to eat... simply because it's a hassle.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en:
Long before humanity was born, the stars were already there. When we gaze up at their radiance, we're seeing only a fragment of time, cast across the depths of the universe.

Yet, small as we may be, we dare to dream of crossing that vast gulf of space. With our fleeting forms, we challenge that ancient silence. We will prove that the beyond is not unreachable, and that one day, we will touch the stellar seas ourselves.

That is the future I wish to reach... together, with everyone.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: These prosthetic legs incorporate the latest medical technology from the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>. Furthermore, they can be modified by my Resonance ability. I've added features like quick levitation, Overclock indicators, emergency heating, and night lighting... When it comes to functionality, the more the better. Wouldn't you agree?

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: The paralysis in my legs had minimal impact on my theoretical research. As a result, during my schooling back home, I immersed myself entirely in reading, learning, studying theories, and writing papers. This way, I would make myself feel better, to feel that I was... a person of value, just like everyone else.\n\nAnd no, I'm not sad about it. I see now that it was all worthwhile. Every bit of it.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: I wish to be like her, having the freedom to do what she wants. To act without constraint. Especially the constraint of a class schedule. It's a pity that professors are forbidden to skip their own lectures…

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: She's a remarkably conscientious student, but her persistence can sometimes be wasteful.\n\nFor instance, she will fill the exam questions with unrelated formulas when she doesn't know the answers. It won't get her points.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: You'll see her at every public lecture, nodding along as if she understands every word. Until she inevitably dozes off, jolts awake after bumping her head on the seat, and then drifts off again... I only later discovered that students receive credit solely for attendance.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: When I was a student, I frequented the infirmary. Dr. Herssen had me take a medicine imported from the New Federation that would only take effect if I went to bed before 10 P.M. A month passed, and my health improved. It wasn't until later that I found those medicines were just ordinary <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te> plant-based milk...

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: The freshman girl who vanished in the <te href=851070>Void Storm</te>... I remember the incident clearly. It happened during my first year as a teaching assistant at the Academy. I even graded a paper she submitted. It was exceptionally well-written, with a logical structure, rigorous analysis, and precise formatting.\n\nNow, she's become the student who writes the best papers in my class.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en:
I'm aware that today is your birthday.

On a macroscopic scale, the universe dictates that entropy will forever increase, time is a one-way flow, and all existence is destined for heat death. A birthday, then, is a coordinate we set for ourselves. It's proof that however small we may be, we can still create and preserve a tiny structure of order against the torrent of chaos.

This is all knowledge I "understand" intellectually. Yet when I'm by your side, I stop thinking about them.

Looking into your eyes, the only thing I "feel"... is the simple joy of sharing this day with you.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: I am Mornye, Research Institute engineer and professor at <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te>. Please, let me know when my expertise can be of service.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: I need not wait for a starry night, nor tilt my gaze to seek the sky. For I have placed it at my back, in my hands, and upon my eyelids.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: Now, I can walk beside you.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: Calculation results... Sorry, I'm on my way.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: Constructing reality mapping for accumulated theories. Rest assured, I'm quite proficient at this.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: Variable parameters, empirical data, potential probabilities... I'll take all of these into consideration to improve our efficiency.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: Your influence has... catalyzed a change in me. Does this progress please you?

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: This takes me back to my first journey to the frostlands. Wind and snow stung my cheeks. It was the first time I felt alive, after a lifetime in a wheelchair. Thank you for bringing that feeling back to me... once again.

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: I don't... want to disappoint you...

speaker: Mornye
anh_en: A finding with some practical value.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: How did I come up with the name Fleet Snowfluff? Totally random! It just popped into my head while I was registering a domain for my site. But hey, I did go all out on that digital Snowfluff Seal design! My fans even turned it into official merch, and the price on these in the marketplace is through the roof! Crazy how my merch just flies off the shelf, even when I'm long gone.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: In the depths of the <te href=851070>Void Storm</te>, sometimes I catch that "eye" staring back at me, with all its void and craving for death, senseless and silent. This is the perilous world the students of Startorch long to explore. From one prodigy to the next, they go on their trek for the truth like moths to flames. Do I see myself among them? Haha, how would I know? I'm just a student going through my sentimental phase.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: I remember how you used to tell me stories on stormy nights like this, when memories of my parents' disappearance glared awake in me. You'd hold my hand until I fell asleep. The warmth from your palm quieted down my fears. I used to love your stories for their twists and turns, danger and thrills—until it dawned on me they were from your own experiences. And then I told myself, "I don't want to hear these stories anymore. All I want… is for you to live safe and happy."

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: When I learned the truth about you, the first thing I felt was anger. The more warmth you showed me, the more my hatred grew toward the things that caused you pain. I was furious, wishing I could cut apart those wretched things like you showed me. It's only been a few decades since I became a ghost, but it's become increasingly difficult to keep the loneliness at bay. To think that... the endless time that flowed through you—You came to this world in solitude, do you intend to depart in that way, too?

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: I know being a savior isn't as glorious as it sounds. The title is too heavy to bear and only the bigheaded would say otherwise. But still, I want to be someone who protects this world. It's such a great burden, but it might be easier if you let someone shoulder it with you. So, I'll be bigheaded. And I'll walk beside you, down the same path you've always walked, until the tomorrow you longed for finally dawns.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: My hobbies usually don't stick around for long. I get along with everyone at the Academy, so I often help out with their club activities—it's a great way to try all sorts of things. If I have to say... It's more the buzz of getting together that I enjoy rather than the activities themselves. It's all about living "a carefree, happy life," isn't it?

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: A classmate from <te href=850093>Huanglong</te> once taught me a local saying: "Nothing but death is worth a moment's thought." It's true—death put everything in perspective. What troubled me in the past looks trivial now. Aside from protecting the world, the only thing I still worry about… is you.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Students at <te href=851069>Startorch</te> come from all over the world, and many bring along special delicacies and recipes from their hometowns. Food review posts are always trending on the Academy Forum, and if you ask me, I'm always up for trying out the latest food fad!

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Nope. As long as it's food, me likey. Though… I don't really need to eat anymore, haha.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Exostrider Armament: Main system to be rebooted.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: I'm faster in my mech, you know?

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: I want to be like you—to become the savior.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Treasure chests! Ahh, the essential RPG experience—

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Don't mind if I take these.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Actually, I'm better at popping digital locks.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: I designed the mech based on the <te href=700008>Exostrider</te>'s operating codes. Being a digital ghost means I can merge into its control system. So, it sort of looks like it's on autopilot once I'm inside. I've stored part of my computational power inside its body, so it can fight alongside me whenever I need support. Gotta make the most of being a digital ghost, right?

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Exostrider Armament: Warning, insufficient power supply.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: To stop the <te href=850074>Threnodian</te> from breaking the seal, I resonated with the <te href=700008>Exostrider</te> in the cockpit. My body was torn apart in excruciating pain, but my mind was alight with an almost blissful thrill. I'd always tried to follow your advice, to live as an ordinary, happy student. But at that moment, your words no longer bound me. I could finally do what I'd always wanted—to save the world. Haha… what a foolish, arrogant, greedy dream I had. And yet, look at me. I actually made it come true.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: The first time I met Professor Mornye was when you took me to the Academy, right before you left <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>. She was your junior back then, sitting quietly in her wheelchair, always stealing glances at you. Every time she tried to speak to you, she'd instinctively bury her head into those papers in her hand before she could utter a word. Urgh, the spell you obliviously cast by being gentle to everyone you meet. Works every time.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Dr. Luuk is kind and competent, admired by many students. But he wasn't always this way. He used to carry a constant tension, as if bracing for battle at any moment. Perhaps the change came when you invited him to <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>. Offering his service at the Academy gradually taught him to trust and allowed him to finally feel the warmth of sunlight again.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: On nights filled with your sighs, I used to sneak near your desk, catching snippets of your conversations with her. Shorekeeper… yes, that's her name. Whenever you talked with her, the weight in your breath would lift. I think she must be the one who's been watching over you, offering solace and quiet comfort.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: I used to chase <te href=700022>Exoswarm</te> across the frostlands with Camellya! She's really good at gaming, too. Ha, I wish we could gather for a rematch someday. But I found out she actually slipped away from <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> on her last visit while she was supposed to be recuperating. She came all the way just to check on you, only to leave without a word, when she saw that you were okay. Camellya's health has always been a bit unstable, so make sure to check on her whenever you can, alright?

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: For years after becoming a digital ghost, I would journey to the frostlands just to see it. It always stood there—silent, motionless in the snow—and I would stand beside it, quietly watching. At a time before the dawn of <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>, what made it decide to take out its <te href=700010>Reactor Drive</te> to illuminate this land? <te href=700008>Exostrider</te>… you came from the same place. So how… why did you make that choice?

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Look what I got you—a limited Snowfluff Seal cake! Isn't it just the cutest thing ever? Haha, finally, I get to celebrate your birthday in this cabin again. Birthday, huh… I wonder if back where you came from, they had any fun celebrations for you. I hope they did! Okay, all candles are lit. Close your eyes and make a wish! I wish that all your wishes come true, and that I get to sing you happy birthday every year from now on. Please remember this: no matter how far you go, your family's here to give you support and love. Forever and always.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Give it a try? Like this. Here.\nIt flew so far! Impressive!

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Exostrider Armament: Running self-diagnosis.\nAemeath: Mm, all systems green.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Aemeath, <te href=700009>Synchronist</te> of the <te href=700008>Exostrider</te> from Rabelle College. That was me back when I was alive. Now? I'm a digital ghost!

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: I destroy all that seeks destruction.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: May this strength help the <te href=700008>Exostrider</te> keep watch over <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te> for ages to come.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: When you can't reason with the bad guys, let your weapons do the talking! That's why I've been working on new laser beam arrays!

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: You taught me well, but I've added a few creative twists to your technique. Now's the perfect time to test it out!

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: I hope I'm strong enough to walk beside you now. It's good to have someone to follow and rely on, but I want more than that. Just like you once protected me… it's my turn to protect you.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Aemeath: Lightshow of the finale, fire!\nExostrider Armament: Order confirmed.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Aemeath: Hero's on, lights up!\nExostrider Armament: Limelights checked.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Aemeath: The world is mine to guard!\nExostrider Armament: Objective logged.

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Blade cleaves the night. Perils, purged in light!

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Souls sing in harmony. To the savior's victory!

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Starlight over the seas. Scorch through the Void!

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Exostrider Armament: Lightwings activated.\nAemeath: Stars shine tonight!

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Exostrider Armament: Cluster cannon ready.\nAemeath: The savior rises!

speaker: Aemeath
anh_en: Exostrider Armament: Body limit unlocked.\nAemeath: The savior rises!

speaker: Denia
anh_en: What's so bad about a pretty illusion? Even an empty gift box is still nice to look at, right? Since people only believe the "truth" they want to believe, maybe the real truth isn't all that important. If the world is made of little lies to begin with, why be afraid of all the deception in our lives?

speaker: Denia
anh_en: So, how've you been sleeping? I heard if you get enough rest, you wake up refreshed and happy every single day. Haha... Must be nice, I wouldn't know. But sleeping itself is nice, I think. After all, every time I drift off, it feels like a death rehearsal.\nSo... if falling asleep feels like a kindness, then maybe death isn't really all that scary, right?

speaker: Denia
anh_en: You seem so sweet and dependable on the outside, but deep down… you're always a little guarded... What? Got fooled too many times that now it's just a reflex? Poor thing, that's got to be tiring. Well, it's not like I have anything to hide from you. So maybe, every now and then, you could try trusting me.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: I used to think the world was rotten right down to its core. Like everything was hopeless. Meaningless. And I never believed any of the things the Spacetrek Collective likes to say. I mean, if life is such a gift, then why do babies cry the moment they're born? It's like they're scared, like they already know. They know it all just goes back to the Void, back to darkness. But... whenever someone holds my hand and shares their heart with me, I can feel that annoying warmth again. It feels real. It coaxes me. Tries to show me happiness might actually be real... Ha. What a joke.

speaker: Denia
anh_en:
Even now, I still believe the Void is unbeatable.
For most people, suffering has an end. They live their lives, close their chapters, and get their happy ending.
But you? Where does your suffering end? Not in any future that I can see, at least.
Still, if you do end up in the Void one day, don't panic... Because somewhere inside all that nothingness, I'll be there.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: I'm a total sucker for those obscure lectures from sweet professors, plus anything warm and sugary... Oh, and those reference books that make zero sense. They help me pass out so much faster! You get it, right? It's impossible to get good sleep at home.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: Well, the side effects aren't as bad now, but I'd give anything for Aleph-1 to just stop mumbling nonsense in my head.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: A birthday cake, of course. The kind with tons of fresh fruit and way too much whipped cream. And candles on top, for sure... Why? Because I've never actually had one before.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: I hate eating anything raw! Especially that fancy sliced meat on a platter.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: Good sleep, good food, and... good friends together. Every single day.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: People keep asking why I don't wear the uniform... Well, the whole point of the Academy uniform is its Voidmatter protection, right? But guess what the Academy has my Forte registered as? "Capable of creating bubbles that can isolate Voidmatter and offer protection." Hehe, surprise, surprise.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: It was just... a lot of time in a dim room. Surgeries. Performance tests. Over and over... Nothing but bad memories, really. But I did like that little garden outside my room. True, they were just plants that grew under the Voidmatter's influence, but they had these colors... Unique and beautiful.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: I find myself wondering... how nice would it be if Sigrika were just an ordinary girl?\nWithout all that weight on her shoulders.  They say you eventually have to pay for being innocent, but what did the kind and pure ever do to deserve that? The world can be so cruel. It punishes the kindest people and calls it "growth." Like that makes any sense.\nBut through it all, Siggy has never been afraid... She really is amazing.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: That miko from <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te> is so powerful. Like she's cheating, you know? Yeah, I'd heard the stories before. But facing that power myself was a whole different story.\nShe wasn't exactly what I pictured, though. Beyond all that strength and the gentleness you can tell right from her face, there's something else, almost... clinging to her. Something that won't wash away. Loneliness... or maybe regret?\nIf growing stronger really comes with a price, I wonder… what has she given up to get this power?

speaker: Denia
anh_en: She was one of the few Overseers in the Fractsidus who would talk to me. When I was floating in the Voidmatter pod, she'd even play the violin for me. I really enjoyed her music. It's just... I never figured out how someone who could make such beautiful melodies... would ever want to help a maniac like the Grand Architect.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: Professor Mornye fits every idea I've ever had of a perfect teacher: She has a soft voice, a sweet heart, she knows her stuff inside and out, and her classes are seriously intense. And the best part? She never, ever calls on me to answer questions when I'm napping in her class! Although... it might also be that no one has ever dared to sleep in her class before.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: She's the legendary Fleet Snowfluff, right? I totally recognized her back in <te href=750040>Voidspace</te>.\nThe Academy's former beloved star—even the toughest professors still talk about her after all these years. Plus, she still holds the top score on every single machine at the Mind Dive Arcade! Honestly, if you want your classmates to trust you, all you have to do is try to act like her... Her charm is seriously next level.\nSpeaking of which... you must be really proud of her, huh? Make sure you protect her well this time. Don't ever lose her again.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: Seriously? You picked me to celebrate your birthday with you? But your cake does look pretty good... Mind if I steal a bite?\nHaha, just kidding. This is your big day, huh? Happy birthday!\nI sincerely wish that, as you journey forward, your heart stays full of happiness, and that nothing—no matter how absurd or painful—ever truly defeats you.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: Better start running. Oh? You actually got away. Hmph, lucky for you.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: One. Two. Three. Four… A bit off, maybe?\nFi-five! No!

speaker: Denia
anh_en: Now, a volunteer from the audience...\nWant me put you down? Well, since you asked nicely… Hehe.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: Surprised to see me? Haha, relax. I told you we'd meet again.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: Shh... Keep this between us, will you?

speaker: Denia
anh_en: Fighting alongside you? Okay, that's new.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: I'm not much of a fighter... Can I just slack off?

speaker: Denia
anh_en: It feels like I can control more Voidmatter now. Hmm... Getting stronger is always a good thing, right?

speaker: Denia
anh_en: So you just need more power? I see... But to borrow my power? That's far too risky.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: Be careful. I can feel it, Aleph-1... It never really left.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: You knew the risks, and yet... you still came this far. You are just... impossible. Always. But thanks to you, I can stabilize Voidmatter now. It's a bit embarrassing to say, but... I think I want to use this power to protect everyone.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: Existence is meaningless. Life is meaningless. We are meaningless. And thinking about this meaningless world is meaningless too—or so Aleph-1 says. But meaningless as I am, I can still hear my own heartbeat. I can still hear the laughter we shared... And now, I believe some things are real. Maybe that's how it's always been: I'm more afraid of being alone than I ever was of the void.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: It's okay to fly sometimes, I guess.

speaker: Denia
anh_en: Can I trade these for desserts?

speaker: Denia
anh_en: Make sure no one sees it.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: Misconceptions about us abound. Violence is just one tool in our arsenal, not our sole means to an end. Cooperation is our usual aim, but in a world of betrayal and deception, we must make sure backstabbing us is never worth the risk. To maintain efficient cooperation, we demand an ironclad contract with consequences... and that's where necessary violence comes in play.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: You're quite good with your sword, but in a world like this, fighting alone will not suffice. Picture this: a single hound may not scare you, but what about a pack? Fear creeps in as you're trapped alone, with no one to guard your back, surrounded by enemies on all fronts. They aren't leaving without blood. Strength comes in numbers... Keep that in mind.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: As a leader, one must excel in the art of deception, projecting an image of unwavering composure and offering false reassurance... Every decision you make could change lives. If a day comes when you are in charge of other people, or even the entire world, what choices will you make? Will you bear the weight of their fate, or prioritize your own desires above all else?

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: You've done your homework on us, it seems. As mercenaries, we take on any job and always deliver... The pay is our only concern. Wherever war and chaos go, the Ghost Hounds will follow. We exist, because there is always demand for our service. How do you perceive us? Though I couldn't care less about others' opinions... I'm open to your thoughts.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: Someday, I may need your aid. If my actions steer the Ghost Hounds off course, I'll count on you to right my wrongs... or put an end to my existence. For now, I am happy to enjoy our current alliance.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: Search, rescue, transportation, recon, group combat... Dogs are loyal and skilled in many ways. Me? I don't keep dogs. It's too dangerous... for the dogs, that is.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: Hopefully, my guys aren't stirring up too much trouble back at the base...

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>'s emergency rations. They taste slightly better than those made elsewhere.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: ...Out in the wild, food preferences don't matter. I only care about what's edible.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: Humans or <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>, I'll eradicate any danger to the Ghost Hounds. It is my sole focus to protect my people, and secure any form of momentary respite when I can.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: The deaths of our kind are likely to go unnoticed. It's our destiny—fleeting, like dust in the wind. Each of us bears a dog tag with our name and story etched upon it, as a form of legacy... A symbol of our existence, no less than a declaration of it.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: In the Underworld, it's all about survival of the fittest. Either you dominate as the apex predator, or you're doomed to be devoured by those above you. It's the brutal law of the land. In a world where might makes right, we must rise to the very top to remain free from others' schemes, and preserve our autonomy.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: He's a capable leader. He once recommended me an ancient tome on the art of war from <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, one that I regret not acquiring sooner—it could have saved me some effort. As for the deal between us... *scoff* It was merely an exchange of interests. Nothing more.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: Pretentious, arrogant, and self-absorbed... That man epitomizes every trait associated with those snooty New Federation nobles. That said, I cannot deny his talent in crafting Tacetite Weapons. I can arrange a meeting with our trusted arms dealer, if he's interested.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: Need to reach Aalto? Here's his contact. Mention my name for a twenty percent discount.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: Yinlin? That undercover agent who infiltrated my group? *huff* Easy there. I didn't give her a hard time, provided she always stayed in her lane.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: I met her once. A prodigy in the field of botany at such a young age... Impressive.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: Happy birthday. Is there anyone or anything bothering you? On this special day, I can offer my services at a discounted price to help rid you of your problems.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: Calcharo, leader of the Ghost Hounds Mercenary Group. I suppose you've heard about what we do. Don't worry, your safety as my client will be guaranteed until the job is done.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: You should have the payment ready by now.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: Curious you'd want me to join you in person...

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: Let's see if the gains will be worth the effort.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: This power you just gave me... Do you always trust others so easily?

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: ...Your kindness, I have certainly received. Naturally, I'll work for you in return.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: Follow our rules and never betray us. As long as I'm alive, the name "Ghost Hounds" should command enough respect to grant you free reign over the continent.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: *amused huff* Impressive, you've got a much bigger ambition than I thought. The offer you made is too enticing to ignore... Very well. I will repay you with my unwavering loyalty.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: I owe you a debt that cannot be easily repaid. The Ghost Hounds have their stance to maintain, and I cannot make decisions for my people lightly. However, I am willing to accept this "contract"... on my own terms. Speak, and your wish will be granted, no questions asked.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: Let slip the dogs of war!

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: The loot we find is not part of my pay. It's all yours.

speaker: Calcharo
anh_en: I trust you can use it to the full.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: Perhaps you haven't noticed, but you seem to always draw in some... rather interesting people. Not sure if it's a blessing or a curse for you, but it certainly makes my job easier... *chuckle* After all, my targets are usually the more peculiar types.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: Contrary to what you may believe, many crimes are motivated by love and responsibility. Ironic, isn't it? The two fundamental values of human society can also lead to its downfall. When love becomes all-consuming and responsibility turns into obsession, crimes find fertile ground to thrive.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: I've seen what you're capable of, so I'm not worried about you in a fair fight. That being said, not everyone plays fair. Just watch your back out there... wouldn't want you to get caught off your game.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: The Fractsidus... You've dealt with them before, correct? Though we still don't know their origins or motives, I do know one thing from experience—criminals are most dangerous when we don't understand their intentions. You may run into them again anytime, so stay vigilant.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: Being a secret agent means constantly adapting to new identities. When the situation calls for it, I'm ready to shed any of my current personas and slip into a new one. But with you, perhaps I can just be myself, Yinlin... and no one else. It doesn't feel awful... to have someone who knows and remembers me for who I truly am.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: Speaking of the puppet show... It's an old tradition in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, though not as popular here as in other places. Dollmaker taught me the tricks to help me manipulate my own puppet better. More importantly, it's a useful way to hide in plain sight while performing. I can teach you a move or two, if you're interested.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: Lately, it seems I've been "running into" you a lot lately... Just a heads up, I like to stay under the radar, and being seen with someone as high profile as you tends to attract unwanted attention... *pause, sigh* Not that I don't want to see you, but you'll need to be more subtle than that.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: I've tried many so-called delicacies through my job, but none has left a lasting impression like the plate of Aureate Fried Rice I once had. I believe it's not the fancy ingredients that make a dish truly special, but the skill and care put into its preparation.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: Dining with a target requires always catering to their taste. When the food is subpar, I know how to choke it down with a grin. That's why there isn't any dishes I truly dislike... It's not the food that ruins a meal, but the company. With you by my side, I suppose I'd be pleased to eat anything.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: A utopia free of all vices and crimes may sound tempting, but once you think about it, it is nothing more than a naïve dream. That's why we exist—to uncover the hidden and unapproachable darkness that the majority refuse to acknowledge, and do the dirty work in their place.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: This puppet? I call it Zapstring. It used to be a basic puppet made by some novice, but I've revamped it for battle. It hasn't let me down yet, despite its wear and tear.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: Members of the Séance Society were lured in by Dollmaker's false promises, but they too must bear responsibility for what had transpired. I can only hope that upon their release, they will break from the illusions of the past... Despite the loss of loved ones, life must continue.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: Happy birthday... What's with that look? Come on, I promise it's really your special day. And no, I'm not playing any games this time. Oh well. I can already tell you have nothing planned, so... Will you let me have you all to myself, for the entire day?

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: No rush. The impatient ones will fall right into our lap.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: Name's Yinlin. As for what I do... Shhh, we don't talk about that in public.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: Anything you need me to deal with?

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: So we're teaming up? Fine, though I'm more used to fighting alone.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: Good. That did make me stronger... Should I start thinking about how to repay you?

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: For us undercover agents, fighting skills are just the bare minimum. The key to success is having an unbreakable will.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: I have finer control over Zapstring now. It's all credit to you.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: I will make good use of this power and fight by your side... We'll confront evil, wherever it lies.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: Good. There's no time to waste.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: I guess you can say Chixia is a younger colleague of mine. She is a natural fit for the <te href=850087>Patroller</te> position. With time and experience, she will surely excel in her role.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: Being skilled as a <te href=850087>Patroller</te> doesn't necessarily make one suited for undercover work, but curiously enough I see potential in you. Have you considered applying to the Bureau? Just kidding, unless you're interested.

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: What's that look on your face? Surprised to see me?

speaker: Yinlin
anh_en: This special power you have entrusted me... Should I take it as a sign of trust in my abilities? Or...perhaps a token of affection for me? Either way, I appreciate the gesture. Your straightforwardness is quite endearing.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Hello there. What will it be for today? Are you here to put in some extra work, or maybe just to loosen up a bit? Of couse, you're welcome for a chat, too. One moment, I'll go make some tea for you.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Exercising is essential for us martial artists. Other people may not find the same importance in exercise, since everyone has their own unique strengths. After all, we no longer live in a time where brute force is the only solution. Or rather, brute force never really solved anything.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Rumors have been circulating about me, and I don't intend to stop them. My story isn't particularly exciting, but people find amusement in talking about it, that doesn't bother me. And with words about me getting out there, I might end up reeling in a few dunderheads. Whatever impression others may have of me, I trust your judgment will not be swayed. Or, if I may say so, I am happy to accept whatever you think of me.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: I did hurt people in the past, sometimes with my hands, and sometimes through other means. Back then, I had to take the initiative... to make sure no more innocent people would fall prey to them. I had experience handling such things, and that was why I felt obligated to help. But I'm not telling you this in response to the rumors. I believe friendship is built on mutual understanding, and now is a good time for you to get to know me better.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: When it comes to the business world, one is often told that it's impossible to find true friendship. I have to concede, nobody I've ever known has understood me as well as you do. Though my gym has many customers, you are the only one to have become a true friend of mine. You are, and will always be welcome at my gym, my friend.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: A steaming cup of tea makes an excellent remedy for sore muscles after an intense workout. It's quite effective, you should give it a try.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Nestled between the borders, <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> is subject to ever-changing weather. Sustaining the dried fish I've been making for Mimi has been a difficult task... Hmm, I suppose a solution will come to me in due time.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: The solid ingredients of Jinzhou Stew blend effortlessly to form a simple dish. Back in the days when I had to live far away from home, it was the only dish that I could recreate to make me feel close to my roots. I can never have enough of it.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: I'm not a big fan of foods that are hard to chew… Oh, it's got nothing to do with my teeth. I'm just not fond of the prickling sensation of stickiness in my mouth.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Well... I just want to maintain the stability I currently enjoy, and maybe keep my hometown safe, if I get the luxury to, haha.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Have I been keeping some kind of secret healthy drink in this flask, you ask? *chuckle* It's really just regular hot tea.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: The stiffest tree is often broken by the harshest of winds, whereas the bamboo and willow survive by bending along. Finding harmony between strength and adaptability is integral to lasting success, be it in martial arts, commerce, or all aspects of life.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: You're always tied up with affairs, how about relaxing a bit for a change on your birthday? Here, I got you an ordermade massager, some Angelica Tea leaves, and a personalized health management planner for the upcoming year. You really should prioritize your health. Self-care comes before anything else, including helping other people, my friend.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Oh? *chuckles*... Did you smell the dried fish I have?

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Please don't worry. I've got it in check.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Hello. I am Yuanwu, and I run a boxing gym. It's not a big place, but we make sure every customer is treated with finesse. You're welcome to visit any time.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Anything I can help you with?

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: It's nice to take a break once in a while.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: I haven't felt this tingling sensation swimming across my veins in a while... So this is all your doing? *chuckle* Looks like this is going to take some time getting used to.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Now that I've gotten used to it, this power feels robust and flexible. It does have something in common with my <te href=850114>Leihuangquan</te>.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Thanks to your help, my skills have improved and even my thunderbolts are stronger. Owing to your aid, I might be able to get a couple more scoundrels dealt with.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: I can't thank you enough. With such power, I feel young and back to my prime days again. They say that time is invaluable. Doesn't that make the gift of power you've bestowed on me priceless? *chuckle*... Now, if you'd allow me some time, I should come up with a way to repay the favor.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Whether you need help with working out or maintaining your health, feel free to come by my gym. We welcome all visitors.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Since you've gifted me such a precious treasure, I should give you a matching gift in return. Please, take this Tea Pet—it grants you free access to all the boxing gyms and teahouses in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>. And... if you ever need me, just hand it to any one of the shopkeepers. I will come to your aid as soon as possible, no matter what.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Nice. Let's go check it out.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Found what you're looking for? Good.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Lingyang often visits my gym to play with Mimi just outside the front doors, always carrying a couple of fresh tetras as treats. I guess it might be his thank-you to Mimi for all the agility training they had done together. He sure is a thoughtful young man.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: I am more than happy to get an outstanding training partner like Jianxin by merely offering her a simple meal... Of course, I'm always pleased to spend time with her over a meal, whether she's here to train with me or not.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: I can sense a dangerous aura from Danjin's way of fighting... I'm worried that she may have far too much burden on her shoulders at such a young age.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Every morning, when I opened the gym, Chixia was already patrolling the street with exuberant energy. *chuckle*... I must keep up with my exercises too. Can't be outdone by the younger generations.

speaker: Yuanwu
anh_en: Your poise and comfidence are impressive. Such remarkable character can't possibly be built overnight. I can tell you've experienced far more than I have.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: Welcome to <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, esteemed guest from afar. My apologies for any shortcomings in my hospitality; my schedule is quite full. If there is a matter requiring my attention, please do not hesitate to find me at City Hall.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: The bustling city of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> is a product of every blooming flower, sturdy brickwork, and occupied home. With every new visitor, the city gains new life. Among them, you are truly one of a kind... No, I am not simply repeating what our <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> has said. These words come from my heart as well.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: An old proverb states, "When a great mind emerges, even the sea will part and the mountains will tremble." It speaks to the transformative power of extraordinary individuals... With your presence in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, I believe great changes will come in due time.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: I used to be quite curious about your background. However, I've come to realize that one's actions hold more weight than their past. Your past may shape you, but it is your present deeds that truly define you. Having witnessed everything you have done for <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, I cannot help but notice the mysterious connections between them... Perhaps there is something deeper behind your arrival in Jinzhou.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: Walking alone may lead to a faster pace, but a group can cover greater distances. \nMoving forward, I will stand by my companions… and I will stand by you as we face whatever the future holds, together.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: Have you been to the Jinzhou Theater? It's a place of endless joy and laughter, especially when a show concludes on a happy note. I've always cherished that sight, which is why I want to ensure everyone finds their own happy ending.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: Hmm... When faced with challenges, I am driven by a sense of purpose to find solutions instead of succumbing to worry. The feeling of worry or frustration rarely crosses my mind nowadays.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: If you haven't yet, I highly recommend visiting <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>'s morning market. The breakfast stall vendor sells the most delicious Loong Buns topped with plump red dates. As they steam, their sweet aroma envelops the air. They are truly a delight.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> once suffered from severe food shortages because of the <te href=850075>Lament</te> crisis. As someone who lived through that difficult time, I've learned to understand that food is not something to be taken lightly. Every morsel is a gift from Mother Nature as are those who work tirelessly to cultivate it... Personally, I have no dislikes when it comes to food, except for wasteful extravagance or exorbitant prices.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: People prayed to the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> not out of weakness, but because they had no other recourse. As leader, I will guide my people towards a future where humanity takes control of our own destiny.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: As a child, I had vivid dreams, some of them turning into nightmares. I would find myself lost at sea, fighting against the crashing waves and tangled seaweed. But each time, I managed to hold onto a piece of driftwood and make it back to shore. And when I woke up, I would find something in my hand… Yes, it was this shiny piece of scale.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: The snows of Mt. Firmament... I still vaguely remember how the snowflakes there danced in their own whimsical ways. One moment they were hovering in the air, and the next moment they flew upwards into the sky, twirling around the tree branches... Before long, everything was coated in a shimmering blanket of white. In <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, the snow brings a sense of peaceful togetherness. Strangers become friends as they brush off each other's shoulders and build snowmen together... Whether the snow is light or heavy, I pray to always protect these precious moments of pure tranquility.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: Over the years, my esteemed teacher Changli has taught me much… Yet her smiling eyes still hold mysteries that I cannot yet comprehend.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: Amidst my busy days, meals can easily slip my mind. Before I knew it, it would be well past the time for another meal. But like a blessing, Sanhua would always appear with a plate of delicious Loong Buns, filled with exactly what I was craving. I am in awe… How does she know every time?

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: Taoqi is able to breeze through mountains of workload with ease, despite her frequent yawns. Her efficiency is truly remarkable.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: Qingloong rise, monsters gone... Every child in Jinzhou knows this nursery rhyme by heart. My faith rests with Jiyan, for with his protection the <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> will never breach our borders.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: I can feel it in my heart that we both have something we'll fiercely defend, a cause worth fighting for... And we won't back down, no matter what it takes.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: After much contemplation, I have decided that a handmade gift will better express my feelings than any expensive store-bought present. Every day since learning of your birthday, I have devoted time to crafting a Loong lantern from materials I've handpicked. Fortunately, I've finished it in time. If you could find time in your busy schedule, please join me at the City Hall to fly this lantern together. It is a beloved tradition in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> to make a wish upon a soaring lantern on one's birthday, and it is said that the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> will bestow blessings for the year ahead.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: May I pray for anything specific for you? It would be my honor… I'm sure your wishes will come true.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: I am Jinhsi, the <te href=850118>Magistrate of Jinzhou</te>. My role holds great power and duty. I vow to serve my people with diligence and bring prosperity to our land.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: As the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> foretold, you and I were meant to cross paths.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: No one is born good at anything. As the <te href=850118>Magistrate of Jinzhou</te>, I must constantly learn and improve.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: As the new <te href=850084>Magistrate</te>, I initially worried about my lack of ability to protect my people. But soon, I realized that dwelling on self-doubt only hindered my progress, so I trained harder. With each session, my strengths grew. It is an honor to serve and defend my people. I'll always strive to improve as their Magistrate.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: Thank you for your guidance. I have seen growth in my strength and leadership abilities, and it seems you have taught me more than just swordsmanship; you've taught me valuable life lessons.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: I am aware that I have rather peculiar frequencies. It is rare for me to encounter someone whose vibrations align with mine so perfectly... Could it be that you also share a mysterious connection with our <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>? I do hope so, as that would make me feel… even closer to you.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: As I get to know you better, I can't help but notice the similarities between us. Our frequencies, powers, and even purposes seem to align. Defending <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> is my duty, and now I sense a deep connection between you and this land… I once believed that mankind should control our own destiny, but my meeting with you has shown me the power of fate. I am grateful for its hand in bringing you into my life.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: There is... much to be done...

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: As far as the eye can see.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: The lands of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> are filled with riches.

speaker: Jinhsi
anh_en: Would these be enough for your needs? Tell me if there is anything else you want.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: I first heard about you when my colleagues were discussing your physical. I was caught up in technical support back then, but wanted to meet you in person. Now, I am content to see that, as I predicted... you have the potential to shape <te href=850079>Solaris-3</te>'s future in unforeseen ways.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: As the child of two scholars, I was always drawn to the same path. Perhaps trying to follow in their footsteps. However, my recollections of them have blurred over time. Most of what I know about my parents comes from reading their published research and evaluations of their work by others, rather than personal memories. Their existence feels elusive to me, like a hazy dream. Yet, I am their legacy—a reflection of their brilliance, and... their madness.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: I like interacting with people, be it my colleagues at the Academy, or others. At times, I fear losing sight of my own humanity while chasing truth's elusive grasp... In those moments, I step away and seek solace in a bustling crowd. The laughter on their faces reminds me of the warmth of human connection.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: Losing my arm didn't bring as much pain as I expected. I was too consumed with excitement, finally discovering the Court of Savantae Ruins, following in my father's footsteps. The achievements I witnessed were beyond imagination. The secrets of a hidden civilization were revealed to me, their inventions harnessing the universe's echoes.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: ...Ah, it's you. Please, come in. No need to worry, I just need to recharge after all those meetings. Like a machine needing a break. Hmm? So you would like to help? Sure, please sit here. Just... stay next to me for a while. You don't need to say anything. Yes, this will do. Thank you.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: Writing a report alone, after completing research, is satisfying. My scattered thoughts and inspirations come together during this time, becoming clear and organized.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: During back-to-back academic conferences, my focus wanes and I need time to recharge. Being with peers is enjoyable, but a little solitude is necessary for me to stay sharp.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: I love all breakfast foods. I prefer to sleep and wake up early instead of staying up late and consuming caffeine. Eating consistent breakfast portions energizes my mind quickly.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: Oh, the Sour Soy Milk… When I was a toddler, my mother once convinced me to try it. While most of my childhood memories are joyful, that particular taste was overwhelming for my young palate.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: The laws of nature on <te href=850079>Solaris</te> have shifted under the <te href=850075>Lament</te>'s sway, and even fundamental principles are now being questioned across all academic fields. Yet, I find the pursuit of new theories quite stimulating. Deep within the cosmos, beyond the stars, lies a vast expanse waiting to be understood. And there, amidst the barren landscape, truth awaits its discovery.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: This prosthetic arm is pretty handy, loaded with helpful features. I don't have to worry about any arm injury while working on risky experiments, and I can even pull a few pranks on my colleagues. Oh, you want examples? Well... I'll definitely show you when I get the chance.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: Among the friends I made when I was a kid, Pascar was the one who kept in touch with me for the longest time. Certain actions, when done too late, can lead to lingering regrets. Occasionally, I contemplate how each individual is a complex enigma, similar to the countless scientific theses I have studied.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: Mortefi is an interesting person. He's devoted to his work with unwavering determination. It's that kind of intense drive that pushes scientists towards brilliant discoveries. I know he considers me a "genius"—but in a workplace with only "geniuses", many ideas will never be realized. My dear friend has yet to grasp his true potential.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: <te href=850084>Magistrate</te> Jinhsi has been paying close attention to the battles against Tacet Discords. She often visits the Academy to learn about our latest progress in weapons development. During those visits, she always seems tense. I understand the pressure and weight she carries, with all the promises and expectations placed on her shoulders...

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: The <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> bring valuable insights on <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> from their years of combat experience. General Jiyan has shared his extensive knowledge and new ideas with us. He possesses a gentle and just nature, but what truly sets him apart is his composure. This is essential for someone in his position.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: Aalto once approached me with an offer from <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, but I declined. Life at the Academy suits me well. Though his manner may seem unserious, Aalto has a sharp eye for valuable information and connections for rare materials. I've frequently relied on his services.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: Baizhi is a great researcher. Our work doesn't often overlap, but I've read her reports and they're well-informed and persuasive. She often participates in field research, earning her a reputation among peers for bringing back valuable data.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: Happy birthday. Please, extend your hand. With the <te href=850075>Lament</te> crisis stalling our deep space exploration, our understanding of the galaxy has been limited. But this... See? This is a glimpse of the unchanging universe, brimming with secrets and tranquility, just for you. If my theories about your true place of origin are correct... I hope this memento offers some solace.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: My name is Xiangli Yao, a researcher at the <te href=850092>Huaxu Academy</te>. Rover, your rare resonance frequencies raise an intriguing question: are you a unique beacon of insight in our quest for truth? Or do you already hold the ultimate truth in your hand?

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: As truthseekers, we gauge the universe from within a nutshell. I'd love to hear your insights.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: Amidst disruptions, let's find our way to the right path.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: Science is life's questioning of truth.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: An interesting new perspective. Thank you. Now I should be able to further improve my prosthetic arm's energy output.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: I can now achieve even greater things with Metalmorph. Is there a particular thing you desire? Please let me offer my new creation as a gift. It wouldn't exist without you.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: It's interesting. Your feedback reminds me of the texts I found in the Court of Savantae Ruins. Their ideology is fascinating and enigmatic, almost as if it came from the stars in outer space.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: I'm headed to test the new combat techniques I've learned. Care to join me? It's time to put theory into practice. I believe I have reached a critical point, and overcoming it will bring a new horizon.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: The pursuit of truth is a rocky path to tread. Some stumble and push forward, others lament their weariness, and a few may even turn back. Our ranks thin as we near the ultimate goal. But Rover... Though you blaze your own trail, I know you are always with us, guiding the truthseekers forward.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: Hmm... That was a rudimentary lock.

speaker: Xiangli Yao
anh_en: Does anything here catch your interest?

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: Strong—that was my first impression of you. Few have ever made me think that, but you were an intriguing exception. It was then I decided: when the time came, we would fight by each other's side. And as you know, I seized that opportunity when it came.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: Deceit and vanity are the fragile facades I despise most. One must face their feelings in the light, be it joy, pain, ambition, or evil. That's why I admire you. You've never tried to hide the fire in your eyes. It's that honesty that made us comrades.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: You hold special access to the Ephor's Palace. Therefore, its gates shall always stand open for you. Hm? You wish to know why? There is no need. I recognize you as a dear friend, and that is reason enough. Should you ever need me, I will stand by you on any journey. This I swear.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: As I said before, the title of ruler is almost too narrow to capture the depths of your humanity. And yet... I can't think of a title more fitting for you. Of course, it should and will never bind you, because only you can define who you are. Ragunna's Laureate, Septimont's Champion, Hero of Heroes... they're but fragments of your story, never the sum of your soul.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: I know well that your path stretches far beyond <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>—that is what sets us apart. I, Augusta, Ephor of Septimont, was born of this land, and to its soil I shall one day return. My gaze reaches every hill and peak of Septimont, but it ends at the sea. You, however, are meant to embrace the world. So go. Seek the lands far and wide. That is where your true arena lies.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: From the heights of the Ephor's Palace, one can overlook the entire City of Septimont. Whenever I finish my duties, I enjoy climbing up to the rooftop to feel the wind. At times, Griffrexes returning from the Sanguis Plateaus soar above the palace. I listen to their cries, eyes tracing their wings as they sweep across every inch of Septimont's land, a land that we, and our forebearers, reclaimed from the jaws of calamity. We Septimontians rarely dwell on the pain of struggle, for we understand that the road to victory is never smooth. And I will carry this glorious legacy forward. It is the promise I make to our people, and to this land that burns with pride.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: Trouble? At the Ephor's Palace, it's not uncommon to encounter challenges, but as long as one is willing to "fight," everything will resolve in time. Heh, troubles that can be overcome aren't real troubles.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: My favorite food? Haha, that's a difficult question. The food in Septimont suits my taste just fine, though I do enjoy some foreign dishes as well. But if you ask me to recommend something, well, I'll spare you. Iuno always says my choice in food leaves much to be desired. Still, if you're in the mood for something, don't hesitate to speak up. I'll treat you. Good food is best shared with friends.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: Uhm, I'm not a picky eater. As long as it satisfies, I'm content with anything. As for sweets, I don't indulge much. When I was young, Angel had a great fondness for desserts, so I would often leave her the treats that the adults gave us. Over time, I grew indifferent to sweets. But I wouldn't say I dislike them, either.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: When I was appointed as Ephor, I swore to defend the glory of Septimont until my last breath. Since that moment, my conviction has never wavered for even an instant. The passage of time has not dulled my vow. On the contrary, with each clash of blades, each call of the hunt, my resolve has only grown steadier and stronger. This is the mission I have chosen, and the path I must conquer.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: This greatsword is forged from the blades of countless Gladiators. You may have heard its tale. At first, I took those swords to spare the defeated a crueler fate. I took their blades, so they could live. I've always believed that a Gladiator's blood should be shed only for the greater good of Septimont. Of course, back then, I needed those blades to serve as my own fangs. Now, Gladiators no longer fight to the death in the Colosseum, and I no longer need a sword to prove myself. Yet somewhere along the way, this weapon became part of me, fused with my very flesh and blood. It bears witness to who I was... and shapes who I must become.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: Not many know about my past, or rather, my whole past. It's not that there are dark secrets to hide, just... the things I did in my younger, more reckless days still make me cringe a little. But with you, I don't feel the need to hide anything. Honesty is the least I can offer in return for your trust.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: Iuno and I became friends because we're so alike—stubborn, headstrong, and relentless in the face of defeat. In many ways, we walked in each other's footsteps, each unwilling to fall behind, and so we ended up on the same path. Even so, there are times I wish she could live more freely. I know the pain she carries runs deeper than what she's ever told me. To others, she may seem arrogant or willful, but that defiance stems from her certainty that every step she takes must be the right one. And such certainty… always demands a price.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: A formidable opponent. His words and actions have indeed earned the Senate's favor. I'm well aware the Senate is far from clean, but I trust Avidius has no intention of sinking into its filth. What I do wonder, though, is how fiercely his ambition will burn… or whether the confusion I now see in his eyes will one day consume him, leaving only cold embers in the wake of a fire gone out.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: A genius made for the arena whose passion burns pure. Had we met in the early days of the Colosseum, perhaps we would have fought side by side, as you two do now. Just watching her reminds me that my efforts to reform the arena were not in vain. The Colosseum is always meant to be a stage for passion and glory, not a mire of corruption and decay.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: Buling... Heh, just from the name alone, I can tell she's from Huanglong. From the moment we met, this remarkable young lady made an impression. I'm grateful she kept her promise and gave Septimont a fighting chance. For me, and for everyone in this land, her kindness is a debt we will never forget.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: Angel... I've never forgotten Fabianum, nor the past we shared. When our homeland fell... I don't know what kind of nightmare she faced that day in the depths of Oak Hollow. But there is a voice in my heart that never fades... it tells me she's still alive. And I believe, one day, Angel will find her way home, back to our land.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: Happy birthday, {PlayerName}. Take this, my dear friend. It's crafted by the finest blacksmiths of Septimont, a sword worthy of you. I know your hands are never without a sharp blade, but what true Gladiator would ever say they have too many? If this gift doesn't quite meet your expectations, just let me know. Any friend of mine deserves nothing less than the best.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: The blade most worn is often the sharpest.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: A faint power... but still, one that commands attention.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: Hehe... Good boy. Go fetch it.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: I am Augusta, Ephor of Septimont. Etch this name into your memory—it belongs to the one who stands above, and whose mark will never fade. Whether we meet as foes or friends, my sword and I await the fierce fight between us.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: With the blazing sun as witness... Glory, bow before us.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: All the sun touches is ours to fight for.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: Strike relentlessly. Again, and again... Each battle reforges my blade. Its true strength lies not in the steel, but in the will that commands it.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: Septimont flows through me, but my blood answers to neither the Senate nor the Colosseum. My veins run deep in the soil of my hometown and spread wherever I go. Each battle I fight, each path I choose, makes them pulse stronger.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: I will not stop here... My hometown's fall revealed the truth: only with the everblazing sun can darkness have nowhere to hide.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: When the rules are rigged, power turns into a weapon of destruction. Yet as I rewrite those rules with my own power, I realize just how much I still need to learn to keep Septimont balanced—and to lead as a true ruler.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: There was a time I felt lost atop Capitoline Hill. Not about the present, but the future. When age catches up to me, when the weight I carry is no longer mine to bear, no longer needed by Septimont... what then? Will I live a quiet life in a small town? Or maybe become a weaponsmith? It's hard to say. But if I had my way, I'd return to the arena with silver in my hair, facing worthy foes to the roar of the crowd... Hah, my blood will never grow old.

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: Stand tall before the eternal sun!

speaker: Augusta
anh_en: A hunt isn't complete without a prize.

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Hi, I found a new ruin! You wanna go explore? Wait, wait. I'll post a thread on the forum first. Need a catchy title. How about, "A 50-year-old woman caught wandering in the ruin at midnight. Here's why." Or "What's the dark mist leaking from the city's most Yin spot?" Which one do you like better? Oh, don't forget to act scared later, okay? You can do it, I know. What happens next? Hehehe, first we get the clicks, then boom, we drop the truth. Even if the truth is boring. Come, come, I'll teach you some new forum slang first.

speaker: Buling
anh_en: The worse the danger, the better I focus and grow from it. Funny, huh? I haven't trained in my sect for a long time, and I usually avoid conflict and fighting. But whenever I face a Tacet Discord, in those dangerous places nobody dares to go... that's when my mind clears. No noise, just stillness. I get serious, channel my spirit, and really push my spells. This counts as cultivation training, right?

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Peeking at heaven's secrets is the best fun! I'm curious about my fate, same as everyone else. But the rules say no reading your own fortune. Hmm... I don't believe heaven will punish me or take away blessings if I do. But knowing my fate will change how I live, and that will disrupt the Tao. So it's better I just let go and surprise myself with what comes next, right la?

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Traveling around means I get to see all kinds of places. Each one has its own little joy, little magic. I always spend till my wallet is empty, then take a few jobs. One job, maybe two, then aiya, I spend all my money again! What to do? I'm really not that brave, you know. I've seen cities rise all shiny-shiny, and I've seen them burn to the ground. So I only dare to enjoy the now. Thinking too far ahead? Don't dare.

speaker: Buling
anh_en: First time seeing me without headphones? Hmm... I guess that's cause we usually met in safe places. Hehe, the headphones actually protect me. When I take them off, I'm either tracking the <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>… or listening to you, like now. But wah, I talk too much already… now it's your turn, Boss.

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Playing games, of course! So many cool ones in <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>. Want to co-op sometime?

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Been many years since I went back to my sect. Of course, it's not like I don't want to, but... what if Master tests my spells, or my kicks and punches? I... uh... I'm not scared to go back! I just haven't finished my training on the road.

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Shredded fish noodles are a really tasty one! Put boiled noodles in the broth, then add shredded fish on top. Mmm, so good la! It's a Mengzhou specialty. You must give a bowl a try!

speaker: Buling
anh_en: One bite of chili, and I start burning head to toe. My tummy also protests all day, all night.

speaker: Buling
anh_en: People call me "Spiritchaser Taoist" because they're afraid of the Tacet Discords and spooky unknowns. But the day Buling makes that name un-be-lingable… that means I did good.

speaker: Buling
anh_en: My friends from the Academy modded these headphones for me. They block out <te href=850081>Tacet Discord</te> frequencies so I don't have all the noises in my head. I only take them off when there's a big job and I need to hear where the "ghosts" are hiding. But hey, don't think it's all silence in here! I've got music on right now. Wanna listen? It's Imaginary Foundry's new song, "To the sky—to the red tree—"

speaker: Buling
anh_en: In this world, not only <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> can kill. Fear can, too. And it's not only doctors who can save lives. Hope can, too. Sometimes, I say "There are no ghosts" to save people from fear. And sometimes, I say "Ghosts exist" to give people hope.

speaker: Buling
anh_en: She's the same as me, super good at some stuff, bad at others. Last martial contest, Master Shiling said she punches too much, thinks too little. I wanted to challenge her—but whoosh—her palm wind came out of nowhere and blew right through my spell array and talisman! But it's okay. I'm not the fist-and-muscle type. Redirecting force to attack is the smarter move. Hehe, knowing Jianxin's style, next time I might not even need to lift a finger. Just a bit of smooth talk and walk away with the win...?

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Master Youhu helps lots of my clients check their treasures, telling them what's real, what's fake, clearing their doubts and worries. But she's never that serious with me. Last time she brought out a new eggshell porcelain cup. Told me it's an ancient treasure with thin glaze, clean color, things like that, and she said five hundred <te href=850104>Shell Credits</te> is a steal. I said the cup was cursed with evil Yin Qi, and better pay seven hundred for a talisman seal, or it's not safe. Guess what happened in the end?

speaker: Buling
anh_en: We haven't met many times, but somehow, he feels like an old friend. Why? I thought I knew many people from traveling, but he knows even more! No matter where I go, someone always drops his name. What's that theory… any two people in the world are only like, six degrees apart? I bet we show up in the same friend circles all the time.

speaker: Buling
anh_en: She's... an interesting one. Before I joined <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, she tried to fight me. Of course I was no match for her, so I ran for it, as fast as oil on shoes! But she chased me all the way... into the <te href=850081>Tacet Discord</te> nest I led her to. She got caught up fighting, looked up and smiled at me. I was sitting in a tree, smiling right back. It was interesting... real interesting.

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Every time I go chasing ghost rumors, I always ask Encore to come along. She's not scared and she loves a new adventure! Sometimes she even livestreams it on the forum, makes up spooky stories to reel our audience in. Then when we drop the twist there's no ghost, we hide behind the screen and laugh till our bellies hurt. Then? Poof. Delete account. Hey, you want to know our forum nicknames? I'm "Earthly Immortal," and she's "Heavenly Sheep."

speaker: Buling
anh_en: She stands guard, outside all laws, all patterns... But total detatchment from the world isn't always a good thing. That isn't my divination, I can't read her. But I see it, loud and clear.

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Today's your birthday? Ooyo... your pillars of destiny, rare, rare! Hehe, I said before, you are the one to break the deadlock. Now I see the lock is probably more dead than we knew! Hmm? Aiya, don't stress. I mean rare in a good way. No better destiny than yours! So no worries, just believe in your path, and everything will go smoothly. Happy birthday, Boss!

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Let me check the feng shui here… hmm… oh? Ah... Ha! I knew it!

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Someone commented on my post? Hmm? What?! Don't believe me? Ah, so stubborn...

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Hmm… the lost treasure is… somewhere around… ah! Found you, hehe!

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Mengzhou Taoist Buling here. Exorcism, talisman divination, fortune-telling... you name it, I "bling" it!

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Boss, what matter do you seek answers for today?

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Seal script flows, Qi pulses through. Now I write talisman guided from above.

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Between heaven and earth, true sounds ring clear. From now on, my spells will hit even harder!

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Body and seal align, spirit gates open wide. My hand mudras now shift in a thousand forms.

speaker: Buling
anh_en: I walk the star steps, from Yin to Yang. The pulse of earth and the breath of heaven are now with me.

speaker: Buling
anh_en: After these enlightenments, I think I can now read more in you. Something I missed before. It's like a knot, but... still unclear. Master once said, if I can't read something, then it must be the world's deepest mystery. Doesn't matter. Even if I'm just a tiny drop in the ocean of fate, when I can finally see it, I will help you break the bind and rewrite the stars.

speaker: Buling
anh_en: Five Thunders have spoken. Demons, perish!

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Gotta admit, Solaris ain't a bad place to live. But the peeps here are nova-level sticklers. So freakin' polite it's even got me swearin' less... Didn't know I could talk 'thout droppin' so many f*ckin' F-bombs.

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Say, you ever had a dog? I did, name was Cup-Cup. Cutest little scruffball you ever saw. Knew how to listen, too. Had his own threads, a dog tag, the whole deal. Man... slept a helluva lot warmer with him around...

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: ...Y'know, never once stepped foot in a school. Everything I know 'bout stayin' alive, I learned on the streets. Constant threat of gettin' flatlined is the best education there is—just never know how high a price you're gonna pay... But hey, even if learnin' how to survive costs a literal arm and a leg, I still call that a bargain, choom.

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: I can crash, like, literally anywhere. I mean, who needs a pillow when ya got hands?! Sure, fluffy bed's nice 'n' all, but once you've zonked out in a shot-up convertible on the street, you can get your beauty sleep any place, any time.

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: I don't bother with "right n wrong," "pros and cons"... it's too damn exhaustin'. See somethin' tasty—scarf it down. Hear someone's bullsh*t—call 'em out. Land a gig—lock 'n' load. Strike it rich—hug your crew. Life doesn't gotta be complicated.

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: What am I into? Do gig afterparties count? Nothing beats grabbin' a fizzy and plantin' myself on the hood of a car. My sh*thead brother clownin' around. Kiwi and Falco clinkin' glasses. Maine "mentoring" David, gettin' sloshed... Dorio tearin' him a new one. Even Lucy the loner would stick around... But I guess that's gone now.

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: I'm thinkin' all these Echoes are way too cool. Pickin' just one's killin' me! Can't you rig the Terminal to deploy all the Echoes you want at once? Turn a one-on-one into a full-on swarm. Now that'd be preem!

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Pizza is peak. Cheap, easy and, most importantly, it's great party fuel. Perfect for sharin' while kickin' it with the crew.

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Food I won't eat...? Hmm... Nope, never heard of it!

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: A dream? I guess... just makin' sure everyone gets to live a decent life? I dunno, choom. Too busy thinkin' about the next stunt we're gonna pull!

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Ya like Guts? My own custom job. Talks the talk, packs a mean punch. Before I chromed up my arms, the recoil would send me flyin'. Total pain in the buns.

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Becomin' an edgerunner wasn't my dream. Was what my pops wanted for me and my bro. Took a little while for things to click, but by the time we joined Maine's crew we'd already built ourselves a pretty savage rep... Whatever. All in the rearview now.

speaker: Rebecca
