anh_en: Lynae and I just click. Got a lot in common—graffiti, motorbikes, badass vibes... Even went racin'. I ate her dust, but whatevs. Not many students 'round here are as nova as she is. Rare breed for sure. Be cool as hell if I got to be her classmate.

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Lucy... Dunno where to even start. Known her a while now, but can't say I really get her, y'know? Far as her netrunnin' skills go, she's a freakin' code wizard, can't deny that. I guess... no matter what, Lucy's crew. That answer your question?

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Mornye's chrome legs and what I've got installed are toootally different. Hers are see-through! Can look right through 'em 'thout seein' a single wire or chip! Like, how's that even work? Uses 'em like she was born with 'em, like the kid's had 'em since forever—Wait, what...? She's OLDER than me?! The hell?!

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: At first, he gave me creepy scavenger vibes. Boy, was I wrong. Hear he's good at patchin' peeps up, even their minds. Might let him scan my skull sponge when the dust settles. See if my grayware needs tuning, or if I'm just a certified whackjob.

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Sigrika's a good kid. Too good. Bein' that responsible, with everyone expectin' so much...? Gotta be exhaustin'. She oughta cut loose more. Go wild sometimes, y'know? ...Speakin' of, think she'd be down to hit the arcade with me next weekend?

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: It's your freakin' birthday, choom! That's a once-a-year license to raise hell! We're throwin' a rager, downin' bottles 'til sunrise! ...Oh, guess some peeps can't drink yet... Fiiiine, guess we'll make do with fizzy sodas!

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Aww, where'd you come from? Who's a good baby?! Yes, you are! You're a good baby! Look how cute he is. Good boy, good boy. Aren't you cute. Buh-bye, see ya 'round!

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Name's Rebecca. Edgerunner from Night City, just like Lucy. Look forward to rollin' with ya.

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Woo! Can feel that juice kickin' in!

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Looked like a standard immunoblocker, but this stuff feels totally different.

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: If Echoes got this Resonance Potion stuff too, then... Huh? Wait, they get somethin' else? What's the deal?

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Thanks, choom! Now that's what I call a solid tune-up!

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Check the specs! Got yourself a fully-loaded Rebecca now! Next fight, just cozy up by me. I got your back!

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: You chooms like this stuff, huh?

speaker: Rebecca
anh_en: Ugh, no ammo? Who stocks these things?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: If anything feels unfamiliar or unaccommodating, you can always ask me for help, Rover. This isn't only because you are our guest. It's just... you have no memory or any friends here in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. I think there might be moments when you'd need me.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Since I became an <te href=850139>Outrider</te>, I've met people from all walks of life in the wild. Some always seemed in such haste, yet remained unsure where they were heading, and often ended up lost. On the other hand, those who had a clear destination in mind usually did make it, despite arduous roads and occasional stumbles. I aspire to be one of the latter, and leaving home for Jinzhou was the first step I took.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I've been able to hear what the Streams have to tell me for as long as I can remember. They are not sounds produced by the vibrations of air, nor sentences spoken in any known language. They are signals carried by the wind, tangible to me whenever I focus myself to feel those incorporeal, rippling airstreams. The wind that flowed beside my ears just whispered another spellbinding story. Do you wish to hear it?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: The Streams make an unusual ripple whenever they flow beside you, as if they are being drawn to you once they come close. I don't know what that implies, but I'm sure I won't settle for standing aside and watching, no matter the implications. If circumstances permit, I want to face everything with you.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Call my name whenever you need me. From desolate lands to vibrant cities, from the beginning prologue to the final epilogue... no matter what awaits us in the end of this journey, no matter what kind of storm you are about to bring, I want to witness everything with you, as long as you'd let me.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Songs are resonating thoughts from the bottom of our hearts. They represent a person's truest feelings.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I want to do as much as I can for everyone in need, but if I take on more than I can handle... I guess it would only trouble those on the receiving end of my help, and burden me further.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Wuthercake is a national dish in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, though how it is made varies depending on the region. They make delicious Wuthercakes here in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, but for me, homemade Wuthercakes are always the best. When we have the chance, would you come home with me, and have a taste of my mother's Wuthercakes?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Shouldn't we cherish all food and not let any go to waste? Oh... Well, if it's truly badly cooked, then.. uhm...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: We all have an appreciation for beauty, but life isn't always full of it. I don't want to always rely on the comforts and safety others provide me with. I must be brave to face the ugly truth. I must be one that guards and gives.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Interested in my ribbon? It's a farewell gift from my mother back when I left for <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. I consider it a sign of a new chapter in my life, one which symbolizes rebirth. I hope it will continue to remind me I should always follow my heart.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: My senses are sharper than most, though it used to cause me severe distress. Various stimuli seemed to come at me from all directions, slamming into my mind at once. I felt like a lone feather, tossed around in a wild storm. Don't worry... I am okay now. I have found a way to stabilize myself in the Streams, and it was the Stream's message that led me to you.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Today is very special. It's your big day. So... *clears throat* happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you... Rover, I hope I can sing for you on your birthday this year, then your next birthday, and then the birthday after your next birthday.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Buoyant and languid... where will the wind take you?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: With every meeting... comes the inevitable parting. Let's not dwell on it.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I am Yangyang, a temporary <te href=850139>Outrider</te> of the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>, responsible for detecting and investigating anomalies. The Streams have guided me to you. I have a feeling we'll be companions for many moons to come.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: The skylark's song is about to sound.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I will do my best to help everyone.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: The Streams are getting louder. What do they have to tell me?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I've never felt such strength in me. It's all thanks to you, isn't it? I am forever grateful, Rover, for everything you've done for me.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Streams are converging from all sides, and I stand in their midst, expecting the wind's arrival.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I dedicate my song to brilliance, braving the raging storm. The skylark in me has never soared higher into the heavens.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I should... Give it my all...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: On the dangerous frontiers where we suffered immense losses, it was General Jiyan who stepped up to protect everyone, making all the tough decisions to ensure our safety. As the backbone of the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>, he has led us to countless victories as our Qingloong. The weight on his shoulders is beyond our imagination.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: When in trouble, ask Chixia, the Ally of Justice! This statement, while playful, rings very true. With her surging passion, seasoned prowess, and abundant vigor, Chixia already meets every quality a hero should have, helping the people in need.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Baizhi has a unique approach to comprehending and accomplishing tasks, but that doesn't make her a difficult person to talk to. When you ask her for help, you may notice a flicker of surprise on her face, but you will never receive a refusal.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I met Danjin a few times on different occasions. I could tell how much she values justice. She is very clear about when to unsheath her blade, and for what she fights, despite being surprisingly young. Her actions reflect her belief in an ideal world—one that she is determined to create.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Ms. Taoqi is always gracefully poised. She is the kind of person to quickly produce multiple solutions with ease in the most urgent situations, with a smile on her face: "Don't worry. I've got it sorted." Her seemingly unhurried demeanor must have been earned through hard work that we don't know about.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: The Streams have guided me to you. I have a feeling we'll be companions for many moons to come.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: This is it... Rover, you have already done so much for me, I shouldn't ask for more. From now on, I want to be the one taking care of you. Please... will you let me? I hope I can be the one to embrace all that you are, and share with you all that you carry.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: This is the answer to our endeavor.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: This should suffice for a while.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Being a broker such as myself, it is essential to establish good relationships to maintain a stable customer base. You still have some uncertainties about this world, it seems. We should really establish a connection, you know? If there's ever anything you wish to know in the future, I'll make sure you receive the best price for my services.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Since we're buddies now, here's some quick business tips. Like they say in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, "your sweet deal might be someone else's poison." It's all about perspective. You can sell the same intel for different prices depending on who you're selling to. Just a little bit of spin and you've got yourself a high-paying customer. Hmm? Nuh-uh, that's not lying! I'd like to call it reasonable strategy in meeting various demands.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Being "popular" attracts wealth… and sometimes unwanted attention. You get the occasional oddball who tries to push for a deal. Well, special customers call for special measures. If only all of 'em were as chill to talk to as you.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Info brokers love to play games with their words. You can't just believe everything they say, but you can't ignore them either. It's like trying to see through fog, but if you put in the effort, you'll uncover real gems hidden beneath their half-truths. But with me, it's easy. You know me, I've always been honest with you, buddy.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: I've been told I'm all about networking, not real friendships. Well, can't say I'd deny that. I don't want anything getting in the way of my judgment, so I tend to keep things strictly business with everyone. But now, I guess you're different. You always are. You have a way of swaying my decisions just by being around, as my friend or not.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: In our line of work, being too buddy-buddy with people and exposing weaknesses is a big no-no. Hmm… I can't say 'No' to you, I guess. I don't have anything in particular for hobbies, just some little mist tricks to give everyone a good laugh from time to time.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: With everything in this world so unpredictable, why sweat yourself all the time? When you're feeling gloomy, just hit me up. I'll get you straightened out, no strings attached.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Encore's Coral Bowl looks weird, but it sure tastes great. It practically dissolves on your tongue and leaves a nice, mellow flavor. You should give it a try. C'mon, what's up with the side eye? You've got to trust me on this one. The stuff may look like coral, but it's completely harmless, really.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: You know how some people make all kinds of excuses for their poor decisions? Take my old man, for example, pointing the finger at booze for his messed up life. Better stay away from things that numb your mind, don't you agree?

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: To live free as the mist and enjoy life while it lasts. Sounds wonderful, doesn't it?

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Hmm, curious about what this is? Nope—not a bone flute, it's a tape recorder. Funny little devices like this always come in handy in a pinch. Why don't we get you some next time?

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Believe it or not but when I was young, our house was like a revolving door for debt collectors, thanks to my dad's gambling habit. Boy, did I hate my life having to put up with it all back then. So hey, don't you think your poor buddy deserves a few extra clients, after everything he's been through?

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Heya! Happy Birthday, my most special patron! Got you a custom-made mist-maker. It may not look like much, but all you have to do is give it a little twist to have mists of all shapes and sizes... And Voila! Here's a kitten for ya, how'd you like it? Now whenever you're feeling down, just turn your troubles into mist and watch them fade away.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Credibility in the name, and customer satisfaction is the game.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: I never miss out on a good deal.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Howdy! I'm Aalto, your go-to information broker. I've got all the info you need at fair prices. Knowledge about different places is key to staying ahead while you're out and about. Interested in a quote?

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Any detail along the way could become valuable intel.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Nice pick! You won't regret choosing Aalto's service.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: It's go time! You'll have my mist for escort.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Whew—I can make more mist now. Thanks, I'll offer you something extra next time.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Hmm? You never fail to impress. My mist can reach even further now. Sweet! And that'll be another intel on the house for ya!

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Now I can switch between any kind of mist as I please. Much appreciated, bud! If you need anything, just ask away. I'll do my best to oblige!

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Whoa, talk about sincerity. I'll make this worth your while, of course. My mist will be with you at all times, you can trust me to have your back.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Phew. In the nick of time.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: How's that for a magic trick?

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Lost in the mist of time.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Can't we just talk this out?

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Time to bring out my A-game.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Don't worry... Just a trick of the eye...

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Well, would you look at that! Easy money.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Say, buddy, we should probably take care of those bills you owe me. Let's see here… Hmm, you know what? I actually made a good chunk of change from the intel you asked for, so why don't we just call it even? Swing by anytime and let's do more business!

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Aaand… What's inside mystery box No. 01!?

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Sometimes not even I can figure out just where Encore's getting all that energy from. As soon as we arrive somewhere, she's off making friends and sharing stories with the local kids in no time. I even got some of my intel from her buddies, believe it or not.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Being the <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> Garrison's General is no walk in the park. You gotta have that big-picture thinking, be on top of everything, and make decisions like they're nothing. Just take a look at General Jiyan—he's got all those boxes checked off and then some.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Oh, Miss Chixia. Our first convo didn't go quite as planned. I was doing some business in Jinzhou at the time, then she tried to arrest me, probably thought I was some crook. Lucky for me we worked it out later.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Miss Yangyang? We haven't talked much, but the way she can tap into the "Streams" for intel is definitely something. As someone in the information game, that really sounds handy. I should see if she's interested in being my informant.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: Hmm… Seems unlikely she'll ever be my client. She's the type of person to trust the conclusions from her own research over information provided by anyone else.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: The Academy's red-haired international research fellow? I heard he's got a way of handling difficult clients. Actually... I was thinking about asking him for some pointers.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: I always enjoy doing business with a Ghost Hound. They keep things clean, They're straightforward, and they don't goof around.

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: That little girl from Rigg's Explorers? Yeah, I bumped into her once, back in the New Federation. Offered me a Starflower for the whereabouts of her mother. But the deal fell through, because she didn't have what I was asking for. And what was that, you ask? Well… I asked for a never-withering flower. In reply, she told me plants have their life cycle, and wilting is just a natural part of it. I remember telling her, "The same can be said for humans."

speaker: Aalto
anh_en: G'day. What does our loyal client wish to inquire about today?

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: I have long been stationed in the borderlands, with little knowledge of entertainment or places of leisure. However, if you are looking for tactics against <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> or beautiful natural vistas, I can provide some suggestions.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: While the borderlands cannot rival the city's clamor and glamor, they do possess their unique charm. Should you find time, I suggest you come and witness the full moon and twinkling stars that grace the tranquil night skies. Rest assured, your safety will not be a concern; I will be there with you.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: The <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> are a source of solace for many, while I see them as a scalpel, with the duty of eradicating maladies. Me? I am the hand that guides this scalpel, I suppose.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: Soldiers of the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> have entrusted their lives to me. Therefore, every time I wield the scalpel, I must do so with absolute precision so as not to betray their trust. One day, this scalpel will eradicate all <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>, and when that moment arrives, I hope you can witness it with me.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: Flowers in the Knell Square are planted to honor the deceased. These flowers are of a unique variety, and they require significant attention. Here is a cultivation guide. If I fail to keep my promise of witnessing humanity's victory with you, please plant one of these flowers there for me.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: Though I no longer practice medicine, I still discuss medical knowledge with my mother in my spare time. This gourd-shaped pill case is a gift from her the year I joined the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: In just a few days, a thin layer of dust has collected on my desk. Cleaning is not a challenge, but consistency is.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: Jinzhou Stew is renowned for its wide variety of ingredients and easy preparation, making it a beloved homemade dish in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. Having been stationed in the borderlands for most of my time, I sometimes miss that taste.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: In <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, there is a vegetable known as "Bittberry". It possesses a bitter and slightly astringent flavor, and is renowned for its detoxifying properties. When I was young, my mother was somehow convinced "those who can endure bitterness will rise above others." She frequently incorporated this vegetable into our meals. I must confess that its taste was far from pleasant. However, now serving in the army, I have grown accustomed to its flavor. After all, resources are scarce, and it is crucial not to squander them.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: If one day, the borderlands no longer need a general, I suppose my wish will have come true.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: This spear was modeled after the weapon of Captain Beiwang, bearing the significance of quelling chaos and warding off external threats.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: My family has been in the medical profession for generations. I once aspired to follow in their footsteps, saving lives and providing care. However, I soon realized that a doctor could never fully alleviate the pain caused by the <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>. It was this realization that led me to join the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>. Over the years, I have found my way of bringing solace to the world.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: I have worn this vambrace since my first battle. It saved my life countless times. A vambrace like this is believed to bring good luck, ensuring the safe return of soldiers. Though it may show signs of wear, I wish to pass on this luck to you. Additionally, I have prepared a few travel essentials that I hope will prove useful. Happy birthday.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: Jiyan, of the Midnight Rangers. Protecting our lands and people is my solemn duty. Should you encounter any difficulties here, I will do my utmost to help.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: Should you find yourself lost, follow the banner of the Qingloong.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: When danger arises, take cover behind me.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: The battlefield is dynamic. Do not let your guard down.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: I can sense an improvement in my strength. I suppose you are well-versed in the art of training, too?

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: So you have opted for a prudent strategy this time. Next time, maybe we can consider something more unconventional.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: Remarkable strategy. Your insight provides me with unique and refreshing perspectives that I have not considered before.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: With your bold plan, my Qingloong has gained more momentum on the battlefield. I appreciate your assistance.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: Others often perceive Mortefi as arrogant and unapproachable, but, in fact, he is not that hard to talk to. Remember to be direct with him, as trying to be overly polite and subtle may only lead to misunderstandings.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: The "battle" Magistrate Jinhsi has been taking on may prove more complicated than our situation in the borderlands: stipulating rules, overseeing trade, ensuring the well-being of the people, and managing the city's functioning all demand her coordination and judgement. Every time I return to <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, I can feel the city's vibrancy and enthusiasm, all thanks to her meticulous governance.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: Taoqi... Though our views on loose management don't always align, I am able to focus on the front lines without any worries, thanks to her effective leadership in maintaining <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>'s fortifications.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: She can perceive minute changes in the surroundings from the Streams, but there is a limit to the amount of information a single person can take in. Excessive use of this ability might add to her burden, and I hope she won't strain herself.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: Many stumble through life directionless, without ever finding a purpose. Baizhi is among the rare few who have found their calling, and she is willing to give up anything for the truth she pursues.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: That energetic and passionate <te href=850087>Patroller</te>? Yes, I have heard of her. She has been devoting her time to protecting the dreams of children in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: Fog can be an enemy to soldiers on the march, as it limits visibility and complicates situational awareness. However, deploying fog strategically can be an effective move on the battlefield. I have had the opportunity to work with Aalto before, and he is an interesting person indeed.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: Are you referring to the little girl who is always seen by Aalto's side? I have met her once. She and Aalto complement each other perfectly, personality wise.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: I have never regretted braving the long night.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: Commanding an army is not a simple task, and sometimes I find myself questioning my own decisions. Going forward, with you staying by my side, I should feel more at ease.

speaker: Jiyan
anh_en: Wouldn't hurt to be more prepared.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: You're a seasoned fighter, I can tell. Let's have a bout sometime soon, shall we? Sparring is my passion, and I can't pass up an opportunity to fight someone like you!

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: Erm, actually... I wonder just how you seem to know so much. I've been to the cities a few times, but I know very little compared to you. Can I ask you for help next time I run into things I don't understand? Please bear with me, though, as it may take me some time to catch on...

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: I grew up in my sect, on a remote, secluded mountain. Most people may find it a bit challenging to make it there, but it should be easy for you. I can take you there if you want. Hehe, honestly, I've always wanted to bring you home as my guest!

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: I wasn't the brightest kid, but I was lucky to find my talent in martial arts. That's why I really admire people with both brains and courage. Of all the smart people I know, you're the best, being a great martial artist and a true defender of justice. You are the one I look up to the most, beside my masters.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: I adore being part of nature's harmony. Every songbird in the sky, every leaf on the ground, and every glimmer of sunlight makes me feel a serene joy, as the sweet breezes surround me, whispering life's many blessings. Your presence brings me the same kind of feeling, Rover. With you, everything feels so right, like I belong where I should.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: My life's goal is to one day fully master Fengyiquan. For me, every place—be it in the valley, on a mountain peak, or a bustling market—provides an opportunity to perfect my art. I find joy in connecting with various energies and Chi available across different places; this connection gives me new chances of growth.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: Worthy opponents are always hard to find. I always yearn for a good fight from which I can learn and improve myself. That said, I'm not too invested in looking for challenges anymore. One can only find inner peace when they let go of their desires. I can find my growth without engaging in frequent battles.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: My favorite food? It's the Guokui Flatbread! We'd always have it at our sect, and when I was little, I got extra servings like other younger disciples. Master Shiling even said that I'd followed his scent of freshly made flatbread all the way up the mountain, and that's how I joined our sect. I'm not sure if it was true or not though, he loves to rib us like that sometimes.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: There isn't any particular food that I dislike. I'm not much of a food person, I guess. People mix various ingredients for a variety of purposes—to gain muscle, to treat illnesses, or to stay healthy. The flavors of these food combinations are just natural outcomes. All types of food serve a purpose and can be beneficial.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: Unite the strengths that are both seen and unseen, and purge oneself of all that is unclean. Only then may one know the Tao's grandness; it is the final test every true Taoist must take.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: I got the Mirrors of Clarity from Master Shiling when I was little. The mirrors represented my masters' good wishes for me: to stay dedicated, disciplined, and become a well-rounded individual. Each day, I carry them with me to honor their teachings, but more importantly, to remind myself of how much they cared for me.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: To reach where our sect is, one must take the Ancient Path—it's the only way up the mountain. This is usually difficult for new disciples, but Master Shiling said when he took me in, I almost made it up the mountain as fast as he did. He said I was like a little wild animal: agile, vibrant, and naive. I can't remember any of that, though. The earliest memory I have is practicing martial arts with fellow disciples.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: Chixia always invites me to spar. She's really good with her guns, and I've learned so much from those fights. I admire her dedication and genuineness. It's great to have made a friend while honing my fighting skills.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: Occasionally I'd leave my sect to go on what we call self-cultivating trips. During one of those trips, I visited Mr. Yuanwu's boxing gym and challenged him to fight, and I won. I told Master Shiling about it when I returned, and it turns out Mr. Yuanwu's ancestors used to practice martial arts at our sect. According to the rules, I guess I should call him my "martial senior". I heard that Mr. Yuanwu went through a lot when he was younger, but it seems he doesn't want me to talk too much about it, so let's just drop it there.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: I've only celebrated birthdays for my masters and fellow disciples before, and we'd usually make peach buns of longevity for the birthday person. So... here, I've made some peach buns for you! Happy Birthday! I wish you good health and great happiness!

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: What am I supposed to do with this... Hmm... W-whoah! Phew...

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: I am Jianxin, the successor of <te href=850134>Fengyiquan</te>. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: Release the wants, and the mind quiets. Cleanse the thoughts, and the soul clears.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: What will I learn from this fight?

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: This is a different practice, but it feels similar to how I usually do seated cultivation as my master taught. Hmm... how do I put this? I'll tell you once I've come up with a better way to describe.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: Finally, I've fully mastered this move. It all went so well today. Thank you for sparring with me!

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: This is... the feeling of standing on top of a mountain, watching the billowing sea of clouds beneath my feet. The spirit within me resonates with every life in this universe... Yes, that's it! That's how it feels! I've finally figured out how to put this feeling into words!

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: Now my body and mind have gained a newfound clarity, and even my senses are keener than before. The Chi that surrounds me seems more... Oh no! Sorry! Are you alright? Phew... I should have paid more attention to keep it in check. I'll focus on improving my control of this power from now on. Thank you, Rover! I'm now another step closer to my goal!

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: Is this real? I can't believe... Thank you, for everything you've done for me. No one, apart from my masters, has shown me more kindness in this life than you have. I can never repay in full what I owe to you, but I want to try anyway. There is something I've wanted to tell you for a while now: beyond seeking martial excellence, I've found another goal in life—to do everything I can for you, until my very last breath.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: A contented mind is a perpetual feast.

speaker: Jianxin
anh_en: Hmm. What's it gonna be this time?
This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.
We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.
I will be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.
The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.
This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.
I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.
A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.
The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: You must be exhausted from your long journey. Well, time to sit down, take a break, and enjoy some poetry and music. What do you have in mind today? A heroic epic, or a simple jolly tale of rural life?

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: While reality may not have those magical swords and spells flying around in stories, that doesn't mean they have no meaning. The enduring goodness and beauty we find in those tales help us love the world even more.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: Want to find me quickly? Let's see... You might catch me at restaurants late at night, on a random street corner, or up on the rooftops... Oh, that doesn't sound very helpful... Anyway, just follow the poetry and music, and we shall meet again.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: So, you've noticed I never mention any goodbyes or farewells in my poems. That's because, to me, goodbyes are just preludes to reunions. If I made the endings all sad and teary, it would be awkward when we meet again, don't you think?

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: A stranger sailed from distant shores and, after a grand debut, was crowned <te href=850103>Laureate</te> of the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te>. How's that for a story? This tale will be sung through the ages. I'll have the wind carry it across time's endless sea, echoing in eternity.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: I really love a polyphonic form of music called the "chaconne." It captures the fleeting journey of life. From the cries of birth, to the drama and joy of living, and finally the melancholy of aging and loss. I believe my poems should follow a similar style. Triumphs deserve celebration, but suffering must also be recognized. Only by embracing both the light and the dark can we truly learn to love the world.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: I've slept in all sorts of "beds" while wandering from one place to another. Tents, treehouses, mountain rocks, you name it. I'm not really picky about the environment. What bothers me the most is that whenever I try to switch sleeping positions, my horns always get in the way. Ugh, a perfect-size nightcap or horn covers would be nice.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: Any food can taste more delicious when paired with poems or music. How about we grab some wine and pizza, my friend? Add a side of "Poetry & Music Sauce," and when you hear the first few notes, you'll know it's time to dig in and enjoy.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: Food names can be misleading sometimes. I once met a merchant who taught me how to make a "gourmet treat" called "Deer Crackers." It was a type of biscuit made with breadcrumbs and flours. The name sounded cute, and I thought it would have a fresh, natural taste. But when I gave it a bite all I got was just dry and bland. Right as the merchant noticed and snatched the crackers from my hand, a deer popped out of the bushes and started enjoying them. So, as the name suggests, "Deer Crackers" are really just crackers for deers.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: I wish I could travel forever. A child's journey, a crazy journey, a colorful journey, a wanderer's journey... Any journey. Being on the road, I get to meet all sorts of people and hear their stories. Their tales of love for life, random chatter, and wild dreams and ideas are like fireworks bursting with colors and excitement.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: This is the first musical instrument I ever had. It can no longer make the sounds it used to, but thanks to my Forte, I can still feel the joys it once brought me from time to time... A young girl basking in the setting sun on stage, performing all by herself for an imaginary audience.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: When I was little, my father wanted me to stay far away from poetry and music. I didn't understand why, especially when he was a choir master himself. But as they became a bigger part of my life, I began to see the other side—the often overlooked tragedies. Tragedies that can even harm the performers themselves.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: She's a discerning buyer and a skilled seller. Whether modern or vintage, Carlotta always appraises art with a fair and thoughtful eye. She taught me that the beauty of art transcends time, and that every artist will eventually find an audience that appreciates their vision.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: There was a time when I thought about telling her the truths about the Order, but after seeing her devotion as she stood in front of the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s statue, praying for the people of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, I abandoned the idea. For an <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> as kind as she is, perhaps the truth may do more harm than good, just as it did to me.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: He's a captivating performer on stage. Sometimes I wonder about Brant's fate. Will he be written into the pages of history after countless adventures? Or will he spend his retirement years recounting his legendary tales on a ship somewhere, holding a bottle of Troupe Strength?

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: The Blessed Maiden? Or a villain? There are still many unanswered questions in Cartethyia's story. I would never sing an incomplete story. A tale must have a proper ending for a bard to make it truly resonate through history.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: On this night of twinkling stars, I give my best wishes to the lucky star born on this day. Have you thought of a birthday wish yet? Wait, don't say it out loud. Once you have it, come sit down. The performance is about to begin.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: Bards are the couriers of heroes' tales. No need for applause or flowers. I'm just a storyteller like any other. Nice to meet you, great hero. You can call me Ciaccona.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: Hear that? A twinkling star just tinkled to the ground!

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: Off we go! May my poems light the way on your path ahead!

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: Some say, the storyteller will end up being part of the story as well.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: Isn't it amazing what miracles words and music can bring?

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: It's a type of vocal exercise. Want to join me?

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: Look, a mandolin made from a cookie jar! And a maraca made with a water bottle filled with beans. Amazing, right? We define what a musical instrument is. Performers never worry about being out of tune when expressing genuine emotions.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: In a vast world, we journeyed across plains and explored ancient underground ruins. Finally, we pushed open the heavy doors of a tavern, dropped bags of <te href=850104>Shell Credits</te> on the table, and began singing our legends. As for whether the story is artistically embellished... Ha, I believe we should approach life with a romantic outlook.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: Time to end this story, the tale of all our adventures together. And there it is, the title of the final chapter: "To be Continued."

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: Now presenting, a poem of finale.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: The poems will be sung again…

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: Phew. Not a mimic from the stories this time.

speaker: Ciaccona
anh_en: Well, look who's also got an eye for inspiration.
This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.
We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.
Let me be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.
The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.
This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.
I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.
A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.
The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: Here, this is for you. Be careful, it's just been baked and is still hot. But trust me, it tastes best when you tear into it right away. This little trick is just for you, since we're good friends. Coming back home feels different, even though my house has been empty for so long. But the bread from that bakery still tastes the same. The last time I had it was when I won the <te href=850103>Laurel</te> as the Blessed Maiden. Back then, the town was covered in posters of me dancing at the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te>. That dance... would you like to see it?

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: ...Back in the tower, I felt uneasy just hearing you mention it... but actually hearing a play about my life was utterly surreal. If you hadn't stopped me, I'd have jumped out of my seat and run away! When I was younger, I used to daydream about being the heroine in one of those adventure stories. But now that it's actually happening, it's nothing like I imagined. The poets of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> have added so many embellishments. If they'd checked my scripture grades from the seminary, they wouldn't have written those extravagant lines about me.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: We meet again, Righteous One. Heh... So, how was I? Was I helpful? I'm no longer the lost, confused girl I once was. Now, I stand ready to fight alongside you. This is the promise I made, and to honor it, I will sharpen this sword even further. Though it may never come to pass, if fate wills it... I will defeat you as I vowed... and set you right.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: After merging Fleurdelys, I finally understood why I hesitated when "I" first saw you as I danced on the water's surface. When you first arrived in <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>, "I" could feel your presence. A strange joy surged through "me." Deep within the tower, "I" wondered… what would the one who could both destroy and liberate "me" look like? Would you be a righteous knight, as in the legends, slaying "me" with your sword? I couldn't choose how I was born, but I could choose how I would die. And that, in itself, is a kind of happiness. You gave "me" that chance, "Godkiller." And the ending of this story is more beautiful than I ever imagined.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: The turmoil in <te href=850096>Rinascita</te> is far from over. Born of mankind's ill will, Leviathan may yet rise from the raging currents of civilization's soul... I cannot stray too far from this land. Everyone has their limits, often bound by responsibility, and true freedom remains elusive. You and I are no exceptions. But the sword you wield was forged from our shared frequencies. It is a mark of our bond and a manifestation of my power. As long as you carry it, I will be your sword and faithful companion... ever present in the depths of your gaze.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: I love seeing people smile! That’s why I adore the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te> and any lively occasion. The cheerful crowds, the joy in the air, the laughter filling every corner... I just love being part of it. Whenever that happens, I want to blend into the crowd, singing, dancing, and spinning hand in hand with everyone...

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: ...Whenever I transform into Fleurdelys for battle, I have to constantly remind myself—My manners, my tone... everything has to be composed and solemn... Ah! It's actually really hard, you know? Truly!

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: My favorite dish is Laurus Salad, of course. It's not only delicious, it's also healthy. I'd gladly eat it for three meals straight. Hm? Oh, I wouldn't get tired of it, not at all! The sweet Viscum Berries coated in dressing have the perfect crunch and flavor. It's easy to prepare, and even I can make the dish taste just right.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: I'm not really fond of fish. I don't know why, but every time I try to eat it, I just can't, even my fingertips seem to resist. When I was little, my parents used to say I was picky. Living by the sea, there aren't many food choices, especially if you don't like fish. But I've never been able to get over this instinctive aversion.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: My current dream? I want to be a wandering knight, just like the ones in the stories passed down in Egla Town. A knight of righteousness, always ready to draw my sword in the face of injustice, then riding off in the most heroic way! Before the Order chose me to be the Blessed Maiden, that was my deepest wish. But now... that title no longer belongs to me, and it never will again. I must step away from the adoring gazes and become a nameless guardian. To that end, I've been revisiting the survival skills I once learned during my days roaming the hills. Oh, do you think you could help me come up with a new knight's name?

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: Haultir is my sword and my very first companion. In the stories passed down in Egla Town, every true knight always has a sword they hold dear, so when I got mine, I was overwhelmed with joy. Though I've wielded many swords since, Haultir remains the most precious. Every time I grip the hilt, I can feel… that my heart hasn't changed. Even if it was a heart born from lies, I know that, when given the choice, I will always choose "to save."

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: I was born from the <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>'s curse and malice. It made me wear the crown, bathe in the glory of the Blessed Maiden, surrounded by the reverence of countless faithfuls. I fought against Its false faith, day after day, until I was finally overwhelmed by the tides... In that long slumber, those familiar prayers no longer felt warm, but cold and sorrowful. At one point, I thought I'd never want to hear them again. But after you saved me from the tower, I secretly visited <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> City… Oh, then I knew, I've never resented the prayers of those longing for happiness. And to ensure these pure voices aren't twisted, there's still much I need to do, and can do.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: I… took away the brilliant future she was meant to have. The future of being the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s true Blessed Maiden. All the goodwill and hopes placed upon me, and the power I now possess… all of it should have belonged to Cantarella. Yet, she never seemed bothered by it. Someone as mature as her must have already found her own path within the <te href=850094>Fisalia</te> family. But still, I'll always remember that I owe her so much… so much.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: That girl has a kind and gentle heart. Duties aside, she always does her best to be there for others. Honestly, when it comes to knowledge of the Order's doctrines, I'm nowhere near as good as Phoebe. It's because of so many true and faithful believers like her, I find it difficult to reveal the truth to the people of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>. People turn to faith for many reasons, not just out of devotion to the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>. To unveil such unsettling truths would bring forth countless difficult choices and challenges...

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: As the daughter of <te href=850101>Montelli</te>, she has really brought fresh ideas to the city. If this island were to stay isolated, the air would grow stifling. The people of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> need new ships, new horizons, and new discoveries. I'm not very skilled in business matters, though. My nanny in the Order always said I didn't even know how to haggle... If I ever get the chance, I'd love to learn a few tricks from Miss Carlotta!

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: When I was a child, I used to beg the bards passing through town to sing me stories of knights. After I was freed from the tower, I wandered through a field one day, and the wind carried a piece of beautiful music to me. I stood beneath a tree in the distance, listening as Ciaccona sang a new poem, one with the melody of Egla Town's folk songs… In the blink of an eye, noon had already given way to dusk.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: The nature of the <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>'s power to converge often makes me appear dangerous and unsettling after battle, but Lupa has never once recoiled. She never treats me as more or less than I am, and she has never distanced herself. She is honest, tenacious, and unwavering in her care of her friends. Even though I'm shorter than her when not in my Fleurdelys form, I still feel that I should take on the role of the "older sister" in our friendship.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: Happy Birthday, {PlayerName}! You're probably wondering why I brought you here. Just look at the clouds, the soaring birds, the Inverted Tower, and the golden glow of the morning sun... As long as you hold my hand, I can guide you to float above the sea like this. It's fascinating, isn't it? Later, when the sun sinks into the ocean, the view will be even more mesmerizing. I used to stare at this every day from the tower, and I grew weary of it. But now, everything feels different, all because of you. I'm not the true Maiden. I don't have the power to grant blessings, but I still want to offer you my best wishes. May your heart's deepest desire come true.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: Today's story is... the great battle between a righteous knight and the wicked <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>! The victor is—Cartethyia the Knight!

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: Time for a little nap... It's... It's just a dream...

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: Cartethyia, now a wandering knight. The <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>'s malicious creation, the Order's unsuspecting <te href=850103>Laureate</te>, the defier lost in the tides of fate... These titles, once portrayed in poems and books, have long since slipped from my grasp. As for what lies ahead... let’s explore it together,  "Swordbearer."

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: The crown of winds... has been engulfed by the sea. Tell me, are you the one who summoned this blade?

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: This sword shall follow your will.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: My swordsmanship has reached new heights!

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: Can you feel it? The frequency of the wind... it's resonating between us.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: During my studies at the seminary, I knew that to uphold justice, I would need to work harder and sacrifice more than others to overcome the shadows that sought to destroy it.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: The power within me once terrified me. I wondered how monstrous I'd become if it consumed me... But such terrors have started to fade, with you by my side.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: The currents of fate pull everything into their depths. At times, as I drift in its grasp, I sometimes feel resistance. Everything I once achieved, every ounce of trust I earned, was consumed by the <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>. How ironic that the power I gained to protect others once served to sustain my nemesis. But I know I cannot let this fear hold me back. The <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> granted me life, and I must honor that blessing by guarding all that remains in Their stead.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: If it's a duel you want...

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: This sword... shall not be shattered!

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: A mere scratch upon my blade.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: What form do you look for?

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: My knightly instinct says... this way!

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: Just like the treasure chests from the stories!

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: This should afford us more provisions.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: Let's call it... A Knight's Great Harvest.

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: What is it you wish for?

speaker: Cartethyia
anh_en: Your wish for wealth is granted.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: A void… I was taken aback when I first heard Grandmother Lillibet describe you as such. We Priestesses revere the Sacred Flames, for their light grants us revelation. Wherever it shines, shadows and reflections emerge. Yet a void... Could it be a barrier, or perhaps some form of falsity that refuses to be seen? As the Unwritten One, do you embody endless unpredictability, or is it an absolute emptiness? Only now, walking this path with you, do I understand. This void is nothing obscure. It's like Chaos, yet different. It's where countless possibilities wait to be chosen.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: Seeing is simple. But facing what you see isn't. It may be a blessing to see the future, but the real curse is knowing what's coming and being powerless to stop it. Yet I won't accept the prophesized end. Only the weak would stand by and just watch it all unfold... I must try to make a change. Even if I have to look at the same agonizing truth over and over again. Even if the struggle never ends. Even if I'm only giving fate a little dent.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: What would happen if I shot that arrow...? Well, I sort of knew what to expect. My existence... might vanish completely, or simply fade from others' memory. In the years of using the Moon Arrow to mark and uncloak the <te href=851023>Dark Tide</te>'s creations, I experienced that too many times. The costs were always small, and the reactions were barely noticeable. At most, people's memories of me would grow hazy for a few days, and I would have to remind them who I was... That much I can bear. And to rewrite the whole end at such a cost? Quite the bargain no matter how you look at it, right?

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: Sometimes those who remember suffer more than those who forget. To remember is to bear a weight, to remain unbroken when you'd rather break, and to be forced to carry on. Forgive me... Back then, I had no clue that returning to the real world was even possible, and because of that, this selfish desire of mine for you to remember me now looks even more willful... But even if I had to do it all again, I'd still... If anyone were to remember me, to keep some piece of me alive, it would be you. You'd be the exception.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: What will I do now? I haven't decided yet. Well... I spent so much time looking into the future that the idea of living in the present feels strange. But now, Septimont and I are in the same position. No more chains. No more limits. Just endless possibilities spread out before us. With so many paths to take, why rush to choose the "best" one? I'll just do what I feel is right, and take what I truly want... And right now? This is what I want. That's for sure.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: I love surprises. Fate can be generous and stingy at the same time. To outsmart it and bring about some "accidents" takes real work. Countless preparations, endless calculations... Until you finally make something completely unexpected real. For such extraordinary feats, no matter how big or small, I'll always give them my wholehearted applause.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: Settling for less? No. Never an option. It has to be my favorite and most satisfying choice... Others, you say? How they choose to handle things is never my problem, so naturally, I haven't the slightest care as to what they say.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: A perfectly ripe, plump fruit, fresh and begging to be eaten. You don't even have to pick it yourself. Just stand under the tree, and it'll drop right into your hands. Take a bite, and its cool, juicy sweetness flows out from the pulp... With all that said, why not try one together?

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: Ugh, protein dishes should be less greasy, lightly seasoned, and absolutely free of any gamey or fishy flavors. And mushy vegetables? Out of the question... And don't get me started on those foods with sticky, sloppy textures. They've got no strength at all! Also... What's that look on your face? I'm not finished yet!

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: Fight against fate? No, not exactly. In the end, I just willfully chose the freedom I wanted. When fate refuses to give people what they desire, they have to claim it themselves. I just happen to be greedy and blatant, taking what I want recklessly, honestly, and gracefully... As for the price, is there anything that doesn't come with it?

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: That bow, crafted from Lunarum Bough, was the last thing my father left me. I got it when I'd just decided to become a Priestess and prepared to leave for the Tetragon Temple, and never thought I'd need to use it back then. But over time, I realized I rather take fate into my own hands than spend my days praying to some higher power. And now, the one who once merely followed the moon's guidance and traces has become one who dominates and anchors its phases. This "lunar arc" has long been rooted in the causality of my story, tying my beginning to my end.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: Well, just as Grandmother Lillibet prophesized, I... Wait, haven't you already witnessed my whole past in the Chaos? It's so strange to repeat what others already know... B-but fine! I'll tell you again... But only because I'm gracious! And as I said before, don't tell anyone else! And don't you dare forget a single word!

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: Here's a little secret even Augusta doesn't know. When we first met, I told her she'd lead Septimont into a new era, and she believed it to be one of my prophecies. But really, it was just a hunch. I never peep into her fate because it's always been in her hands. She's the kind of ruler who'd sacrifice everything for her people, even her own flesh and blood. You don't need a coronation to see that. It's obvious at a glance. Yet, that kind of responsibility she carries is heavier than anyone else can imagine. Even though I know she can handle it alone, I still want to help somehow. As a Priestess, as a friend... or even as someone she has forgotten.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: After prophesizing about me, Grandmother Lillibet took me to the Tetragon Temple to teach me everything about fate. I'm never the obedient type, and she's more of the authoritative model of what Septimont expects in a Priestess. We rarely saw eye to eye on what makes the most gifted Priestess or how to handle fate and prophecies. But she never forced her views on me, never pushed me to be like her or any other Priestesses. She said rules only matter if they're worth following, and one is always free to choose as long as they do not harm others... She taught me that Priestesses aren't just symbols fixed on the wall, but living, breathing people, too.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: Anyone who's seen her matches probably feels the urge to challenge her as well, wouldn't you agree? Her passion for competition is really something... Pure, simple, and completely genuine. For her, victory and glory are just icing on the cake compared to the joy of the fight. She's not afraid to lose, but her passion always drives her to give her all and never back down, no matter the odds.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: He roared at fate with everything he had. Sure, that roar was swiftly reduced to whimpers, then silence, but we all heard it. It left its mark... I think he's more like the Hero of Heroes when he stops worrying about what that even means or what others expect from him.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: She and her family always manage to bring something fresh to Septimont and Ragunna, even to themselves. And before you know it, those little novelties spark whole new trend.... Me? Yep, I usually end up buying whatever it is. It's just hard to resist. She always gets what I like. Those Montellis, cunning as ever!

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: For a Priestess, the day of birth is the starting point that stretches towards the end. Hmm, a rather suitable line to mark the beginning of a prophecy. But the infinite possibilities of the void are already perfect. There's nothing more I could offer. So, I've prepared something else. See this little moon? It can change its phases. Take it and place it in your void. If you ever find the infinite paths ahead overwhelming, it will at least serve as an anchor of certainty... Happy Birthday, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: Iuno, the prodigy born under the lunar eclipse. The Priestess who sees the true future. Curious about what lies ahead? Come to me... But no promises of the perfect ending you seek.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: Beyond myself. Beyond every written start and end of the story. Till we rewrite our fate.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: Very well. I shall grant you enlightenment.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: Oh. What will you do without me?

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: I am the moon that never falls, here to rewrite the ending.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: My powers keep manifesting like my emotions, memories, and connections... You've become quite adept at this anchor job, haven't you?

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: From one moon to another, through endless cycles... until it's beyond measurement.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: Are you sure about this? Indulging my willfulness? Just so you know, if we keep this up, we might... fall into an unknown future scarier than Chaos!

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: Can I have anything else I want other than power? Think carefully before you answer. Once you say it, I won't stop until I get it.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: I see cold flames beyond the edge of reason. I see perfection rising from the shattered end. I see Chaos. I see illusions. I see truths. I see... you, the one who captured the moon.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: You dare test me? The insolence.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: Like it? I've got plenty more of that.

speaker: Iuno
anh_en: A windfall? Fate can be rather generous sometimes.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: <te href=260009>Mingting</te>'s eyes are everywhere. When war broke out in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, your profile was submitted to the Grand Library. Within the hour, the briefs reached me. Hm? How do I read these? It's simple: text-to-speech.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: Rules bind all. Those who breach them must be held to justice, regardless of background or past merits. The <te href=260001>Internal Security Agency</te>'s work is never simple. When Grandmaster Liang led, our every action fulfilled our duty to <te href=260009>Mingting</te> and <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>'s greater good. But much has changed since...

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: I'm blind, but I can still "see" what's in people's hearts. Arrogance, hatred, malice, pleasure... Through my mind's eye, they take form in shifting hues and silhouettes. But I can't see yours. A rare exception. Maybe, just as she once said—you are exactly as you are.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: For all these years, I've never tasted defeat. Being blind hasn't dulled me. In fact, it sharpens my focus on swordplay. If the opportunity arises, I'd welcome a duel with you.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: I once wielded this sword only for myself. Then, I drew it for the hand that saved me, and then for <te href=260009>Mingting</te>. But now, I am a drifter, my sword as aimless as my path... I can't see you, but I can feel your calling. Should you ever need, call my name. This hidden blade shall unsheathe again to defend your faith.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: Those years I stayed with Master Zhang, I cooked for his patients. Each meal was carefully crafted for their individual need. Beyond those, I know a few spicier dishes from Chongzhou. Whether they suit you, that, I cannot say.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: Agents of the <te href=260001>Internal Security Agency</te> work from a list—names to arrest, names to eliminate. It's all there. Now, only two names remain on mine: the Fractsidus operative who murdered the man who saved my life, and Geshu Lin. Blood debts are paid in blood. That's the natural order. Until my blade ends them, my mission will never end.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: Years ago, I'd just wrapped up a case in Yuezhou and had to rush back to <te href=260009>Mingting</te> overnight. I was exhausted and famished when I stumbled into a diner by the roadside. A bowl of rice, braised pork, a bottle of rice wine. A humble meal, yet nothing has ever filled me like that night.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: <te href=260009>Mingting</te> has a certain... drink. Greenish-gray, with a smell you don't forget. Trust me, you don't want to find out how it tastes...

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: Ideals, wishes... those things mean little to someone who lies down each night unsure if tomorrow comes. So I see no point in dwelling on them. All I know is I can't die yet. Not before I've had my revenge, not before I've fulfilled my duty. What happens after that... I'll leave that to fate to decide.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: This is not wine. It's medicine. I was on death's door in Chongzhou when Master Zhang saved me with this potent regimen. But it came at a cost. Ever since then, I've relied on it to "see" with my mind. It sharpens perception but brings the risk of madness. Most people aren't worth my blade, though. For them, this bamboo stick will do.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: Curious about my past? Heh... if that's what you want, I've no intention to hide. But maybe we should talk over a good pot of wine.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: My master once told me some of my ancestors moved from Chongzhou to the borderlands. Sanhua comes from that branch of lineage. Like me, her only interest used to be swordplay. But now, it seems she's found a purpose for her blade in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>'s <te href=850084>Magistrate</te>. I'm glad for her.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: In <te href=260009>Mingting</te>, people like me rarely got the chance to meet the high-ups—and understandably so. We only show up where there's trouble. As for her, all I know is that ever since she stepped down as Secretary-General, no one's been able to truly fill her place.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: Across the troops under <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>'s <te href=260010>Ministry of War</te>, you'd find no one other than him competent enough to earn the title of General at such a young age. I heard he used to be a medic before joining the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>... He's saving lives, one way or another.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: My knowledge of him only comes from the files. If we ever crossed blades, he wouldn't last three rounds without backup. Though <te href=260009>Mingting</te> brushed him aside like any other Fractsidus criminal, people in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> would scour the earth for him. Given the gravity of his crime, he's only asking to meet his end.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: Many tried to erase me because they wished to smother the truth. They wouldn't hesitate to murder anyone connected to me, just to bury the cases they're involved in... So, for my and everyone's best interests, the fewer people who know about me, the better.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: Happy birthday. As your path unfolds, more will join you on your journey. The world is like an inn we stay briefly before we set off on our destinations. Perhaps I'm just another passenger in your story, but on this special day, allow me to share this temporary shelter with you.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: Qiuyuan, a blade drawn at your word. Wield me as you will.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: Name the target. I'll take care of the rest.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: A blade is honed to strike.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: Clarity within, precision without. You've learned this well.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: A chance given is a future rewritten.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: A sharp sword is honed on whetstones, clashing blades, and shattered armor, then tempered in the fire of life. Even if it breaks, it must remain sharp.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: Since you've come this far, why not cross blades with mightier foes and test your mettle?

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: In my younger days, all I cared about was keeping my blade sharp. It once felt weightless in my hand. But now, with the lives I've touched and choices I carry, my blade seems to grow heavier with each swing. My skill never falters, but something has changed...

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: Your life, is mine to take.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: One strike, to settle it all.

speaker: Qiuyuan
anh_en: I'll repay your trust... in another life.

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: Hey, are you free next weekend? Want to come with me to <te href=700021>Bjartr Woods</te>? I know a secret spot there with lots of Dusk Honeypots!

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: These <te href=700026>Soliskin</te> are my friends. I know one day they'll eventually return to the Solistrees, turning into tiny sparks. It's sad when friends leave, of course. But they told me that this is their choice.

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: I've been studying these runes since I was very little. To me, they're never flat in my palm. They have depth. A piece of history, or a coordinate... like the grooves etched into Ashen Ironwood to mark the past. When I decipher them, I see projections of civilizations not yet known. What I see feels so vast that it makes me wonder. When I'm deciphering them... are they, in their own way, deciphering me?

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: After what happened, I called Mother and told her everything. About the riddles we solved together, how I'd been scared I wasn't good enough, and the times I almost gave up. And how every time, you were there to comfort me, telling me it was okay, even if I failed. Maybe that's how I managed to overcome the version of me in the Dark Side. Mother... She went quiet for a long time. When I asked if she was alright, she finally said, "You've been carrying so much all this time." I... I never thought she'd say that. But then I closed my eyes and thought: That feels really, really good.

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: Now, I want to learn more interesting things and see places I've never been. I won't run away from what everyone hopes for me, but I also want to listen to my own heart a little more. To try things that only I can experience. You've told me about so many amazing places, like <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, Septimont... If I ever get the chance, I'd really love to visit them! And when that day comes, would you come with me?

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: Back home, a hug means something special. When someone leaves, we send them off with a hug full of blessings. And when they return, we welcome them with a hug full of joy. The frostlands are so cold that it feels like the air itself might freeze. In a world like that, what you need most is the kind of warmth that's light as feathers. So... would you like a hug, Senior?

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: If possible, I really wish we could all stay friends for a long, long time. But... I know time has a will of its own.

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: Every time I leave home for school, Mother packs a huge jar of Fruit Crackle for me. She makes it all herself, and it's always so sweet. She wraps the jar carefully in ice so it stays crisp until I open it. That's why the jar always feels so heavy when I carry it… It's heavy with a warmth too big to hold.

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: Have you ever tried Grilled Fern Spore? Don't, seriously don't! It's so bitter just thinking about it makes me grind my teeth... If I ever had to eat something that awful, I'd rather eat at the cafeteria! Not that we actually call the cafeteria food "food," right? ...Wait, you're saying the cafeteria's serving Grilled Fern Spore Jelly tomorrow? Oh no, no, no, no! Grilled Fern Spore is already a nightmare, and jelly made from it? I...

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: I still want to live up to everyone's expectations! But now, I won't push myself too hard, and I won't stop just because I'm afraid of failing. Because now I know... this is the path I chose. And I want to give it everything I have!

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: This hair accessory? It was a gift from Father. He's always trekking across the frostlands, bringing home all sorts of strange trinkets. He used to tell me that our lives shouldn't end within <te href=700021>Bjartr Woods</te>. Well, someday, when I get the chance, I want to travel around too. Then maybe... I can bring back some interesting stories of my own, bright enough to make the little ones in the tribe smile.

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: When I was little, Mother would take me out to the frostlands to herd the <te href=700022>Exoswarm</te>. At night, I'd lie on their backs and look up at the stars, one by one. Mother said stars are the endpoint of a riddle. She would connect them, one to another. And just like that… everything looked different! The stars were no longer scattered pieces of gold. Each one held its own meaning. That was my first understanding of "riddles." What is a riddle? What is the solving? What is the answer? The riddle is the <ano=Rune>starry sky</ano> itself. The solving is finding the hidden connections within it. And the <ano=True Name>answer</ano>… is in the very moment you see those connections come together.

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: Nia always says, "If you can't finish it, just drop it. Toss away whatever's hard or sad. Running away makes everything so much easier." But whenever I'm up late studying, she's always right there beside me. Sometimes I think… maybe she's actually the one who least wants to run away. She never talks about herself, so I can't quite see what's going on in her heart. Still... I hope we can stay friends for a very, very long time.

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: Lynae always comes and goes like the wind. Wherever she passes, she leaves behind these dazzling colors. Those colors are her riddles, and the smile on her face? That's always the answer.

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: I really, really love Fleet Snowfluff's songs! But the last time she held a fan meeting, I was out on a frostlands field study... I-I hope I'll get another chance to attend! I would love to see her!

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: After the New Solar Celebration incident, some students said we should make a banner for Dr. Luuk. It seems that whenever someone's feeling down, he's always there, checking on them, talking with them for as long as they need. They suggested things like "<te href=851069>Startorch</te>'s Best Counselor" or "Best Doctor and Best Advisor." But if you ask me… I think I'd just write, "The One Who Always Has Candy."

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: President Lucilla's classes are so much fun. When she taught the history of Royan clothing, she even turned it into an impromptu styling workshop! But getting into her classes is almost impossible. Every time the course listings go up, I have to glue myself to the screen and click as fast as I can, or they'll be gone in seconds! And on the professor review forum, her page is just full of students complaining, "How can someone who teaches everything have classes that fill up in seconds?!"

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: Today's your birthday, right? Happy birthday, my dearest Senior! This whole box of gifts is for you! Look! A jar of Fruit Crackle, a scarf woven with rune blessings, and a fluffy Soliskin plushie… and this Sunstone I made. No matter where you are, it'll always point you toward the sun. I hope sunlight always follows you, and that every wish you make comes true!

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: Smile for the camera... Three, two, one...

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en:
Hello. Mother—Mm, I'm doing well. Made a few new friends...
How are you doing? ...Yes, I know. Just promise me you're looking after yourself.
I really want to eat the Fruit Crackle you make... 
My grades? Oh, not bad! Come on, don't worry about me! Yes, yes, I will. I promise...

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: Hi, I'm Sigrika! Want to understand the meaning of runes? Need a hand with something? Then I'm the one to ask!

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: I'll keep all of this in my heart forever.

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: The runes will be our guide.

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: Now, time to mark the next starting point...

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: When the True Name is unveiled, the rune illuminates.

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: I can see more now... So that's what was troubling me all along.

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: From something flat to something with great depth, the meaning of the runes unfolds before my eyes. It feels infinite...

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: Am I... crying? I-I never imagined I would touch the True Names themselves. They're beautiful, dazzling... To come this far and see so much... Thank you, Senior.

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: Can I keep going like this?

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: Couldn't live up to... those expectations...

speaker: Sigrika
anh_en: A reward for solving a riddle.
This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.
It is natural to feel dreadful of the unknown, yet... there are times when the unknown harbors hope, like how I can never know what else this power has to offer.
We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.
I will be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.
The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.
This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.
I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.
A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.
The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: Do you know? The little flower next to you really likes you! I heard it talking about it. Plants talk in a silent and sincere language. I can translate their talk for you, if you want.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: You saw me in the Dim Forest late at night? My bad, I was probably too caught up waiting for a Noctemint to blossom to notice you. Those plants wait their whole lives for that one bloom. I think they'd be happy to have someone there, witnessing and recording it all.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: O-of course we can talk about something other than plants. I do take breaks from the greenhouse, you know. Um... Do you like Morri Pot? The various types of mushrooms in it are so... What? M-mushrooms are not plants. They're fungi!

speaker: Verina
anh_en: When you have the time, how about we take a walk together? The world is going to look very different when you don't have a particular destination in mind. Want to give it a try?

speaker: Verina
anh_en: Sometimes, it feels like the two of us are dandelion seeds, drifting wherever the wind takes us. We have our ups and downs, just like weathering a storm, but one day we may finally land and flourish, after a good rain. Rover, as fellow travelers, let's embrace what lies ahead, wherever and whenever we may be. To me, that's what truly makes life worth living.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: During my free time, I enjoy strolling around <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> on my own. Every brick and tile looks slightly different from one another, and I can find resilient little flowers growing in the cracks. The streets are always bustling with people, and the smell of steaming food brings a cozy atmosphere. Whenever I wander around and take in all these sights and sensations, I feel... hmm, is "invigorated" the right word for it?

speaker: Verina
anh_en: I've noticed a trend of people sharing Terminal-generated images online, saying those must be new plant species. While I understand their interest and curiosity, I'm worried this could mislead the public. As a botanist myself, I always try to be accurate and honest when I'm sharing information about plants.
