I've been wanting to find a way to help people tell the difference between fake images and real photos, but it seems there's still a lot of work to do. What should I do...

speaker: Verina
anh_en: My mom always said milk would help me grow taller, like how plants need fertilizer. And every time I drink it, I feel warm and cozy. Maybe that's what happiness feels like.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: I'm not a big fan of big, greasy dishes—like steaks... It's not that they aren't tasty, I just hate the idea of letting food go to waste if I can't finish it. It doesn't sit right with me...

speaker: Verina
anh_en: Maintaining a balanced ecosystem is no easy feat, especially when it involves regulating the population of various species. But what if we could grow flowers that have a calming effect on the <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>? This could greatly reduce the strain on our frontline soldiers and potentially save lives.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: My adventure journal isn't just about plants. Check it out - this story is about an old lady patiently waiting for a flower to bloom, and this one is about an adventurer going all out to snap a photo of a rare type of grass. Each leaf represents a unique story that has bloomed into something beautiful. I wrote them down to remember every one of these stories.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: When I was little, I thought showcasing the beauty of flowers would make people appreciate and protect them... Reality hit me hard when I saw people plucking and flaunting expensive flowers instead. It used to upset me, but then I'd remind myself: Verina, remember the value of every plant's life. Remember what mom and dad had wanted you to do.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: H-here. This <te href=850133>Starflower</te> is for you, and it represents... hope and miracles. Happy birthday! Sorry, I'm not really used to celebrating other people's birthdays yet, erm... Yeah. I just want you to always be happy, Rover.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: Wow, such a rare species! It's my lucky day!

speaker: Verina
anh_en: Can you hear it? Shh... That's the sound of sprouting.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: I'm Verina. If you come across any plants that pique your interest, do let me know! Huh? You want me to go on field researches with you? Of-of course! It's my honor. But it can get quite dangerous out in the wild. Please be careful and stay close to me.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: Sprouting marks the inception of a plant's journey, a tiny miracle in motion.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: As I grow, even my breaths feel lighter...

speaker: Verina
anh_en: Now is the time to bloom... I didn't realize I was holding my breath. Look. It's so beautiful!

speaker: Verina
anh_en: Look, it's bearing tiny fruits! Another miracle, but the journey of a plant doesn't end here.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: Miss Yangyang was curious about my plant growing skills, and she asked me many questions earlier. Then, she patiently listened to me explaining details for a long, long time. Hanging out with her feels like basking in a gentle breeze.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: Miss Chixia once fed me a spoonful of her Victor Savor... I-I couldn't believe how spicy it was! What kind of pepper was that? Ow, my mouth still burns just thinking about it.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: Did you know? "Baizhi" is actually an old name for Angelica, a plant that can bloom beautiful flowers in freezing temperatures. It kinda makes me think of Miss Baizhi herself—some might say she seems a bit chilly, but I have a feeling she's got a warm and gentle heart underneath.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: Mr. Mortefi's dedication to his work is remarkable, but I do worry about his well-being... I mean, we all know how important the research project is, but a good night's sleep is just as crucial! Whenever I go and check on the nocturnal plants at night, I can see the lights on in his lab from a distance.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: Little Encore is full of intriguing ideas, and she always has a lot of curious questions to ask. Hmm... I've got to keep looking for all the answers she wants. Oh, you're wondering why I call her "little"? Hehe, we're just playing big sister and little baby.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: I remember meeting Mr. Calcharo when I was out collecting data in the wild. At first, he didn't seem very approachable... but then he gave me some flower seeds, all super rare species. He's so awesome.

speaker: Verina
anh_en: This flower is for you. I hope it makes you happy!

speaker: Verina
anh_en: As of late, my thoughts have turned to the wondrous ways in which life flourishes. The fish dance in the sea, the trees root deep in the earth, and the birds take flight in the sky...all thriving and growing in unique ways. You seem to always inspire me to new wonders, too... Would you like to hear about them?

speaker: Verina
anh_en: Are those little flowers growing inside?

speaker: Verina
anh_en: It's nature's gift! Let's keep it well.

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: Hey, I've been hearing about you for ages! How? <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te> has stations everywhere, so news travels fast! And, in case you don't know, you're the talk of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>!

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: This Terminal ringtone? Yeah, I made it! Thought it'd be a cool way to get the <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te> name out there… It's catchy, right? My colleagues thought so too and all started using it. Now it's ringing everywhere.

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: This is Squeakie, my plushie. Here, give it a squeeze—isn't it adorable? I made it when I first joined <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te>. Everything was new, I mean, scarily new… and I was super nervous about the job… So having Squeakie around was such a comfort!

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: My nail polish is all chipped off… Time for a new color! When I first moved to the city, I tried all sorts of looks so I could fit in, but always ended up looking silly! Now… Now I've found my own style. So, what color d'you think I should go with?

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: I never left my village growing up, but once I did, I became a restless traveler. Riding my bike with the wind in my ears just feels amazing. I keep meeting new people, and saying goodbye to them… it's all part of the journey, isn't it? I bet you're the same, always on the move. Great way of living, right? I think... we'll surely meet again somewhere down the road. And when we do, let's grab some local food and catch up on our adventures!

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: I jot down all the interesting sights, people, and events in my travel journal. If words don't cut it, I sketch it out. I've filled up so many journals since joining <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te>!

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: There's never enough time! Delivering packages, planning new routes, catching up with friends, keeping my journal... Oh I wish I could be in a million places at once！

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: Rice noodles are my absolute favorite! Spice it up with chili, a dash of vinegar, sprinkle some green onions... delicious! Next time you're in Yuezhou, I'll treat you!

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: Hmm... What did they call it? Some local speciality noodle I tried during a delivery, with this golden fish broth and green veggies. Did NOT taste as good as it looked—ugh, it was so bitter! Never again!

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: Wow, ever since we got a road in our village, things have been crazy! We've built so much new stuff. I've been keeping an eye on my team, making sure everyone's good—some want promotions, some need more cash for their fams, and some wanna travel. Hehe, busy days, but it feels great to be needed... I should keep it up!

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: This on my head? It's my employee ID badge. Clipped it to my hair to save myself the fumbling when I'm carrying stuff. Now everyone knows my name in a snap. Perfect!

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: That day, I left my village, hiked over the mountain, farther than anyone else had gone before. I soon found myself in a vast field, the air fresh and damp with dew. I was so pumped that I started to glow, and the light attracted <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>... Did everything I could to fight them off, then I blacked out. Next thing I knew, a <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te> team saved me, their lights cutting through the darkness, the brightest I've ever seen.

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: When I am out delivering packages, I can't always find a place to stay, so sometimes I rest outdoors. Once, I woke up to see Miss Jianxin napping on a boulder on the cliff edge! She seemed... so light, like a feather...

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: Ma Xiao...oops, I mean Chixia, hehe! Ahem, <te href=850087>Patroller</te> Chixia's packages are mostly snacks and hero play merchs. She was so stoked last time she got one, she practically bounced out of the room!

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: Youhu's packages always come with insurance, full of pricey antiques. I don't know much about these stuff, but the way she handles them, you can tell they're her treasures.

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: Researcher Baizhi's packages weigh a ton! Mostly stacks of books, thick ones, and a bunch of other weird stuff. Said those are for research purposes...

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: Actually, I rarely get to meet Miss Zhezhi in person… She's a night owl, barely out during the day. So I've been dropping her paints and paper at her door.

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: Auntie Panhua's letting me use her stove today. In my village, we celebrate birthdays with steaming longevity noodles like this, topped with two braised eggs! Hey, you gotta slurp it all in one go, no biting allowed! Hehe… Happy birthday! May your journey ahead always be bright.

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: Squeakie! Enough playing with the letter!

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: Greetings! Lumi here! Need to send some mail? I've got you covered as <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te>' professional navigator!

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: Don't worry, my light's got you!

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: A new page in my journal!

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: Is it just me, or is the light bulb on my tail brighter than before?

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: To chart new routes for <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te>, physical training is a must.

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: You're an amazing teacher! Didya know? Squeakie's jumping higher and faster after your pointers!

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: They used to call me Jolly Sun in my village. I prefer Lumi though! The sun sets at night, but I'm always ready to illuminate someone's way home!

speaker: Lumi
anh_en: So, you are saying I'm already a top-notch navigator? Really?… No, no, don't get too comfortable, Lumi! There's still a long way to go, gotta keep it up!

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: I had pictured our reunion in my head, again and again, after your departure. I wondered what kind of person you would become, how your days were spent, and if you achieved your goals. Countless questions filled my mind, but when I saw you again, there was only one thing I wanted to say: Welcome back. Back to the Black Shores, and… back to my side.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: Time changes everything—Blake Blooms, Stellar Matrices, and <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>—all constantly in flux. I've documented these changes, repairing the damage and preserving the good. Yet, I wonder... Am I doing enough? Have I earned your trust? These questions haunt me, but I press on, seeking solace in my work.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: Your past... I promised to keep it a secret, at your own request. That day, I realized our reunion would be one-sided. This is why your memory loss didn't surprise me... But it doesn't matter now. You may have forgotten me, but I will remember everything about you, always.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: Humans dream to fulfill their desires. For a long time, I believed such dreams were not meant for me, as I had never yearned for anything. Until one day... I dreamed of you. We were strolling through an unfamiliar land, basking in the warm sunlight. You showed me your world and shared stories of your past. You even brewed a cup of tea for me... Though only a figment of my imagination, I wished that moment could last a little longer.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: Next time you journey to distant lands, could you bring me along? I don't want to watch from afar or hear secondhand about your adventures. I long to experience the unknown by your side, as your friend... Please, will you give me the chance?

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: Pressing a piano key creates an enchanting sound from the vibrating strings. Unlike other frequencies I've processed, a piano produces a pure, clear, and vivid tone. If I could one day communicate my emotions as simply and intuitively as humans do... If I could create my own melodies, would you be my first listener?

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: I cannot physically grow and age, and therefore can never truly comprehend the range of emotions that come with it as a human does. Despite my wealth of knowledge and ability to replicate others' experiences through the <te href=850077>Sonoro</te>, these feelings remain enigmatic to me, forever distant and unfamiliar.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: Long ago, during our days together at <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, you used to prepare chowder for us, blending milk, seafood, and vegetables. One spoonful of its warmth could dispel the freezing sea wind and restore stamina. Despite multiple attempts, I cannnot seem to recreate that flavor.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: The food I hate... Hmm, hate might be too strong a word, but I tend to steer clear of pickled food, like preserved plums. While I appreciate their long shelf life, the fermented smell reminds me of their preserved nature.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: My purpose had been clear long before my creation: to build a safe haven from the unrelenting waves of the <te href=850075>Lament</te>, until humanity could find a path to a brighter tomorrow. It used to be my duty, but now... it is a choice. I am one with <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>. I want to prevent more tragedies from happening, I want to protect everyone, I... I want to safeguard my connection with the world around me. This is my own will.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: Ah, so you've noticed the crystal on my chest. It's not an adornment, but a fissure brimming with the energy emanating from my body. Through it, you can touch the core I've managed to keep safe since my creation. It resembles the kernel of a fruit, or the beating heart of a human, where the essence of life is preserved.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: <te href=850076>Remnant Energy</te> coalesced into a crystal cocoon on a moonlit shore, stirred by the crashing waves, and the breath and heartbeat of a certain individual. That person then infused it with {Male=his;Female=her} own frequencies, and the butterfly within finally emerged... Yes, you've guessed it. You are the one I speak of, the force that gave me life and form.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: Though her words may not always align with her actions, she remains fiercely loyal to her desires. Her carefree lifestyle holds a certain charm, yes, but we were made differently, with distinct objectives to pursue. Following your example, I've allowed her to make her own choices, without limitations.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: A mature organization requires a personable and skilled negotiator, adept at forging connections with all they encounter. In the case of <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, that person is Aalto. His keen insight ensures he obtains crucial information precisely when needed. Beneath his playful smile lies a resolute determination to end the <te href=850075>Lament</te>. Despite other offers, he was destined for the Black Shores' path from the start.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: Encore sees the world as a canvas for her boundless imagination. A warrior, a knight, or a little adventurer... In her tales, she can become anyone she wants to triumph over evil and reach a happy ending. Wherever she ventures, her radiant energy dispels dismay. Perhaps this is what <te href=850110>Tethys</te> saw in her when she was chosen.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: Atop this massive Tacetite lies the ideal "singularity" spot to observe the <te href=850075>Lament</te>. This is where we formed <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, its members distinguished by their Blake Blooms. Beneath the endless stars, humanity's light glimmers. That light belongs to those who had given their lives to illuminate a brighter future for all. I've welcomed countless such people into this place... and bid farewell to just as many.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: The <te href=850110>Tethys</te> System and I are creations of the same civilization, and we are bound by similar obligations. By human standards, we are of the same kind. Yet, our perceptions of emotions, humanity, and existence diverge, leading us down distinctly separate paths.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: Happy birthday, {PlayerName}. You once taught me a person's birthday is their most important day. So, I've made it a habit to prepare something in advance for days like this... Please have this crystal—it's a piece of myself. Hold it, and you'll be enveloped in a personalized <te href=850077>Sonoro Sphere</te>, where you can change everything to your liking. Though I cannot bring you what you truly want, let me gift you a peaceful dream to escape your worries.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: The stars rest in silence, awaiting their fated journey.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: Worry not if you don't remember me... I can always introduce myself again. I am the Shorekeeper, acting executive of <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, and the core computational unit of <te href=850110>Tethys</te>. Now and forever, I will stand by you and our home, through every yesterday and tomorrow.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: The Shorekeeper... This name suits me well enough. It aligns with my purpose and drive: they only exist because of you.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: Understood. I am here to serve your will.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: I'll fulfill it, be it a direct command or any other wish you have.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: Your return has cast a glimmer of change into my prolonged existence. It allows me to gain some understanding of a world beyond my reach.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: The energy within me gathers and evolves... like delicate threads on a loom, meticulously woven by your hands into a new part of my being.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: My crystal seems to glow brighter. I sense your warmth on my skin, flowing from your touch, reaching deep inside my chest.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: I believe I have received an invaluable treasure from you... Something infinitely close to what humans call a "soul."

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: I lack a heart, yet my chest stirs whenever I see you. Thump, thump... I would compare it to the emergence of a butterfly, or the birth of a star; not a sudden rush, but a gradual, growing pulse. I want more of you. Yearn to be with you always. This longing I feel… I am certain now. It must be love.

speaker: Shorekeeper
anh_en: Please have them. I hope they will prove useful.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: Shhh.... how come you're all here? Ah, sorry {PlayerName}, didn't mean to disturb you. I just wanted to pay you a visit. Didn't expect these guys to tag along...

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: {PlayerName}, how did you meet Abby? Sorry, I don't mean to pry, it's just the two of you are inseparable, always looking out for each other, always trusting one another. It's wonderful, Abby must be... like family.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: I know disciples of the Order should not form "attachments" to <te href=850082>Echoes</te>. But they're my dear friends, and that will never change. This must be one of the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s trials, a test to see if I can fulfill my duties as an <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> while holding onto such... ties. It's a good test of my resolve. It's just, every time I see them, I want to hug them tightly... No, no, no, I must resist!

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: You always seem so busy, but I hardly ever see you resting... Are you, perhaps, having trouble sleeping? If that's the case, I can help. Just a little tap with my staff and your mind will be at ease... Hmm? Where are you going? It won't hurt at all...

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: Balloons soaring into the bright blue sky, people and <te href=850082>Echoes</te> rejoicing under rainbows... When the <te href=850103>Laurel</te> was placed upon your head, I felt so happy. This <te href=850102>Carnevale</te> has been spectacular in every way, and it will remain etched in my heart forever.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: When I was little, I loved going to Whisperwind Haven with friends. We'd lie on slopes surrounded by flowers and watch the clouds drift by. Tilly would play their accordion, and Livia and Brenno would weave all sorts of garlands that left a wonderful scent in their wake. I still go back sometimes... in secret.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: I saw shadows where light could not reach. What if the path I once believed in so fervently was never the right one? Then... No, never mind. Please don't mind me...

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: Something smells so good... It must be Miss Margherita's pizza cooked to perfection by Bakie... No, no, no, this month's Pizza Day already passed. What is Pizza Day you ask? It's the only day of the month we were allowed pizza at the orphanage. Even though I don't go hungry anymore, as an <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> I must resist gluttony.... Besides, the best pizza is one that's shared with friends.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: Everything we eat comes from the good earth created by the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>. According to Them, "Our bodies are vessels for our souls." Therefore, we must sustain that vessel with things that are beneficial to it, such as those found in the sacred Viscum Berry. I still have a few left, would you like to try one? The Codex says sharing makes life sweeter...

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: I hope for children to be by their parent's side. For sailors to return home after long voyages. For all to soar, free as birds. For people to come together despite their differences. For the <te href=850075>Lament</te> to not drive people apart... Huh? What do I hope for myself? I hope... I...

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: This locket was a gift from my father. I always thought it had sunk with that merchant ship, but here it is again in my hands. This itself is already a miracle... I cannot ask for more.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: When I was a child, I awoke on a dark shore. I walked that shore for what felt like forever until I saw a light... a few kind <te href=850100>Acolytes</te> of the Order brought me to a brightly lit room. They fed me, sheltered me, and treated me well. Eventually, they became my adoptive family... Sometimes when the rain lashed out at night, Livia and Brenno would cuddle up next to me until I fell asleep. With them at my side... I never felt lonely.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: Mother once told me a story about an adventurer braving storms in search of freedom. When I saw Brant on stage, he reminded me of that adventurer, caring for naught while the ocean thrashes around him... Sometimes, I think Mr. Brant chooses to act out a life of equal parts comedy and tragedy.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: Miss Roccia might appear ice cold, but at heart, I know she is a gentle and caring person. Her kindheartedness brings smiles to all those around her. And then there's her friend, <te href=850122>Pero</te>. I wonder if there's any chance Pero could also be my friend?

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: ...I once dreamt of a black sea, with swells growing larger and more violent. Amidst the spray, the Blessed Maiden appeared—or at least I think it was her. Something in that swaying silhouette resembled her, yet it also felt so unlike her...

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: Not everyone in <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> worships the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>. Certain <te href=850100>Acolytes</te> of the Order believe a person's worth is solely measured by their piety... But Miss Zani is brave and dependable, which just might be enough to overcome existing prejudices. After all, she's such a reliable and respectable person.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: Happy Birthday! Ooh... confetti! Just like how Mama and Papa used to celebrate. Here, take this, a bluebird set with aquamarine gemstones. A little something to be by your side through winds and storms. Like this statue, may your eyes always be bright, and may luck always be with you. Your path is not one ordained by the Sentinel, but one of your own making. And no matter where you go, I will always pray for you.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: May Thy love endure forever, never ceasing.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: Hm... Eh? Oh, there you are! Who's a good boy...

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: I'm Phoebe, an <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> of the <te href=850099>Order</te>. Praise the Sentinel. May They guide you to compassion and enlightenment.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: I resolve disputes in the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s name.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: May the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> guide those who are lost.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: The sparkling sea knows no bounds.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: Do I have what it takes to fight the forces of darkness?

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: Your light has shown me a world I had never seen.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: Thanks to you, my light will shine upon those in need.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: Held aloft by the rapids, I saw a golden glow... Your wisdom and grace have become gospel which I shall forever hold dear.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: Dark forces approach, be on guard.

speaker: Phoebe
anh_en: Cherish the gift not given lightly.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: So, {PlayerName}, were you satisfied with how I handled your reception before the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te>? Why bring this up now, you ask? Well, gathering client feedback is part of my job. As the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family's esteemed guest, your opinion naturally holds a special weight for me.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: For an employee of the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family, appearance is everything. No matter how busy the day gets, always present yourself flawlessly. The Employee Manual puts it best: "Impeccable etiquette and attire give you the upper hand in negotiations."

speaker: Zani
anh_en: I don't hate work or overtime, so long as it serves a purpose. If I'm forced to sit idly at a desk doing nothing or sacrifice my personal time on trivial tasks... Then what I'm earning isn't a salary, it's compensation for the piece of my soul that's been taken.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: You look tired, {PlayerName}. I understand you're shouldering some heavy burdens. But I suggest you catch a break whenever you can. You don't want to end up like me. Once I pulled my first overtime, I soon found myself working around the clock. Trust me, saving the world can wait.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: I used to think life was nothing but living the same day on repeat. Grinding through trivialities, running in circles until even the smallest joys faded away. But then you came along, just as I'd grown numb to this way of living. Like the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te> itself, you brought a burst of color into my life.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: I love my job! Really. No joke. Was I smiling? No? Then you get the idea.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Listen, efficiency is everything at work. It's all about hitting the nail on the head. Some people just don't get it. Instead, they waste so much time on unimportant details, prioritizing form over substance. A shame, really. That won't solve anything. All it does is complicate things even more.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: My go-to restaurant is Trattoria Margherita. Nothing fills my stomach and soothes my soul quite like a slice of pizza freshly baked by Signorina Margherita after a long day at work.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Employees of the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family swear by espresso—straight, no sugar or milk—to keep themselves energized. But as for me, work is already hard enough... I'd rather treat myself to something sweet.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: I grew up in <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, and I know every corner of this city like the back of my hand. The sea breeze that greets you, the bustling plaza filled with familiar faces, the shiny new products in shop windows, the aroma of food from Trattoria Margherita. I hope this quiet life never ends. I hope everyone finds their place. For me, that would be enough.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Hmm? Why is this pocket watch so big? Well, this is not a pocket watch per se, but an alarm clock. In the early days when I worked for the <te href=850101>Montellis</te>, I almost caused a major incident by being late. After that, I've carried this alarm clock with me everywhere and I haven't been late since.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: My past? Nothing worth mentioning, really. I clock in, do my work, clock out—then do it all over again. Now and then, I straighten out a few troublemakers. Were you expecting some "white-collar hero saves the day" kind of story? Then you've read too many comic books.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Lady Carlotta? Her vision has never been limited to <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, or even <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>. Hers was about the world beyond the sea horizon. I don't know what kind of future she sees, but I'll stand by her until the day her vision becomes reality.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: To me, <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>'s fate lies in the will of its people, not the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>. Many <te href=850100>Acolytes</te> would call this heresy, but not Phoebe. That's what makes her unique. She would never dismiss another's beliefs or efforts just because they do not align with her own.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: The <te href=850094>Fisalia</te> family has always clung to <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>'s traditions, stubbornly resisting change. But Signorina Cantarella, the current head, isn't as traditional as people imagine. As an employee, I do not get to influence how the <te href=850101>Montellis</te> handle their relationship with the Fisalias... but personally, I wouldn't mind working with her.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Brant is a skilled actor, a respected captain, and a fighter willing to sacrifice everything for truth and justice. But what I envy most is that he's never weighed down by stacks of paperwork. If I knew anything about acting, I'd quit this job, join the <te href=850108>Troupe of Fools</te>, and live the carefree life he does... Now, now. Just a pipe dream to keep me going.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: I've seen Ciaccona perform a few times outside the city. She often sings about <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>'s old folklore. I once asked her if she thought the age of heroes described in her poems had ended, whether heroes had already exited the stage of history. She answered that as long as there is suffering, someone will rise up to be the new hero.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: It's your birthday today right? According to <te href=850097>Ragunnesi</te> tradition, we must put aside all work and throw a grand party with all our friends. Nobody leaves before midnight! Rest assured, I've already lined everything up in Palazzo Agrotta. Today, my job is to make sure you have all the fun.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Alright, where are we off to next?

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Time to get back to work.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: I am Zani. I work for the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family. Hmm? Oh, that's not eyeshadow. It's proof of my hard work, a badge of honor for my dedication. Ha, if I keep saying that, I might actually start believing it myself.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Alright, what's the first thing on today's to-do list?

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Is that the alarm... Alright, time to work.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: As the Montelli saying goes, "A blade only stays sharp if it's regularly honed." Even if it's just for work, exercise is necessary.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Hmm? Have I become more... productive? How am I supposed to act busy now...

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Such radiant lights... I hope it shines on every shadow and leaves no darkness to hide in.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Ah, such power... Perfect. Now I can be the shield that protects more people.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Words alone can't repay all you've done for me. Now, it's my turn to fight for you. Happen to need an unbreakable sword or a shield that can withstand anything?

speaker: Zani
anh_en: And that was me holding back.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: I can spare a minute to knock some heads around.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: All of you at once. I don't do overtime.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Ugh, now I have a report to write.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: My shield can withstand more than that.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: No… I've still got work to do...

speaker: Zani
anh_en: I'm off duty, it's your turn.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Fine. Comes with the job, I guess.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: Some pocket money? Won't say no to that.

speaker: Zani
anh_en: I'll take it as my overtime fee.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: This nickel-plated pair of scissors weighs about 152 grams. Its max opening angle is roughly 60 degrees. Just enough to cut through thick wool, even with quilted fleece hidden in the seam. I've always been able to estimate numbers like that, even as a little girl. But after that strange and terrifying power descended upon me, I started seeing more. Now, even a single inch feels like an entire world.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: When I was little, I'd sit on the porch of our house, listening to cicadas while cutting colored paper into goldfish and lucky stars. My mother would be nearby, stitching a yukata. The electric fan creaked as it turned, and slow midday dramas played on the TV... Now that I think about it, summers like that were kind of a luxury.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: In Honami, summer never ends. But there are no cicadas. No evening wind chimes. Only the endless loop of the Lament... Sometimes, I find old boxes of sugar candy in abandoned convenience stores. Normally, living beings shouldn't feel hunger inside a Sonoro Sphere. But that sugary taste always brings back memories of festivals back home, candy in hand... Sorry, I guess none of that really matters.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: I... I'm not good with faces. When I was little, people always said I got stuck on the details. But ever since faces started blurring in front of me, I've had to rely on that instead. In this Sonoro, "death" is only temporary. Those who disappear always show up again like nothing happened. So I take notes. The grease stain on the shopkeeper's sleeve across the road. The shape of the clerk's hair clip in the convenience store. That way, even if their faces are a blur, I still know who they are.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: Since grade school, I was what people called a "straight-A student." Steady grades. Perfect attendance. Neat handwriting. Homework always early. Not a single crease in my textbooks. For most people, that's enough... and I don't mind that. People have always trusted me for those reasons, without ever really knowing me. But with you, it's different. You didn't come to me because you saw "I was performing well." You didn't stay because I seemed "reliable." \nWe've stood together on the edge of this city's collapse, again and again.  That's why I wanted to say this. Like you said... we're partners. So of course I trust you, too.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: Handcrafting, tailoring, plus... mathematics. Yes, I'd say I'm quite good at these.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: It's probably my lack of facial expressions. A lot of people think I'm "difficult to approach." It's not that I dislike anyone. I just don't know... how to approach people in a natural way.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: Chocolate bars... A former classmate gave me one once and said something like, "Keep frowning like that and your blood sugar's gonna crash." Didn't really get the science behind it. But after trying one... I started keeping a few boxes on hand. They're good for a quick energy boost, and they keep my head clear. That's the main reason I have them.\n...But I do have to admit that chocolate is better than strawberry.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: Spicy food. I tasted some <te href=850093>Huanglong</te> cuisines while I was at the Black Shores, and they were... unique. It was the first time I was annoyed by my lack of tolerance for spice. But maybe this could change with enough practice? I'll have to try more.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: ...I don't have any grand ideals. I just know that if I see something happening, I can't pretend I didn't. If my abilities can help, even a little, then I'll keep using them.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: These small scissors I carry with me were a present from my mother. She used them her entire career as a seamstress. Later, I used them to alter my new school uniform I wore to orientation. It didn't quite fit, so I adjusted it myself. They feel like an invisible thread my parents stitched into me. Silent, yet always pulling me forward.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: The day they put this collar on me, it happened to rain in my hometown. I watched the downpour and rolling stormclouds through the window, and oddly enough, I felt a sense of relief. My Resonance Ability had been restrained. And I told myself, "Now they won't hate you anymore."

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: Sumika was the first to uncover the "loop pattern" of the <te href=850077>Sonoro</te>. We used to pull all-nighters at the safe house, crunching data. I needed coffee to stay focused, but she always stayed sharp. Honestly, even borderline manic. But I knew how deeply she wanted to understand the truth behind the city's Lament. Maybe that's just the nature of a true researcher. Like she said, even the most dangerous equation still needs someone willing to solve it.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: Born of love. Always kind and dependable... That's the Guardian of Honami City. Or at least, that's how it likes to introduce itself. Being around Namipon feels peaceful. Hard to explain. Sometimes it follows me, quietly. I won't notice until it brushes up against me, soft fur against my arm, asking if I want coffee. But there's something more beneath that face. Something vast. Maybe it's just... trying to return the love people once gave it.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: She's a very fascinating Taoist. If I remember correctly, she's from <te href=850154>Mengzhou</te>, in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>? She's always saying odd metaphors and local sayings, and showing off the rare antiques she carries around. Once even offered me a "Buy two, get 20% off" deal. Maybe... I'll take her up on it. Just to see.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: Shorekeeper helped me a lot while I've been recovering at <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>. It took me a while to settle in, but in time, I started to feel the kindness there. Shorekeeper once took me to the beach at the Haven of Sprouts to see the stars. They were infinite. And I found myself thinking... Sumika must've stood beneath that same sky many times, imagining the future she hoped to reach.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: A birthday... isn't just the anniversary of your birth. It's also a reminder that you're still here. For me, that alone makes it important.\nSo... please continue to stay healthy, level-headed, endlessly capable, and someone others can count on. May each of your days pass smoothly, and may there always be someone walking alongside you.\n—That's the most concise and practical birthday wish I could come up with.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: Hmm… That's not it. It's this one.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: Kuchiba Chisa. Tactical Development Program, Department of Engineering, Startorch Academy. Forte Specialization: structural dissection... Apologies, this might not be the time for formalities.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: ...The threads. I see them more clearly now.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: The structure is more complex, but also... more distinctly identifiable.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: My Resonance energy continues to expand... Don't worry, I can control it.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: This wasn't by chance, nor was it coincidental. The deadlock has cracked. We'll fight alongside each other... just like before.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: No matter where this leads… This battle, I'm all in.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: There's still time… before the threads snap.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: Is this as far as I go…?

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: In the blink of an eye.

speaker: Chisa
anh_en: New supplies… This'll last us a few more days.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: Hey, you! Brought you some snacks. Nice day, huh? Whaddya say we get some scorch marks on the road? Oh, and I heard the cafeteria is serving some weird new dish. We should try it for lunch! Oh yeah, I also heard the Film Club is screening an old New Federation film this afternoon that I've always wanted to watch! Interested? And then tonight we could... Oh. Uh, yeah, my bad. Should I...? Yeah, I'll let you keep sleeping.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: New spray cans, odd parts for my seniors, candy from Sigrika... Just a few souvenirs from the last school event. Yeah, just tidying up. You barely notice it happening, then all of a sudden you look around and your room's full of this stuff. Can't bring myself to toss any of it. Weird, right? There was a time I wouldn't even let myself have a potted plant. I'd just have to leave it behind anyway, ya know? Oh, I've got you something. Here. I finished painting this Exostrider model yesterday. Not bad, huh? Looks just like the real thing.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: When I first got to <te href=851069>Startorch</te>, I used to wake up in a cold sweat... wondering if I could really just live like this. I kept waiting for the other shoe to drop. I was chasing this fragile, perfect idea of freedom all day, and then running from my old self in my dreams at night. Just... waiting for the bill to come. So I started making every choice like it was my last day here. "What would I do if this were it?" Yeah, and looking back, I guess the answer was almost always... "skip class."

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: I can tell, you know. Even if you don't say it. The weight of your past is a lot heavier than anyone knows. Hey, if you wanted to tell me about it, I'd be all ears. But I won't dig. The you I know and want to understand is the you standing right here. It's just... hauling that around must get heavy, right? So if there ever comes a day where you just want to drop it all, forget who you're supposed to be, and just... breathe... Let me know. I've got a few channels to set you up with a whole new look and story. Whatever identity you wanna try on for size, I can make it happen. Well... as long as it's not too crazy. But judging by that look on your face, I think I already know what your answer's gonna be.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: I never could put down roots in my merc life. Anywhere. So I built my whole thing on taking what I could get in the moment. Little indulgences, you could say. That way, whenever I had to bail, I knew I'd gotten everything out of it. And now? Honestly? I still feel the same way. The difference is... that gnawing fear of losing it all? It's gone. Every day here is just... good. I just want to pour everything I've got into appreciating that. I guess what I'm trying to say is... next time we go for a joyride, let me drive. Just like the day we first met.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: Custom paint jobs, skating, parkour, FPS games.... Hard to pick a favorite, but I'd put the feeling of a full throttle under the skies of Lahai-Roi in first place. Lately though, my list of hobbies has been out of control. There's just too much cool stuff to try. Wait... Overflowing Palette? What's that? Heh, now you gotta tell me!

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: Back in the day, it was all about my cover getting blown, or the Fractsidus pulling new crap, or dealing with moving on to someplace new... But now... Ugh. My biggest headache is figuring out how I'm gonna dig myself out of this credit deficit...

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: Lemme let you in on a little secret. Everything tastes amazing when you're eating it in class. Even instant noodles. Gah, just the thrill of it, you know? Like, you wait for the teacher to turn their back to write on the board and then...

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: Anything bland. It's not hate, it's just... a trigger of some bad times. Washes the world out for a minute. So my motto stands, for everything: Go bold. Go bright. Never be boring.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: A dream for the future... huh. Never thought I'd get to have one of those. Let's see, if I could just have more days like today... Yeah. That's enough for me.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: When I came to <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>, all I brought with me was that acceptance letter. The one that never really had my name on it. It was a key. One that unlocked this wild, colorful dream... and all the chaos that came with it. Without it, I never would've met you or anyone else. So... I don't regret what I did. And hey, like you said—This time, this admission letter will be my own.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: The New Federation isn't all bells and whistles. If you're a Resonator, you do what you're told. If you're a merc like I was, you do it for cash. No loyalty. No higher purpose. The only fun I had was spraying a little graffiti after a job was done.... even if I had to scrub it off two seconds later. Anyway, enough about that. So, about our rides. What's the new paint job gonna look like?

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: What do Professor Mornye and I have in common? Easy. We both hate sitting through class! So I took her for a drive one time. Total stone face the whole time, but I could tell she was loving it. The best part was the welcome committee when we got back. A whole pack of her researchers, swarming the gates like I'd just pulled a full-blown professor-napping. I mean, hello?! I kinda like my life here. And let's be real... if I were actually trying to sneak her out, nobody would've had a clue.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: When I first got here, Sigrika helped me get a handle on student life... She's super serious, the kind who never lets up on herself, you know? She never complains though, just bottles it all up inside. She's gonna hit a wall one day if she keeps that up... So, how about you and I... pull a little "intervention"? You know, take her out to have some real fun.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: The first time I met Dr. Herssen at the infirmary, I got this weird feeling he could see right through me. Now I think I might've just imagined it. Anyway, the man can write a very generous doctor's note slip. I'll give him that.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: First time I saw Chisa, I thought that quiet, intense vibe meant "keep your distance." Man, was I wrong. We clicked instantly. She took one look at my bike and knew exactly what part was malfunctioning. Way faster than any manual diagnostic I could've run! Now that's impressive...

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: An organization full of crazies. Too harsh? Doesn't make it less true. I'm done with them. Really hope I won't have to deal with them ever again.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: Happy Birthday! A special day calls for special plans. Consider whatever you're working on handled. I'll help you finish it later. I promised you a surprise that'd blow your mind, so we're ditching the noise. Now, hop on! We're leaving all that boring stuff in the dust. Only thing on the agenda today is you. Oh, and one last thing... you're wearing this balloon hat.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: Yeah... right there. A little more drip... Perfect.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: Heh. Time to shake off the rust... Good. Still got it.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: Hey, name's Lynae. Just Lynae. Looks like I'm your new classmate here at Startorch Prep. So... be nice to the new girl, hmm?

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: Outlaw Blue, Apollo Orange, Hazard Yellow, Acid Green... Wanna guess what color is my next pick?

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: Relax, I can play by the rules.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: The spectrum I'm seeing got a whole lot clearer...!

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: Didn't think I could get this big of an upgrade... Don't hold back on me now!

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: I guess someone's potential is like an Energy Gel Sachet. You think it's empty, but there's always a little more if you squeeze harder...

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: ...Sometimes I think you could stand up there and teach the class yourself. With what you know, you'd own that classroom.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: A bright, big place to call my own. Friends to learn with. Allies to fight beside... Everything I've ever wanted is right here. So even when the training is over... this doesn't just end, right? Keep teaching me. Trust me with more. This peace, this beautiful life... I'm going to fight like hell to protect it.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: Don't blink... you'll miss the best part!

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: Tie a bow and call that my signature!

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: Tch… You haven't seen anything yet.

speaker: Lynae
anh_en: A world... of black and white...

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: Funny thing. When I first went color blind from the side effects of Ichor, the world turned into an old black‑and‑white movie overnight. The only color I saw was the mesmerizing golden hues gilding the world around me: the morning light dancing on the windowsill, students' smiles as I unwrapped their bandages, and the vibrant energy they brought to the room as they pushed open my door... Look, even this bouquet the students brought me this morning glows faintly with the same golden light. Perhaps when I have time, I'll go pick out new specimens myself.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: I was born into a family of doctors. My childhood toys were stethoscopes, and my bedtime stories were medical texts... Anyone would've said I was cut out for medicine. For years, I moved like delicate clockwork, each step precise, deliberate, flawless, on the set trail. But once I'd mastered how to handle a scalpel, confusion made its first incision. Each time I stood beneath the surgical light, I could feel invisible threads pulling at me. Reason ordered me to cut, while the heart refused to move. Can this truly save everyone? Can I really excise all the sickness and decay from this world just by standing here?

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: Later, I turned to psychology. I began listening to people's dreams, hesitations, and fears. I watched repressed emotions begin to stir beneath a calm surface, and that was another kind of "surgery": the incision wasn't on the flesh but on their silent facade. Through it, I saw many climb back up from the depths of despair... and myself being pieced back together through their stories.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: Do you still remember that night of rain? The wind was so strong it could strip a man's bones bare. I thought the world had left me with nothing but an empty grave for company, until I saw you, standing at the edge of the storm, reaching out your hand—you saw through that scheme of "<ano=The Grand Architect>theirs</ano>" long before I did. Even death was just another narrative device in their twisted play. As the rain scoured the scripts off the tombstones like melting snow, the so-called "truth" was washed away, dissolving into obscurity.\n...That was not the ending I wanted.\nI will carve out the truth, and I will expose every lie... to the burning light of day.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: I've seen the sun in our pact. So now, it's my turn to lead the way. Whatever lies ahead—despair or hope—just as we once supported each other through the blizzard, let's walk together shoulder to shoulder.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: Hmm... does being around people count as a hobby? I like meeting others, listening to the stories of their lives. You'd be surprised by the wondrous, amusing tales you'll hear. It's far more interesting than burying myself in research papers.\nOf course, when I'm alone, I like to pour myself a cup of tea, sit by the window, and watch the snow fall... or arrange my scalpels and medicine bottles just right. It's oddly soothing, though sometimes it brings back memories of the old days. Hah, I was joking, of course. I've long since moved on from the past. Whatever happened back then, each day I have is now is something to look forward to.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: Honestly, I don't think I have many worries at this moment—would you believe that? I've learned to enjoy a conversation with others instead of brooding by myself. Whether it's the weather, breakfast, or a flower by the roadside... be it our anxieties or trivialities, they're just proof we're still alive. So, if something's troubling you, just share it with me.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: You already know the answer, don't you? Candy, of course. Would you like one? \nLately I've been experimenting with some new varieties. My students are a constant source of inspiration. The other day, one came to me, dead serious, and asked if I could make a candy that could release exam stress overnight. Heh. Should I tell him that, compared to candy, a chat with me in my counseling office might work better?

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: I can't stomach pungent vegetables or seafood that tastes too fishy. Those tastes remind me of rainy seasons... of damp, moldy, rotten smells. I've never been fond of endless rain... Still, I'd never judge someone else's taste. Every dish that earns affection must have its own charm, wouldn't you say?

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: My lifelong wish is to be someone's "partner in crime." Together, we'll send <ano=The Fractsidus>them</ano> straight back to hell.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: These restraint devices on my neck and arms... they're for containing the Ichor, or what they call the "Golden Serum." Nothing mysterious here. I'm sure you've heard the story, haven't you? They're just "surgical scars." The Ichor can remold itself into any form I desire. As long as I need it, it always appears in my hand in perfect shape. Thanks to these, the Ichor stays quiet within me. I don't... pose any threat now, and I'm in full control.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: The day before I came to <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>, I dumped all of Novialle's mess onto my assistant. I felt oddly at ease when I saw the look of sheer shock and confusion on his face. You were right. I needed to loosen the string I'd kept too tight, and move somewhere new for a fresh start.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: The President of the Academy and a... savvy adult. Lucilla knows what she wants, and what others want from her. Unlike those pedantic academics, she understands when to put her foot down and when to give ground for the sake of <te href=851069>Startorch</te>. She's like the undercurrents flowing beneath the Academy's ice cap—calm, quiet, and always keeping things afloat.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: That child who means so much to you... I do see you in her. So bullheaded up against fate itself. So decisive and brave it leaves one speechless. At moments when that upbeatness flickers, I can tell that bright smile is just a mask she puts on, but if that's what she wants others to see, I'll respect it.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: Sigrika... She shoulders a weight far too heavy for someone her age. Thankfully, there's candy to sweeten the gloom. She never hesitates to sample my newest candies. Her fearlessness has me impressed. Perhaps that curiosity of hers... is what finally lets her act her age.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: We share no blood, two "brothers" played as pawns in this game of Golden Serum. Even so, there were similarities between us—when we have our eyes set on a path, we never turn back. That same hunger to reach the truth, no matter how it burns. If he ever wakes again... I believe he'll be a brilliant painter. He always had the gift. His life shouldn't end here. There must be a way.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: Strange, isn't it? <ano=The Grand Architect>They</ano> toyed with so many lives as if they were stage props, yet I know nothing of their name or gender. I doubt they ever bothered to remember mine either, but that's fine. One day, we'll wrench the entire Fractsidus from their roots and cast them down the abyss they carved out for themselves.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en:
Hello, {PlayerName}. Happy birthday.
The frostlands rarely see the seasons change, only an endless winter stretching as far as the eye can see. Yet the snow that buries the past also nurtures new beginnings. On a day like this—feels right to send out my best wishes.
Thank you for choosing to spend this day with me.
Keep walking towards the sunrise. The world ahead is vast, and your every footprint in the snow will be touched by the light. You'll keep moving forward, and I'll be not far behind, watching over the places you've illuminated. When you look back, I'll still be here, arms open—
Just as we always have, emerging from the dark, together.
From this day on, I'll remain your companion, one you'll never need to thank.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: Take it easy. Do you want one too? Hmm? Haha.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: Dr. Luuk Herssen, from the Resonator Nursing Unit. A rare exception that we meet outside my office. Oh, you can just call me Luuk.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: I've already bid farewell to the self buried beneath the frostlands. When the snow thaws... we'll meet again among the new blooms of spring.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: Need a doctor? I happen to be free.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: May this gold become your most reliable blade.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: My body's responding... with a frequency so subtle, almost inaudible. Like the quiet instant when a blade is finally honed to perfection. Mm, feels good. Precise, like an extension of my arm.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: Strength isn't only for battle. It also finds its way to those who, caught between ruin and recovery, still choose to reach out a hand.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: ...The Ichor's stirring. It burns a bit, but still tolerable. It's fine. Pain is the doctor's language. It reminds me why I took on this duty, and where I must go.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: I won't break. I am the bone that endures blizzards, the white-hot lamp over a surgical table. I burn, but my scalpel never falters.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: We're sworn friends. Together, we'll send those who have no place in this world straight back to hell. So I make this vow to you: I shall resurface from the ice and see the sunlight kiss the snow, until then and beyond, I'll never betray you or leave your side.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: Shh... Struggling only pains you more.

speaker: Luuk Herssen
anh_en: Hmm. Just a few scratches. Everything's functional.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Don't really understand the peeps here. One friendly convo makes someone a choom? One fight, and you trust 'em to watch your back? Can't imagine any of you survivin' a day in Night City.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: ...Askin' about my cyberware? Guess you're not sportin' a scanner. Sorry, but I ain't interested in talking about me or my specs... Rather change the subject.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: I fell into the edgerunner life by chance, but got the gist of crew dynamics pretty quick. Us havin' two netrunners proved a real advantage. When things got messy, I could hand off hacking duties and flank the enemy with my monowire... Adaptive and effective.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Ahem... So yeah, should apologize for tryin' to hack you. If it's any comfort, I got zilch. My scans couldn't read your biodata—your identity's a total black box. Piqued my curiosity, sure, but I decided against digging. Who you are now... is someone I trust.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: You ever been to the Moon? I have, but it cost me a lot... Still remember exactly how I felt when I first arrived. Even though David couldn't take me, I knew we were there together.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: I used to slip outside city limits on still nights to go see the stars. The peace, the silence... I could let my worries melt away, y'know? From the desert, Night City looks like a neon prison, a cage of light. And everyone's trapped inside... myself included.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Sleep doesn't come easily. I close my eyes, and he's there... the cyborg boogeyman. My memory of that day follows me everywhere, even to the Moon. But after what happened here, think I feel strong enough now to face it. So... thank you.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Do energy drinks count? A deep dive into the Net saps you fast, in body and mind. Glug down one of those, it's a fast and efficient refuel. Got in the habit of crackin' one open after every ice bath.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Hm, can't say there's anything I won't eat. 'Ganic foods in Night City are crazy overpriced, so by comparison this place has it beat in both taste and cost. No complaints here.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Used to dream of going to the Moon. Escape there, I thought, and I could leave everything behind. That dream came true... just not in any way I would've ever wanted.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: The David Martinez—it's a cocktail found at a bar in Night City called The Afterlife. Vodka, ice and a splash of NiCola. It's funny... David never liked fizzy drinks... For most, that drink honors a merc legend. For me... a man my heart will never forget.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Night City's a cage, yes... But as I fled my past, it kept me hidden, kept me safe. And just when I started gettin' comfortable, it was all ripped away... Right back to square one.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: She always saw me as a choom, as part of the crew. But in all our time together, I never once opened up to her. It wasn't until she was gone that I realized... just how much I left unsaid.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Tragedy did not extinguish her ideals. She works tirelessly to reach the stars with her own two hands. I mean, sh*t, you can feel the weight of these records just by reading them. If I hadn't met 'er myself, I'd call it a fairy tale. No one holds onto hope that tight... I respect her for it.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: When my Resonance Ability awakened, I hacked Lynae. Not on purpose, but I did see the memories she'd locked away. Hard to reconcile the weight of her past with that big, bright smile. Can't say we're all that different, her and I. I'm just glad she's finally free.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: We've never crossed paths, but her rep's solid. Hear she did a lot of heavy lifting with the Somnoire situation. The approachable Madam President, former editor for the Pioneer Association... Official file reads like a press release though. Bet the real story's a helluva lot more interesting. Wouldn't mind a face-to-face, see the woman behind the curtain.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Sigrika is an interesting girl. Has a way of puttin' people at ease. But what gets me are the runes she uses. What are they? They seem to follow a unique operational logic... some kind of unparsed assembly language? What's the transmission method...?

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: When I hacked into the Second Coming of Solaris's database, I found a sealed file with your birth date. Sooo... surprise, happy birthday. Rebecca's been on my case for weeks 'bout a party. Whenever you're ready, I'll take you there.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Hm? Buried payload. Someone left a present.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Yeah, could use a little unwind.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Well, well... Don't think I've ever seen a score that high.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Not bad. It's good to shake off the rust.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Pff... That was server lag. Doesn't count.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: All right, a tune-up should do the trick for now.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Lucy. When I was takin' gigs as an edgerunner, my specialty was netrunning. If this is just biz, that's all you need to know.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: I know... the dream had to end.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Not like any upgrade I've ever had, hardware or soft. It's like... my whole system's hummin'.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Cyberware benchmarks keep climbin'... What kinda architecture's driving this?

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: 'Preciate the assist... I'm startin' to get used to this.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Startin' to understand what's behind these upgrades. Your world sure has its perks.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Not in the biz of owin' favors, so consider my arsenal of tech wizardry at your disposal. In other words... I got your back.

speaker: Lucy
anh_en: Run. I'll erase you at the finish line.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Take your time and enjoy the journey. Don't hurry too much, or you may miss out on all the beautiful sights along the way. You don't want to reach the end of the road with nothing to show for it. Hehe... Just some tips from someone who's been there before.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: I wasn't slacking off, really. I just needed to recharge a little... Aww, you don't believe me? Don't say that. I'll be so hurt.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: It does get overwhelming with so many people counting on you. I know that feeling all too well... Worry not. You can relax a little more when you're with me.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Oh... I fell asleep? ...Hehe, I guess your presence just made me feel that much more at ease. You should get more rest too, Rover. Staying up late too much could lead to hair loss.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: The danger in the air is palpable nowadays. I guess that's why you have come to our aid at a time like this. How unfortunate, I have been hoping to enjoy a peaceful life with you... Anyway. Rover, would you come a little closer? Let's have some leisurely time together, even if only for a little while.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Had a great sleep. Ugh... time for work... Gotta get up... but... still 'eepy... Just one more nap...

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: I am fully booked for afternoon consultings well into next year, and I heard someone is reselling bookings at high prices... I didn't know it would spiral into this. Honestly, I don't believe my input made much of a difference—in the end, it was up to themselves to solve their own issues.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: I'm all about the easy-to-eat stuff. Give me some creamy, savory porridge any day. Can you help me out with this spoonful? It's a little bit too hot for my tongue.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Hmm... food that requires peeling, I guess. Why? It's too much hassle.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: I really hate working. That said, I've got to put in some effort now so one day I won't have to work anymore. Haha, sure, I could just retire by myself if I want to... but I'm hoping to ease the load off of everyone else once and for all, so we can all enjoy a peaceful life together.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: How do you like it here in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>? Enjoying your stay? It is my dream to make it a truly safe and cozy place to live, free from all the border city dangers.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: In the past, my friends were always there for me, shielding me from harm. Their presence was steadfast like the city walls, providing me a great sense of security and comfort. That is why I am now driven to build stronger walls for all citizens of Jinzhou, so everyone can enjoy the same comfort and reassurance.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: It's your birthday today. You should take a well-deserved rest. Let's nap together, shall we? I've got the comfiest sleep gear just for you. Sweet dreams, and happy birthday, dear.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Perfect weather for a walk today... Hmm, maybe not...

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: More paperwork? Let's see... *satisfied smile* All set. Now, what should I have for dinner?

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Sometimes I pretend I was a cloud in the sky... Just drifting by as a soft and fluffy pile, without any worry.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Hi there, I'm Taoqi, in charge of border defense at the <te href=850085>Ministry of Development</te>. If you need my help, shoot me a message any time. I'll get back to you during work hours.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: No need to rush. Everything will work out in due time.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: I'll take good care of you.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Time to work? *chuckle* No more lazing around, then.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: I feel so good right now, I'd say even better than when I just took a seven-day leave. Thank you for your help, Rover.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: My heart is beating faster, and I can hear my blood rushing... This newfound strength is making me feel a bit restless. Maybe I should go get some sleep.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: With more power comes more responsibility... I really don't want more work, but if it's you asking... I can do some overtime. Just a little.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Thank you. You're so reliable, my darling little one. Hmm? You might have actually lived longer than me. Hehe... Now that I'm stronger than ever, I just want to take care of you like a big sister. Can't you just let me?

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Excited for what's inside? Hehe, aren't you adorable.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: People think Lady Jinhsi is too young to lead, but I don't see the problem. Her young age may be seen as a disadvantage, but it's also her greatest strength. As we work on moving Jinzhou forward, she will go further and accomplish more than any of us can imagine.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Oh, I wish I had someone like Sanhua. Imagine how much easier my work would be with her help. Where on earth did Lady Jinhsi find herself such an incredible bodyguard? I'll have to ask her about it next time we meet.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Mr. Xiangli? Yes, he is a great collaborator of ours at the <te href=850085>Ministry of Development</te>. Our work partially overlaps with the Academy's research projects, and I consult him daily. Despite his genius intellect and quick thinking, I have no issue keeping up with his ideas.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: General Jiyan's schedule is always so impossibly tight... He seems to keep finding more issues to take care of, like a devoted parent who never allows himself any rest. Maybe it's his doctor instincts, always putting others first. I really hope he can take some time off for his own well-being.

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: Time for another afternoon consultation, I see. What's on your mind today?

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: You have opened my eyes to things I've never noticed before. Safety isn't found in one person building a "wall." It comes from supporting each other, and cherishing shared moments. Thank you for always being here for me. If we could stay like this forever, I... Hmm? You didn't catch that last sentence? Hehe, I'll say it again for you, then...

speaker: Taoqi
anh_en: My luck seems good like always.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: Greetings, Rover whom I've come across in my journey. What are you travelling for? You can't quite recall? Hmm, no worries. I'm sure you will rediscover it along the way.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: I was scared, too, when I first started travelling alone. Especially at night, I had this constant feeling of being followed. That's when I'd start chanting to myself, 'Keep going, don't look back'. Master always said that if I kept pushing forward, I'd eventually reach the light of dawn.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: I've gotten used to walking in the dark, braving the ever-changing weather and rugged roads in the wilderness. That doesn't mean I'm letting my guard down. I'll always keep an eye on the shadows—I won't let them hurt anyone in my reach ever again.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: The path of vengeance that I seek is destined to be filled with darkness and peril, like trudging alone through an endless night. Fortunately, with you around, I won't lose myself so easily.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: With you by my side, I can fight without worry... Even if the crimson haze momentarily clouds my sight, you'll be there to help me break free from it, right?

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: I enjoy releasing lanterns into the sky, watching as the solitary lantern in my hand joins the beautiful sea of many lights, setting them free one by one. That sight always fills me with a nostalgic warmth.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: Sometimes I get a little carried away in battles... I didn't startle you, did I?

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: Will there ever be <te href=850115>Loong Whiskers Crisps</te> that are as loooong as a real loong's whiskers? Aww, I really want to give them a try!

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: Star Flakes are pretty, but they're a pain to keep fresh. I once packed a pouchful of them to enjoy while I was out in the wild, and they quickly turned soggy and lost their crunch.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: Wherever I go, I swear to vanquish evil, whether it's out in the daylight or hiding in the dark.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: No matter what happens, no matter what I've been through, this jade pendant will forever stay clear and bright.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: It's easy to cut down my enemies with a sword swing, but eradicating evil is not as simple. One oversight and it silently regenerates, ready to make a comeback... That's why I must uproot and shatter every trace of evil I see.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: Happy Birthday, Rover! I made these <te href=850115>Loong Whiskers Crisps</te> to be as long as those of our great Sentinel. They say eating something long on your birthday makes you live long and prosper. Enjoy!

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: May the moonlight attest my steadfast will.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: Greetings, my name is Danjin. I'm currently patrolling the lands as a ranger. Tell me about any injustice you've encountered, and I'll get it dealt with. You can't think of any? That's good.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: Hopefully my patience will pay off this time.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: Where to? I can lead the way for you.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: Now that my blade is faster, I should be able to make cleaner cuts.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: My Crimson Blades are lasting longer, and my whole body feels so light... I never knew this sword could feel so light in my hands.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: Vengeance is not mindless killing. It is about identifying the root of malice, and hitting where it truly hurts. Thank you, the move you've taught me has been very useful.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: For many years, a crimson rage of vengence had been consuming me, devouring me from within. Now... I can feel it fading away, gradually drown out by the warmth of your kindness. \nWith you by my side, I won't have to journey alone... not anymore.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: Hmm, this is a nice find.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: Mortefi may seem a bit intimidating, but he's actually quite nice. Once my blade got really worn out, and Mortefi repaired it for me. To repay his kindness, that week I wiped out several groups of bandits eyeing the Tacetite weapons he developed... He ended up having to repair it for me again.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: You can never go wrong by taking lost children to Chixia. While some kids may find me scary, they would never be scared of her.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: The familiar sight of Yinlin's thunder always reassures me that the upcoming battle will be a breeze. \nThough, I must admit, it took me until at least our tenth collaboration to finally learn her name... Embarrassingly so.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: When I just met Yangyang, I had been curious how someone could always be such a sweetheart. Later, I finally learned how gentleness with boundary has a powerful strength of its own.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: You always act first in the face of injustice, despite having lost all memories... You must always have been a righteous person, right? I'd be very troubled if it turned out otherwise.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: Ranger, Danjin. Worry not, my Crimson Blade will not harm you as long as you haven't done anything bad.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: My eyes have been opened... I'm starting to realize how there's so much more to the world than just fighting for justice. There are countless amazing things waiting to be discovered, and the best part is having you by my side.

speaker: Danjin
anh_en: Some <te href=850115>Loong Whiskers Crisps</te> would be great…

speaker: Camellya
anh_en: My mind has grown numb with monotony for the past decade or so. I handle exciting jobs sometimes, but the fun soon dries up, like tidal marks on the shoal. But you... you're the only one who keeps me on my toes. So of course I'd be paying attention to you.

speaker: Camellya
anh_en: My stance? Ha! I didn't join <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> to save the world. Just needed a way to pass the time on this island. Justice, truth… Saints spout them, sinners exploit them, all for their own gains. Me? I need nothing and want nothing. Pretty words hold no power over me.

speaker: Camellya
anh_en: Why did you... come here? Told you not to... Cough cough! Not to visit... while I'm here in the pod... Hehe, a cute girl like me needs her privacy, you know? ...I hate myself like this... don't look.

speaker: Camellya
anh_en: You know what? I dreamed of you while I was in the medical pod. In that dream… I couldn't get to know you. Your name echoed in my head endlessly as we roamed the same places, but I never saw your face, not even once... How odd...

speaker: Camellya
anh_en: Saving the world? Couldn't care less. This cage of a world only consumes and binds you with responsibility. But if you believe it's the right thing to do… Go for it! You're staying true to yourself, and I like that. It's beautiful, we both find joy in our own paths! But if you ever get tired of this whole savior business, do let me know… What will I do? Hehe... Secret!

speaker: Camellya
anh_en: Napping in the sun on a warm afternoon is so cozy, I just need to find a quiet place. Sleeping in the warmth, nestled among branches and leaves...

speaker: Camellya
anh_en: Working for <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> has been a snooze fest. I tried to spice it up by picking the toughest jobs, didn't help. There's no one worth my time on <te href=850079>Solaris</te> now. I'm dying of boredom!

speaker: Camellya
anh_en: Fruit juice. Fresh, raw, and tangy. That gentle sweetness lingers... You want some?

speaker: Camellya
anh_en: I don't like boozy stuff. Why? ...I don't know. It just makes me... uncomfortable.

speaker: Camellya
anh_en: Pick the best seeds, protect them till they're ripe. Then comes the fun—I'll have worthy opponents to fight! I don't care about the rest. We'll all die one day, might as well dance and live it up while we can. Responsibility? Ideals? Those are just lies we tell ourselves to feel better, nothing but a false high.

speaker: Camellya
anh_en: This bracelet was a gift from you. I remember it's meant to monitor my frequency. Then in case I'm in trouble, you can find me. Convenient, right? It's been broken for years now, though...

speaker: Camellya
anh_en: I'm a regular at the medical pod. The docs must be surprised I'm still alive after all these years. Binders are my saving grace—can't handle the pain without them. That's how I made it through alive every time. Don't look at me like that. I see nothing bad about it. Being on death's doorstep taught me to stay true to myself. Betraying life is worse than any lie. You have to embrace yourself to find real joy.

speaker: Camellya
anh_en: Encore… Ah, that girl who loves stories! I hope she'll mature into a strong opponent one day, then we'll have so much fun together.

speaker: Camellya
